```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Content;

use App\Enums\ArticleStatus;
use App\Models\Article;
use App\Models\Media;
use App\Models\User;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\MassAssignmentException;
use Illuminate\Database\LazyLoadingViolationException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Model Article (09 §6.3, F4A-R5, F4A-R7, F4A-R10). Review Focus F.1: batas waktu tayang.
 */
class ArticleModelTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function freeze(): Carbon
    {
        $this->travelTo(Carbon::parse('2026-10-05 10:00:00'));

        return now();
    }

    public function test_fillable_follows_the_blueprint(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame([
            'article_category_id', 'author_user_id', 'title', 'slug', 'excerpt', 'body', 'status',
            'published_at', 'meta_title', 'meta_description',
        ], (new Article)->getFillable());
    }

    public function test_unknown_attributes_are_rejected_in_strict_mode(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(MassAssignmentException::class);

        (new Article)->fill(['bukan_kolom' => 'x']);
    }

    public function test_casts_and_database_defaults(): void
    {
        $created = Article::query()->create([
            'title' => 'Artikel Minimal', 'excerpt' => 'Ringkasan.', 'body' => '<p>Isi artikel yang cukup panjang untuk uji.</p>',
        ]);
        $article = Article::query()->findOrFail($created->id);

        $this->assertSame(ArticleStatus::Draft, $article->status);
        $this->assertNull($article->published_at);
        $this->assertNull($article->article_category_id);
        $this->assertNull($article->author_user_id);
        $this->assertSame('artikel-minimal', $article->slug);

        $published = $this->createArticle();
        $this->assertSame(ArticleStatus::Published, $published->status);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(Carbon::class, $published->published_at);
    }

    public function test_factory_states(): void
    {
        $this->freeze();

        $published = Article::factory()->published()->create();
        $draft = Article::factory()->draft()->create();
        $scheduled = Article::factory()->scheduled()->create();
        $trashed = Article::factory()->trashed()->create();

        $this->assertSame(ArticleStatus::Published, $published->status);
        $this->assertTrue($published->published_at->isSameDay(now()->subDay()));
        $this->assertSame(ArticleStatus::Draft, $draft->status);
        $this->assertNull($draft->published_at);
        $this->assertSame(ArticleStatus::Published, $scheduled->status);
        $this->assertTrue($scheduled->published_at->greaterThan(now()));
        $this->assertTrue($trashed->trashed());
        $this->assertSame(1, Article::onlyTrashed()->count());
        $this->assertSame(3, Article::query()->count());
    }

    // --- Review Focus F.1: batas waktu tayang ---

    public function test_published_scope_honours_the_publication_boundaries(): void
    {
        $now = $this->freeze();

        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Tepat sekarang', 'published_at' => $now]);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Satu menit lalu', 'published_at' => $now->copy()->subMinute()]);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Satu menit lagi', 'published_at' => $now->copy()->addMinute()]);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Satu detik lagi', 'published_at' => $now->copy()->addSecond()]);
        Article::factory()->draft()->create(['title' => 'Draf ber-tanggal', 'published_at' => $now->copy()->subDay()]);
        Article::factory()->trashed()->create(['title' => 'Terhapus']);
        Article::factory()->create(['title' => 'Terbit tanpa tanggal', 'status' => 'published', 'published_at' => null]);

        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing(
            ['Tepat sekarang', 'Satu menit lalu'],
            Article::query()->published()->pluck('title')->all(),
        );
    }

    public function test_an_article_becomes_visible_when_the_clock_reaches_published_at(): void
    {
        $now = $this->freeze();
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Terjadwal', 'published_at' => $now->copy()->addMinutes(5)]);

        $this->assertSame(0, Article::query()->published()->count());

        $this->travelTo($now->copy()->addMinutes(5)->subSecond());
        $this->assertSame(0, Article::query()->published()->count());

        $this->travelTo($now->copy()->addMinutes(5));
        $this->assertSame(1, Article::query()->published()->count());
    }

    public function test_is_publicly_visible_and_is_scheduled_follow_the_same_rules(): void
    {
        $now = $this->freeze();

        $past = $this->createArticle(['published_at' => $now->copy()->subMinute()]);
        $exact = $this->createArticle(['published_at' => $now]);
        $future = $this->createArticle(['published_at' => $now->copy()->addMinute()]);
        $draft = Article::factory()->draft()->create(['published_at' => $now->copy()->subDay()]);
        $draftFuture = Article::factory()->draft()->create(['published_at' => $now->copy()->addDay()]);
        $trashed = Article::factory()->trashed()->create();
        $noDate = Article::factory()->create(['status' => 'published', 'published_at' => null]);

        $this->assertTrue($past->isPubliclyVisible());
        $this->assertTrue($exact->isPubliclyVisible());
        $this->assertFalse($future->isPubliclyVisible());
        $this->assertFalse($draft->isPubliclyVisible());
        $this->assertFalse($draftFuture->isPubliclyVisible());
        $this->assertFalse($trashed->isPubliclyVisible());
        $this->assertFalse($noDate->isPubliclyVisible());

        $this->assertFalse($past->isScheduled());
        $this->assertFalse($exact->isScheduled());
        $this->assertTrue($future->isScheduled());
        $this->assertFalse($draft->isScheduled());
        $this->assertFalse($draftFuture->isScheduled(), 'Draf bukan terjadwal, walau published_at di masa depan.');
        $this->assertFalse($noDate->isScheduled());
    }

    public function test_going_back_to_draft_keeps_published_at_but_hides_the_article(): void
    {
        $this->freeze();
        $article = $this->createArticle();
        $publishedAt = $article->published_at->toDateTimeString();

        $article->update(['status' => 'draft']);

        $this->assertSame($publishedAt, $article->fresh()->published_at->toDateTimeString());
        $this->assertFalse($article->fresh()->isPubliclyVisible());
        $this->assertSame(0, Article::query()->published()->count());
    }

    public function test_newest_first_orders_by_published_at_then_id_descending(): void
    {
        $now = $this->freeze();

        $old = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Lama', 'published_at' => $now->copy()->subDays(5)]);
        $sameA = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Sama A', 'published_at' => $now->copy()->subDays(2)]);
        $sameB = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Sama B', 'published_at' => $now->copy()->subDays(2)]);
        $new = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Baru', 'published_at' => $now->copy()->subDay()]);

        $this->assertSame(
            [$new->id, $sameB->id, $sameA->id, $old->id],
            Article::query()->newestFirst()->pluck('id')->all(),
        );
    }

    // --- search dan inCategory ---

    public function test_search_matches_title_and_excerpt_case_insensitively_and_trims(): void
    {
        $byTitle = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Menjaga Jantung Sehat', 'excerpt' => 'Ringkasan satu.']);
        $byExcerpt = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Tidur Nyenyak', 'excerpt' => 'Membantu jantung beristirahat.']);
        $other = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Cuci Tangan', 'excerpt' => 'Kebersihan.']);

        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing([$byTitle->id, $byExcerpt->id], Article::query()->search('  JANTUNG  ')->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame([$other->id], Article::query()->search('kebersihan')->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame([], Article::query()->search('tidak ada')->pluck('id')->all());
    }

    #[DataProvider('blankSearchTerms')]
    public function test_a_blank_search_term_has_no_effect(?string $term): void
    {
        $this->createArticle();
        $this->createArticle();
        $this->createArticle();

        $this->assertSame(3, Article::query()->search($term)->count());
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{0: ?string}> */
    public static function blankSearchTerms(): array
    {
        return ['null' => [null], 'kosong' => [''], 'spasi' => ['   ']];
    }

    public function test_search_escapes_like_wildcards_and_backslashes(): void
    {
        $percent = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Diskon 100% Sehat']);
        $plainPercent = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Diskon 100 Sehat']);
        $underscore = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Tidur_Nyenyak']);
        $plainUnderscore = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Tidur Nyenyak']);
        $backslash = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Jalur A\\B']);

        $this->assertSame([$percent->id], Article::query()->search('100%')->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame([$underscore->id], Article::query()->search('Tidur_N')->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame([$backslash->id], Article::query()->search('A\\B')->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertContains($plainPercent->id, Article::query()->search('100')->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertContains($plainUnderscore->id, Article::query()->search('Nyenyak')->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame(0, Article::query()->search('%')->whereKeyNot($percent->id)->count());
    }

    public function test_in_category_filters_by_the_category_slug(): void
    {
        $gizi = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Gizi']);
        $anak = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Anak']);
        $a = $this->createArticle([], $gizi);
        $this->createArticle([], $anak);
        $this->createArticle();

        $this->assertSame([$a->id], Article::query()->inCategory('gizi')->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame(0, Article::query()->inCategory('tidak-ada')->count());
    }

    // --- Accessor ---

    #[DataProvider('readingTimes')]
    public function test_reading_time_is_the_word_count_over_two_hundred_rounded_up(string $body, int $minutes): void
    {
        $this->assertSame($minutes, (new Article(['body' => $body]))->reading_time_minutes);
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{0: string, 1: int}> */
    public static function readingTimes(): array
    {
        return [
            'kosong' => ['', 1],
            'hanya tag' => ['<p><br></p>', 1],
            'satu kata' => ['<p>kata</p>', 1],
            '200 kata' => ['<p>'.str_repeat('kata ', 200).'</p>', 1],
            '201 kata' => ['<p>'.str_repeat('kata ', 201).'</p>', 2],
            '400 kata' => ['<p>'.str_repeat('kata ', 400).'</p>', 2],
            '401 kata' => ['<p>'.str_repeat('kata ', 401).'</p>', 3],
            'tag tidak menyatukan kata' => [str_repeat('<p>kata</p>', 201), 2],
            'entitas dan tag sisipan' => ['<p>satu&nbsp;dua <strong>tiga</strong></p>', 1],
        ];
    }

    public function test_seo_title_and_description_fall_back_to_title_and_excerpt(): void
    {
        $plain = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Judul Artikel', 'excerpt' => 'Ringkasan artikel.']);
        $custom = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Judul Lain', 'excerpt' => 'Ringkasan lain.', 'meta_title' => 'Meta Judul', 'meta_description' => 'Meta deskripsi.']);
        $blank = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Judul Ketiga', 'excerpt' => 'Ringkasan ketiga.', 'meta_title' => '', 'meta_description' => '']);

        $this->assertSame('Judul Artikel', $plain->seo_title);
        $this->assertSame('Ringkasan artikel.', $plain->seo_description);
        $this->assertSame('Meta Judul', $custom->seo_title);
        $this->assertSame('Meta deskripsi.', $custom->seo_description);
        $this->assertSame('Judul Ketiga', $blank->seo_title);
        $this->assertSame('Ringkasan ketiga.', $blank->seo_description);
    }

    // --- Slug ---

    public function test_slug_is_derived_from_the_title_and_numbered_on_conflict(): void
    {
        $first = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Pola Tidur yang Baik']);
        $second = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Pola Tidur yang Baik']);

        $this->assertSame('pola-tidur-yang-baik', $first->slug);
        $this->assertSame('pola-tidur-yang-baik-2', $second->slug);
    }

    public function test_an_explicit_slug_is_kept_and_not_changed_by_a_title_edit(): void
    {
        $article = $this->createArticle([
            'title' => 'Mengapa Pemeriksaan Kesehatan Berkala Itu Penting',
            'slug' => 'pentingnya-pemeriksaan-kesehatan-berkala',
        ]);

        $this->assertSame('pentingnya-pemeriksaan-kesehatan-berkala', $article->slug);

        $article->update(['title' => 'Judul Berubah']);

        $this->assertSame('pentingnya-pemeriksaan-kesehatan-berkala', $article->fresh()->slug);
    }

    public function test_slug_never_exceeds_the_column_length(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(220, strlen(Article::uniqueSlug(str_repeat('a', 400))));
        $this->assertStringEndsNotWith('-', Article::uniqueSlug(str_repeat('abcdefghi ', 40)));
    }

    // --- Media dan relasi ---

    public function test_cover_url_is_the_placeholder_without_media(): void
    {
        $article = Article::query()->with('media')->findOrFail($this->createArticle()->id);

        $this->assertSame(asset('images/placeholders/article.svg'), $article->cover_url);
    }

    public function test_cover_url_points_to_the_uploaded_cover(): void
    {
        Storage::fake('public');
        $created = Article::factory()->withCover()->create();
        $article = Article::query()->with('media')->findOrFail($created->id);

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('images/placeholders', $article->cover_url);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('cover/', $article->cover_url);
        $this->assertSame('cover', $article->firstMedia('cover')->collection);
    }

    public function test_relations_resolve_without_lazy_loading_when_eager_loaded(): void
    {
        $category = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Gizi']);
        $author = User::factory()->create(['name' => 'Penulis Satu']);

        foreach (range(1, 4) as $i) {
            $this->createArticle(['author_user_id' => $author->id, 'title' => "Artikel nomor {$i}"], $category);
        }

        $articles = Article::query()->with(['category', 'author', 'media'])->newestFirst()->get();

        $this->assertCount(4, $articles);

        foreach ($articles as $article) {
            $this->assertSame('Gizi', $article->category->name);
            $this->assertSame('Penulis Satu', $article->author->name);
            $this->assertSame(asset('images/placeholders/article.svg'), $article->cover_url);
        }
    }

    public function test_an_article_without_category_or_author_has_null_relations(): void
    {
        $article = Article::query()->with(['category', 'author'])->findOrFail($this->createArticle()->id);

        $this->assertNull($article->category);
        $this->assertNull($article->author);
    }

    public function test_listing_without_eager_loading_is_caught_by_strict_mode(): void
    {
        $category = $this->createArticleCategory();
        $this->createArticle([], $category);
        $this->createArticle([], $category);

        $articles = Article::query()->get();

        $this->expectException(LazyLoadingViolationException::class);

        $articles->first()->category;
    }

    public function test_body_is_sanitized_on_save(): void
    {
        $article = $this->createArticle(['body' => '<script>alert(1)</script><p onclick="x()">Isi artikel yang aman.</p>']);

        $stored = (string) DB::table('articles')->where('id', $article->id)->value('body');

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<script', $stored);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('onclick', $stored);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<p>Isi artikel yang aman.</p>', $stored);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Content;

use App\Models\Banner;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Model Banner (09 §6.4, F4A-R25). Review Focus F.1: batas waktu tayang banner.
 */
class BannerModelTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function freeze(): Carbon
    {
        $this->travelTo(Carbon::parse('2026-10-05 10:00:00'));

        return now();
    }

    public function test_fillable_follows_the_blueprint(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(
            ['title', 'subtitle', 'button_label', 'button_url', 'sort_order', 'is_active', 'starts_at', 'ends_at'],
            (new Banner)->getFillable(),
        );
    }

    public function test_casts_and_defaults(): void
    {
        $created = Banner::query()->create(['title' => 'Banner Minimal']);
        $banner = Banner::query()->findOrFail($created->id);

        $this->assertTrue($banner->is_active);
        $this->assertSame(0, $banner->sort_order);
        $this->assertNull($banner->starts_at);
        $this->assertNull($banner->ends_at);
        $this->assertNull($banner->button_label);
    }

    public function test_factory_states(): void
    {
        $now = $this->freeze();

        $plain = Banner::factory()->create();
        $expired = Banner::factory()->expired()->create();
        $scheduled = Banner::factory()->scheduled()->create();
        $inactive = Banner::factory()->inactive()->create();

        $this->assertTrue($plain->is_active);
        $this->assertNull($plain->starts_at);
        $this->assertNull($plain->ends_at);
        $this->assertTrue($expired->ends_at->lessThan($now));
        $this->assertTrue($expired->starts_at->lessThan($expired->ends_at));
        $this->assertTrue($scheduled->starts_at->greaterThan($now));
        $this->assertTrue($scheduled->starts_at->lessThan($scheduled->ends_at));
        $this->assertFalse($inactive->is_active);
    }

    public function test_currently_active_honours_the_period_boundaries(): void
    {
        $now = $this->freeze();

        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Tanpa periode']);
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Mulai tepat sekarang', 'starts_at' => $now]);
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Selesai tepat sekarang', 'ends_at' => $now]);
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Dalam jendela', 'starts_at' => $now->copy()->subDay(), 'ends_at' => $now->copy()->addDay()]);
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Berakhir semenit lalu', 'ends_at' => $now->copy()->subMinute()]);
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Mulai semenit lagi', 'starts_at' => $now->copy()->addMinute()]);
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Mulai sedetik lagi', 'starts_at' => $now->copy()->addSecond()]);
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Nonaktif dalam jendela', 'is_active' => false, 'starts_at' => $now->copy()->subDay(), 'ends_at' => $now->copy()->addDay()]);
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Nonaktif tanpa periode', 'is_active' => false]);

        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing(
            ['Tanpa periode', 'Mulai tepat sekarang', 'Selesai tepat sekarang', 'Dalam jendela'],
            Banner::query()->currentlyActive()->pluck('title')->all(),
        );
    }

    public function test_a_banner_ends_after_the_end_second_has_passed(): void
    {
        $now = $this->freeze();
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Promo', 'ends_at' => $now->copy()->addMinute()]);

        $this->travelTo($now->copy()->addMinute());
        $this->assertSame(1, Banner::query()->currentlyActive()->count());

        $this->travelTo($now->copy()->addMinute()->addSecond());
        $this->assertSame(0, Banner::query()->currentlyActive()->count());
    }

    public function test_currently_active_and_ordered_sort_by_sort_order_then_id(): void
    {
        $this->freeze();

        $third = $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Ketiga', 'sort_order' => 5]);
        $firstA = $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Pertama A', 'sort_order' => 1]);
        $firstB = $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Pertama B', 'sort_order' => 1]);
        $second = $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Kedua', 'sort_order' => 2]);

        $expected = [$firstA->id, $firstB->id, $second->id, $third->id];

        $this->assertSame($expected, Banner::query()->currentlyActive()->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame($expected, Banner::query()->ordered()->pluck('id')->all());
    }

    public function test_schedule_label_has_four_values(): void
    {
        $now = $this->freeze();

        $live = $this->createBanner();
        $liveWindow = $this->createBanner(['starts_at' => $now->copy()->subDay(), 'ends_at' => $now->copy()->addDay()]);
        $scheduled = $this->createBanner(['starts_at' => $now->copy()->addHour()]);
        $ended = $this->createBanner(['ends_at' => $now->copy()->subHour()]);
        $inactive = $this->createBanner(['is_active' => false]);

        $this->assertSame('Tayang', $live->scheduleLabel());
        $this->assertSame('Tayang', $liveWindow->scheduleLabel());
        $this->assertSame('Terjadwal', $scheduled->scheduleLabel());
        $this->assertSame('Berakhir', $ended->scheduleLabel());
        $this->assertSame('Nonaktif', $inactive->scheduleLabel());
    }

    public function test_schedule_label_boundaries_match_the_currently_active_scope(): void
    {
        $now = $this->freeze();

        $startsNow = $this->createBanner(['starts_at' => $now]);
        $endsNow = $this->createBanner(['ends_at' => $now]);
        $startsLater = $this->createBanner(['starts_at' => $now->copy()->addSecond()]);
        $endedBefore = $this->createBanner(['ends_at' => $now->copy()->subSecond()]);
        $inactiveScheduled = $this->createBanner(['is_active' => false, 'starts_at' => $now->copy()->addDay()]);
        $inactiveExpired = $this->createBanner(['is_active' => false, 'ends_at' => $now->copy()->subDay()]);

        $this->assertSame('Tayang', $startsNow->scheduleLabel());
        $this->assertSame('Tayang', $endsNow->scheduleLabel());
        $this->assertSame('Terjadwal', $startsLater->scheduleLabel());
        $this->assertSame('Berakhir', $endedBefore->scheduleLabel());
        $this->assertSame('Nonaktif', $inactiveScheduled->scheduleLabel());
        $this->assertSame('Nonaktif', $inactiveExpired->scheduleLabel());

        $active = Banner::query()->currentlyActive()->pluck('id')->all();

        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing([$startsNow->id, $endsNow->id], $active);
    }

    public function test_image_url_is_the_placeholder_without_media(): void
    {
        $banner = Banner::query()->with('media')->findOrFail($this->createBanner()->id);

        $this->assertSame(asset('images/placeholders/banner.svg'), $banner->image_url);
    }

    public function test_the_list_with_media_does_not_lazy_load(): void
    {
        foreach (range(1, 3) as $i) {
            $this->createBanner(['title' => "Banner {$i}"]);
        }

        foreach (Banner::query()->with('media')->ordered()->get() as $banner) {
            $this->assertSame(asset('images/placeholders/banner.svg'), $banner->image_url);
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Content;

use Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent;
use Tests\TestCase;

class GalleryModelTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_constants_and_fillable_follow_the_blueprint(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(100, Gallery::MAX_PHOTOS);
        $this->assertSame(['title', 'slug', 'description', 'is_published', 'sort_order'], (new Gallery)->getFillable());
    }

    public function test_defaults_and_factory_states(): void
    {
        $created = Gallery::query()->create(['title' => 'Album Minimal']);
        $fresh = Gallery::query()->findOrFail($created->id);

        $this->assertFalse($fresh->is_published);
        $this->assertSame(0, $fresh->sort_order);

        $this->assertTrue($this->createGallery()->is_published);
        $this->assertFalse(Gallery::factory()->unpublished()->create()->is_published);
    }

    public function test_published_and_ordered_scopes(): void
    {
        $c = $this->createGallery(['title' => 'C', 'sort_order' => 3]);
        $a1 = $this->createGallery(['title' => 'A1', 'sort_order' => 1]);
        $a2 = $this->createGallery(['title' => 'A2', 'sort_order' => 1]);
        $draft = $this->createGallery(['title' => 'Draf', 'is_published' => false, 'sort_order' => 0]);

        $this->assertSame([$a1->id, $a2->id, $c->id], Gallery::query()->published()->ordered()->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame([$draft->id, $a1->id, $a2->id, $c->id], Gallery::query()->ordered()->pluck('id')->all());
    }

    {

        $first = $this->addGalleryPhoto($gallery, ['sort_order' => 1]);
        $tied = $this->addGalleryPhoto($gallery, ['sort_order' => 1]);
        $this->addGalleryPhoto($gallery, ['collection' => 'editor', 'sort_order' => 0]);

        $loaded = Gallery::query()->with('media')->findOrFail($gallery->id);

        $this->assertSame($first->id, $loaded->coverMedia()?->id);
        $this->assertNotSame($tied->id, $loaded->coverMedia()?->id);
        $this->assertCount(3, $loaded->mediaIn('photos'));
        $this->assertSame([$first->id, $tied->id, $third->id], $loaded->mediaIn('photos')->pluck('id')->all());
    }

        $this->assertNull($gallery->coverMedia());
    }

    public function test_add_gallery_photo_helper_numbers_photos_sequentially(): void

        $this->assertSame('lobi-dan-area-pendaftaran-foto-contoh', $first->fresh()->slug);
    }

    public function test_slug_never_exceeds_the_column_length(): void
```

```php
        $this->assertSame([$umum->id, $draft->id, $a1->id, $a2->id, $b->id], Faq::query()->ordered()->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame(0, Faq::query()->inCategory('layanan')->count());
```

```php
        $this->assertSame('Mitra asuransi masih dipakai oleh 1 data. Nonaktifkan saja.', $other->deletionBlockedReason());
        $this->assertCount(2, $partner->appointments);
    }

    {

        $this->expectException(QueryException::class);

        $partner->delete();
    }
```

- [ ] **Step 12: Implementasi `app/Support/InternalLink.php` (tool Write)**

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Support;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Routing\Router;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\MethodNotAllowedHttpException;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\NotFoundHttpException;

/**
 * Memeriksa apakah sebuah path internal (mis. `/dokter?q=a`) cocok dengan route GET yang terdaftar
 * (F4A-R15). Dipakai `Banner::hasUsableButton()` agar tombol banner yang menunjuk route fase lain
 * (mis. `/pasien/pendaftaran/baru` sebelum fase 6) tidak tampil sebagai tautan mati.
 *
 * Hanya path yang diawali satu `/`; `//host`, karakter kontrol, spasi, dan backslash ditolak (browser
 * memperlakukan `/\host` sebagai `//host`). Query dan fragmen diabaikan. Pencocokan memakai router
 * (`RouteCollection::match`), jadi segmen berparameter seperti `/dokter/abc` dianggap ada; keberadaan
 * modelnya tidak diperiksa.
 */
final class InternalLink
{
    public static function exists(string $path): bool
    {
        if ($path === '' || $path[0] !== '/' || str_starts_with($path, '//')) {
            return false;
        }

        if (preg_match('/[\x00-\x20\x7F\\\\]/', $path) === 1) {
            return false;
        }

        $target = parse_url($path, PHP_URL_PATH);

        if (! is_string($target) || $target === '') {
            return false;
        }

        try {
            app(Router::class)->getRoutes()->match(Request::create($target, 'GET'));
        } catch (NotFoundHttpException|MethodNotAllowedHttpException) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```php
        ],

        ],
    ];

    /**
     * `key` dan `is_system` sengaja tidak termasuk: diisi seeder lewat forceFill() (F4A-R24).
     *
     * @var list<string>
     */
    protected $fillable = [
        'title',
        'subtitle',
        'body',
        'meta_title',
        'meta_description',
        'updated_by',
    ];

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'is_system' => 'boolean',
        ];
    }

    public function updater(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'updated_by');
    }

    /**
     * Halaman sistem untuk `$key`. Bila barisnya belum ada, mengembalikan instance TAK TERSIMPAN dari
     * `DEFAULTS` (judul, subjudul, meta description; `body` NULL) sehingga halaman publik tetap 200 (F4A-R4).
     * Key di luar `KEYS` melempar InvalidArgumentException.
     */
    public static function forKey(string $key): self
    {
        if (! in_array($key, self::KEYS, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Halaman sistem tidak dikenal: {$key}.");
        }

        $page = static::query()->where('key', $key)->first();

        if ($page !== null) {
            return $page;
        }

        $defaults = self::DEFAULTS[$key];

        return (new self)->forceFill([
            'key' => $key,
            'title' => $defaults['title'],
            'subtitle' => $defaults['subtitle'],
            'body' => null,
            'meta_title' => null,
            'meta_description' => $defaults['meta_description'],
            'is_system' => true,
            'updated_by' => null,
        ]);
    }

    /** Halaman ini boleh memiliki isi rich text (`pages.body`). */
    public function hasBody(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this->key, self::KEYS_WITH_BODY, true);
    }

    /** Nama route publik halaman ini (00 E.5). */
    public function publicRouteName(): string
    {
        return self::ROUTES[$this->key];
    }

    /**
     * Judul SEO: `meta_title`, atau `title` bila kosong (F4A-R5).
     *
     * @return Attribute<string, never>
     */
    protected function seoTitle(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::get(fn (): string => filled($this->meta_title) ? (string) $this->meta_title : (string) $this->title);
    }

    /**
     * Deskripsi SEO: `meta_description`, lalu `subtitle`, lalu NULL (layout memakai `seo.default_meta_description`).
     *
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Enums\ArticleStatus;
use App\Models\Concerns\HasMedia;
use App\Models\Concerns\HasUniqueSlug;
use App\Models\Concerns\SanitizesRichText;
use Database\Factories\ArticleFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Casts\Attribute;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;

/**
 * Artikel kesehatan (09 §6.3). Tayang publik = `status = published` ∧ `published_at <= now()` ∧ belum dihapus
 * (F4A-R10); `published_at` di masa depan berarti terjadwal. Soft delete mempertahankan media dan slug.
 * Accessor `reading_time_minutes` dan `seo_*` membaca `body`/`excerpt`, jadi daftar yang memakainya tidak boleh
 * memilih kolom parsial.
 */
class Article extends Model
{
    /** @use HasFactory<ArticleFactory> */
    use HasFactory, HasMedia, HasUniqueSlug, SanitizesRichText, SoftDeletes;

    /**
     * `author_user_id` diisi controller (pengguna pembuat), tetapi tetap fillable agar factory/seeder
     * dapat mengaturnya; `deleted_at` tidak termasuk.
     *
     * @var list<string>
     */
    protected $fillable = [
        'article_category_id',
        'author_user_id',
        'title',
        'slug',
        'excerpt',
        'body',
        'status',
        'published_at',
        'meta_title',
        'meta_description',
    ];

    /**
     * @return array<string, string|class-string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'status' => ArticleStatus::class,
            'published_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    public function category(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(ArticleCategory::class, 'article_category_id');
    }

    public function author(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'author_user_id');
    }

    /** Tayang: terbit dan `published_at` sudah tercapai (inklusif). Artikel terhapus sudah disaring SoftDeletes. */
    public function scopePublished(Builder $query): void
    {
        $query
            ->where($this->qualifyColumn('status'), ArticleStatus::Published->value)
            ->where($this->qualifyColumn('published_at'), '<=', now()->startOfSecond());
    }

    public function scopeNewestFirst(Builder $query): void
    {
        $query->orderByDesc($this->qualifyColumn('published_at'))->orderByDesc($this->qualifyColumn('id'));
    }

    /**
     * Cari pada judul dan ringkasan. Kata kunci dipangkas; karakter `\`, `%`, `_` di-escape; kosong tanpa efek.
     */
    public function scopeSearch(Builder $query, ?string $term): void
    {
        $term = trim((string) $term);

        if ($term === '') {
            return;
        }

        $like = '%'.str_replace(['\\', '%', '_'], ['\\\\', '\\%', '\\_'], $term).'%';

        $query->where(function (Builder $inner) use ($like): void {
            $inner->where($this->qualifyColumn('title'), 'like', $like)
                ->orWhere($this->qualifyColumn('excerpt'), 'like', $like);
        });
    }

    /** Artikel pada kategori dengan slug tertentu (relasi `category` tidak perlu dimuat). */
    public function scopeInCategory(Builder $query, string $slug): void
    {
        $query->whereHas('category', fn (Builder $category) => $category->where('slug', $slug));
    }

    /** Dapat dilihat publik sekarang (F4A-R10). */
    public function isPubliclyVisible(): bool
    {
        return ! $this->trashed()
            && $this->status === ArticleStatus::Published
            && $this->published_at !== null
            && $this->published_at->lte(now()->startOfSecond());
    }

    /** Terbit tetapi belum tayang: `published_at` di masa depan. Draf bukan terjadwal. */
    public function isScheduled(): bool
    {
        return $this->status === ArticleStatus::Published
            && $this->published_at !== null
            && $this->published_at->gt(now()->startOfSecond());
    }

    /**
     * URL cover (koleksi `cover`), atau placeholder `article.svg`. Muat `media` pada daftar.
     *
     * @return Attribute<string, never>
     */
    protected function coverUrl(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::get(fn (): string => $this->mediaUrl('cover', 'full', 'images/placeholders/article.svg'));
    }

    /**
     * Perkiraan waktu baca: jumlah kata teks polos (tag dibuang, setiap tag menjadi pemisah) dibagi 200,
     * dibulatkan ke atas, minimal 1 menit.
     *
     * @return Attribute<int, never>
     */
    protected function readingTimeMinutes(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::get(function (): int {
            $spaced = preg_replace('~<[^>]*>~', ' ', (string) $this->body) ?? '';
            $text = trim(html_entity_decode($spaced, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8'));
            $words = $text === '' ? [] : (preg_split('/\s+/u', $text, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY) ?: []);

            return max(1, (int) ceil(count($words) / 200));
        });
    }

    /**
     * Judul SEO: `meta_title`, atau judul artikel bila kosong (F4A-R5).
     *
     * @return Attribute<string, never>
     */
    protected function seoTitle(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::get(fn (): string => filled($this->meta_title) ? (string) $this->meta_title : (string) $this->title);
    }

    /**
     * Deskripsi SEO: `meta_description`, atau ringkasan bila kosong (F4A-R5).
     *
     * @return Attribute<string, never>
     */
    protected function seoDescription(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::get(fn (): string => filled($this->meta_description) ? (string) $this->meta_description : (string) $this->excerpt);
    }

    /**
     * Kolom rich text yang disanitasi saat disimpan (F2-R14).
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function richTextAttributes(): array
    {
        return ['body'];
    }

    /** Slug berasal dari judul (F4A-R7). */
    protected function slugSource(): string
    {
        return (string) $this->getAttribute('title');
    }

    /** Panjang kolom `articles.slug` (09 §6.3). */
    protected function slugMaxLength(): int
    {
        return 220;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Models\Concerns\HasMedia;
use App\Support\InternalLink;
use Database\Factories\BannerFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Casts\Attribute;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

/**
 * Banner beranda (09 §6.4). Tayang bila `is_active` dan sekarang berada dalam [`starts_at`, `ends_at`]
 * (NULL = tanpa batas; batas inklusif). Hapus permanen; gambarnya (koleksi `image`) ikut terhapus.
 */
class Banner extends Model
{
    /** @use HasFactory<BannerFactory> */
    use HasFactory, HasMedia;

    /**
     * @var list<string>
     */
    protected $fillable = [
        'title',
        'subtitle',
        'button_label',
        'button_url',
        'sort_order',
        'is_active',
        'starts_at',
        'ends_at',
    ];

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'sort_order' => 'integer',
            'is_active' => 'boolean',
            'starts_at' => 'datetime',
            'ends_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    /** Sedang tayang, urut `sort_order` lalu `id` (F4A-R25). */
    public function scopeCurrentlyActive(Builder $query): void
    {
        $now = now()->startOfSecond();

        $query
            ->where($this->qualifyColumn('is_active'), true)
            ->where(function (Builder $inner) use ($now): void {
                $inner->whereNull($this->qualifyColumn('starts_at'))->orWhere($this->qualifyColumn('starts_at'), '<=', $now);
            })
            ->where(function (Builder $inner) use ($now): void {
                $inner->whereNull($this->qualifyColumn('ends_at'))->orWhere($this->qualifyColumn('ends_at'), '>=', $now);
            })
            ->ordered();
    }

    public function scopeOrdered(Builder $query): void
    {
        $query->orderBy($this->qualifyColumn('sort_order'))->orderBy($this->qualifyColumn('id'));
    }

    /**
     * Tombol layak tampil (F4A-R15): label dan URL terisi, dan URL-nya `https://…` atau path internal yang
     * cocok dengan route terdaftar (`InternalLink::exists`).
     */
    public function hasUsableButton(): bool
    {
        $label = trim((string) $this->button_label);
        $url = trim((string) $this->button_url);

        if ($label === '' || $url === '') {
            return false;
        }

        if (str_starts_with($url, 'https://')) {
            return filter_var($url, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL) !== false;
        }

        return InternalLink::exists($url);
    }

    /**
     * Label periode untuk admin (F4A-R25), dihitung dengan waktu aplikasi: `Tayang`, `Terjadwal`, `Berakhir`,
     * atau `Nonaktif`.
     */
    public function scheduleLabel(): string
    {
        if (! $this->is_active) {
            return 'Nonaktif';
        }

        $now = now()->startOfSecond();

        if ($this->starts_at !== null && $this->starts_at->gt($now)) {
            return 'Terjadwal';
        }

        if ($this->ends_at !== null && $this->ends_at->lt($now)) {
            return 'Berakhir';
        }

        return 'Tayang';
    }

    /**
     * URL gambar banner (koleksi `image`), atau placeholder `banner.svg`. Muat `media` pada daftar.
     *
     * @return Attribute<string, never>
     */
    protected function imageUrl(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::get(fn (): string => $this->mediaUrl('image', 'full', 'images/placeholders/banner.svg'));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Database\Factories;

use App\Models\Page;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;
use LogicException;

/**
 * @extends Factory<Page>
 */
class PageFactory extends Factory
{
    /**
     * Halaman sistem dengan key acak yang belum terpakai (dipilih lewat closure, jadi tidak ada kueri bila tes
     * menimpa `key`), judul/subjudul/meta dari `Page::DEFAULTS`, tanpa isi. Untuk key tertentu, tes memakai
     * `InteractsWithContent::createPage()`.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function definition(): array
    {
        return [
            'key' => function (): string {
                $available = array_values(array_diff(Page::KEYS, Page::query()->pluck('key')->all()));

                if ($available === []) {
                    throw new LogicException('Seluruh 15 key halaman sudah terpakai.');
                }

                return fake()->randomElement($available);
            },
            'title' => fn (array $attributes): string => Page::DEFAULTS[$attributes['key']]['title'] ?? 'Halaman Contoh',
            'subtitle' => fn (array $attributes): ?string => Page::DEFAULTS[$attributes['key']]['subtitle'] ?? null,
            'body' => null,
            'meta_title' => null,
            'meta_description' => fn (array $attributes): ?string => Page::DEFAULTS[$attributes['key']]['meta_description'] ?? null,
            'is_system' => true,
            'updated_by' => null,
        ];
    }

    /** Halaman dengan isi rich text contoh. */
    public function withBody(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes): array => [
            'body' => '<h2>Bagian Contoh</h2><p>'.fake()->paragraph().'</p>',
        ]);
    }
}
```

```php
            'published_at' => now()->subDay(),

            'meta_description' => null,
        ];
    }

    /** Terbit kemarin (tayang). */
    public function published(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes): array => [
            'status' => ArticleStatus::Published,
            'published_at' => now()->subDay(),
        ]);
    }

    /** Draf tanpa tanggal terbit. */
    public function draft(): static
    {

            'status' => ArticleStatus::Draft,
            'published_at' => null,
        ]);
    }

    /** Terbit tetapi terjadwal dua hari lagi (belum tayang). */

    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes): array => [
            'status' => ArticleStatus::Published,
            'published_at' => now()->addDays(2),
        ]);
    }

    public function trashed(): static

            'deleted_at' => now(),
        ]);
```

### Task 3: Integrasi lintas modul (audit, `MediaPolicy`, gambar editor, slug soft delete, `InternalOrHttpsUrl`, `InternalLink`)

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Rules/InternalOrHttpsUrl.php`
- Modify: `app/Models/Concerns/HasUniqueSlug.php` (`slugTaken` sadar soft delete; import `SoftDeletes`)
- Modify: `app/Models/Concerns/SanitizesRichText.php` (`isBlankRichText` menjadi `public static`)
- Modify: `app/Observers/AuditObserver.php` (nama dari `name` → `title` → `question`, `Str::limit(…, 80)`; docblock)
- Modify: `app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php` (observer untuk 7 model; import)
- Modify: `lang/id/messages.php` (`entities` 7 kunci baru; `rules.internal_or_https_url`)
- Modify: `app/Policies/MediaPolicy.php` (5 pemetaan → `content.manage`; import dan docblock)
- Modify: `app/Services/Media/MediaService.php` (`EDITOR_REFERENCE_COLUMNS`)
- Modify: `app/Models/Concerns/HasMedia.php` (hook `deleting`: soft delete mempertahankan media; F4A-R32)
- Modify (tes): `tests/Feature/Auth/MediaPolicyTest.php` (provider `ownerCases` + tes `reorder` konten)
- Test: `tests/Feature/Content/ContentAuditTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Content/ContentSlugTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Content/BlankRichTextTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Content/BannerButtonTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Media/ContentEditorImagesTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Media/SoftDeleteMediaTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Support/InternalLinkTest.php`, `tests/Unit/Rules/InternalOrHttpsUrlTest.php`
- Tidak diubah: `app/Support/InternalLink.php` dan `Banner::hasUsableButton()` (dibuat Task 2; Task 3 hanya menambah tesnya); `HasMedia::mediaIn()` dan `mediaUrl()`.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: tujuh model dan factory Task 2; `InteractsWithContent`, `InteractsWithStaff`, `InteractsWithMedia`; `MediaService`, `ImageFixtures`; `AuditLog`; `Page::KEYS`.
- Produces:
  - `HasUniqueSlug::uniqueSlug()` menghitung baris soft delete (model ber-`SoftDeletes`): judul artikel yang sama dengan artikel terhapus mendapat `-2`, bukan galat UNIQUE (F4A-R7).
  - `SanitizesRichText::isBlankRichText(string $html): bool` = `public static`, perilaku tetap (dipakai `ArticleRequest`, Task 8).
  - `AuditObserver` mencatat `page.*`, `banner.*`, `article.*`, `article_category.*`, `gallery.*`, `faq.*`, `insurance_partner.*` dengan deskripsi berbahasa Indonesia (F4A-R8).
  - Kunci `lang/id/messages.php` `entities`: `page` "Halaman", `banner` "Banner", `article` "Artikel", `article_category` "Kategori artikel", `gallery` "Album galeri", `faq` "FAQ", `insurance_partner` "Mitra asuransi"; kunci `rules.internal_or_https_url`.
  - `MediaPolicy::manages()` memetakan `Page`, `Article`, `Banner`, `Gallery`, `InsurancePartner` ke `content.manage` (F4A-R9).
  - `MediaService::EDITOR_REFERENCE_COLUMNS` = `['clinics' => ['description'], 'pages' => ['body'], 'articles' => ['body']]`.
  - `App\Rules\InternalOrHttpsUrl` (`final class … implements ValidationRule`), pesan "Tautan harus berupa alamat internal (diawali /) atau URL https." (BR-124).

**Test IDs:** F4A-R32 (soft delete mempertahankan media), F4A-R33 (nama audit dari atribut mentah), SEK-08 (gambar editor `pages.body`/`articles.body` terikat dan tersanitasi), SEK-15 (hanya sisi pendukung), CRD-13 (soft delete artikel: audit `article.deleted`, media dipertahankan, slug tidak dipakai ulang), MED-07 (`media:prune` melewati gambar yang dirujuk `pages.body`/`articles.body` dan media artikel terhapus), D-55 (`EDITOR_REFERENCE_COLUMNS`), D-42 (`MediaPolicy` per pemilik), BR-124 (`InternalOrHttpsUrl`), Review Focus F.2 (isi kosong secara visual) dan F.5 (slug artikel terhapus tidak dipakai ulang).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **`HasUniqueSlug::slugTaken`** (`app/Models/Concerns/HasUniqueSlug.php:57-63`) saat ini memakai `static::query()`, yang menyembunyikan baris soft delete lewat global scope; indeks `articles_slug_unique` mencakup baris terhapus (Task 1), sehingga tanpa perubahan ini judul yang sama dengan artikel terhapus menghasilkan `QueryException`. `class_uses_recursive(static::class)` dipakai untuk mendeteksi `SoftDeletes` (trait diletakkan pada model, bukan pada trait slug).
- **`SanitizesRichText::isBlankRichText`** (`app/Models/Concerns/SanitizesRichText.php:75`) `private static`; dipanggil di dalam trait sebagai `self::isBlankRichText`, yang tetap berfungsi setelah menjadi `public static`. Method itu bisa dipanggil dari model mana pun yang memakai trait, mis. `Article::isBlankRichText($html)`.
- **`HasMedia::bootHasMedia`** (`app/Models/Concerns/HasMedia.php:25-30`, hook `deleting` di baris 27-29) menghapus media pada event `deleting`, yang juga dipicu soft delete; 09 §6.3 menetapkan media artikel terhapus dipertahankan. F4A-R32: media dihapus hanya bila `! method_exists($model, 'isForceDeleting') || $model->isForceDeleting()`. Hanya `Article` yang ber-`SoftDeletes`.
- **`AuditObserver`** (`app/Observers/AuditObserver.php:50-65`) (F4A-R33: nama dibaca dari `getAttributes()` dengan `array_key_exists`) mengambil nama lewat `$model->getAttribute('name')`. Pada model hasil query (event `updated`/`deleted`) mode ketat melempar `MissingAttributeException` bila kolomnya tidak dimiliki model (mis. `name` pada `Banner`). Karena itu nama dibaca dari `$model->getAttributes()` (array mentah). Kunci aksi memakai `Str::snake(class_basename($model))`, yaitu `article_category` dan `insurance_partner`.
- **Event `deleted` juga dipicu soft delete**, jadi `Article::delete()` menulis `article.deleted` tanpa kode tambahan; `restored` dan `forceDeleted` tidak diobservasi.
- **Audit dan `AuditLogger::NAME_ONLY`** (`app/Services/Audit/AuditLogger.php:49`): kolom `body`/`description` hanya dicatat `[konten diubah]`, sehingga `pages.body` dan `articles.body` tidak membocorkan isi ke `audit_logs`.
- **`MediaPolicy`** (`app/Policies/MediaPolicy.php:63-67`): `match ($media->model_type)` menolak tipe lain. Pemetaan baru hanya menambah satu arm. `canUseEditor` (unggah gambar editor tanpa pemilik) sudah mencakup `content.manage`.
- **`EDITOR_REFERENCE_COLUMNS`** (`app/Services/Media/MediaService.php:64-66`) dipakai `isReferencedInRichText()`, yang membaca tabel mentah (`DB::table`), sehingga baris soft delete ikut terhitung. `ownerlessRows()` juga memeriksa keberadaan pemilik lewat tabel mentah, sehingga media artikel yang di-soft-delete (`model_id` tetap terisi) tidak dianggap yatim (09 §6.3).
- **Lang.** `NoHtml` memakai `$fail('messages.rules.no_html')->translate()`; `InternalOrHttpsUrl` meniru pola itu dengan kunci `messages.rules.internal_or_https_url` yang tidak memuat `:attribute`.
- **Pengerasan tambahan.** `InternalOrHttpsUrl` dan `InternalLink` juga menolak backslash, spasi, dan karakter kontrol pada path internal, karena browser memperlakukan `/\host` sebagai `//host`. Perilaku ini adalah himpunan bagian dari aturan kerangka (menolak lebih banyak, tidak lebih sedikit).
- **Tes `InternalLink` dan `Banner::hasUsableButton`** bergantung pada route yang ada saat Task 3 (`/`, `/layanan`, `/dokter`, `/jadwal-dokter`). Route pasien `/pasien/pendaftaran/baru` belum ada sampai fase 6; tes memeriksanya hanya bila `Route::has('patient.appointments.create')` bernilai salah, sehingga tidak patah saat route itu muncul.
- Jumlah tes ±110.

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit\Rules;

use App\Rules\InternalOrHttpsUrl;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * BR-124 / 12 §3.1: tautan tombol banner hanya path internal (diawali satu /) atau URL https.
 */
class InternalOrHttpsUrlTest extends TestCase
{
    private const MESSAGE = 'Tautan harus berupa alamat internal (diawali /) atau URL https.';

    /** @return array<string, array{0: mixed}> */
    public static function acceptedValues(): array
    {
        return [
            'path internal' => ['/dokter'],
            'path internal dengan query' => ['/jadwal-dokter?poli=x'],
            'path internal dengan fragmen' => ['/layanan/poliklinik-anak#jadwal'],
            'beranda' => ['/'],
            'path dengan segmen berparameter' => ['/artikel/judul-artikel-contoh'],
            'https' => ['https://contoh.test/a'],
            'https tanpa path' => ['https://contoh.test'],
            'https dengan query' => ['https://contoh.test/a?b=1&c=2'],
        ];
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{0: mixed}> */
    public static function rejectedValues(): array
    {
        return [
            'protokol relatif' => ['//evil.test'],
            'protokol relatif dengan path' => ['//evil.test/dokter'],
            'backslash setelah slash' => ['/\\evil.test'],
            'spasi di dalam path' => ['/dokter dua'],
            'baris baru di path' => ["/dokter\n/x"],
            'diawali spasi' => [' /dokter'],
            'http biasa' => ['http://x.test'],
            'javascript' => ['javascript:alert(1)'],
            'javascript berhuruf besar' => ['JavaScript:alert(1)'],
            'data uri' => ['data:text/html,x'],
            'tanpa slash' => ['dokter'],
            'https tanpa host' => ['https://'],
            'https dengan spasi pada host' => ['https://exa mple.test'],
            'ftp' => ['ftp://x.test'],
            'angka' => [123],
            'larik' => [['/dokter']],
            'boolean' => [true],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('acceptedValues')]
    public function test_accepts_internal_paths_and_https_urls(mixed $value): void
    {
        $validator = Validator::make(['button_url' => $value], ['button_url' => [new InternalOrHttpsUrl]]);

        $this->assertTrue($validator->passes(), 'Seharusnya lolos: '.json_encode($value));
    }

    #[DataProvider('rejectedValues')]
    public function test_rejects_everything_else_with_the_standard_message(mixed $value): void
    {
        $validator = Validator::make(['button_url' => $value], ['button_url' => [new InternalOrHttpsUrl]]);

        $this->assertTrue($validator->fails(), 'Seharusnya ditolak: '.json_encode($value));
        $this->assertSame(self::MESSAGE, $validator->errors()->first('button_url'));
    }

    public function test_an_empty_value_is_left_to_nullable_and_required(): void
    {
        $nullable = Validator::make(['button_url' => ''], ['button_url' => ['nullable', new InternalOrHttpsUrl]]);
        $null = Validator::make(['button_url' => null], ['button_url' => ['nullable', new InternalOrHttpsUrl]]);
        $required = Validator::make(['button_url' => ''], ['button_url' => ['required', new InternalOrHttpsUrl]]);

        $this->assertTrue($nullable->passes());
        $this->assertTrue($null->passes());
        $this->assertTrue($required->fails());
        $this->assertSame([], array_filter(
            $required->errors()->get('button_url'),
            fn (string $message): bool => $message === self::MESSAGE,
        ), 'Nilai kosong ditolak oleh required, bukan oleh aturan ini.');
    }

    public function test_the_message_does_not_depend_on_the_attribute_label(): void
    {
        $validator = Validator::make(
            ['link' => 'dokter'],
            ['link' => [new InternalOrHttpsUrl]],
            [],
            ['link' => 'Tautan tombol'],
        );

        $this->assertSame(self::MESSAGE, $validator->errors()->first('link'));
    }
}
```

```php
        ];
    }

            'segmen berlebih' => ['/dokter/a/b/c'],
            'kosong' => [''],
            'tanpa slash awal' => ['dokter'],
            'protokol relatif' => ['//x'],
            'protokol relatif dengan path' => ['//x.test/dokter'],
            'url penuh' => ['https://x.test'],
            'url penuh ke host sendiri' => ['https://localhost/dokter'],
            'javascript' => ['javascript:alert(1)'],
            'backslash' => ['/\\dokter'],
            'spasi' => ['/dokter dua'],
            'karakter kontrol' => ["/dokter\x00"],
            'hanya query' => ['?q=a'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('existingPaths')]
    public function test_a_path_matching_a_registered_get_route_exists(string $path): void
    {
        $this->assertTrue(InternalLink::exists($path));
    }

    #[DataProvider('missingPaths')]
    public function test_anything_else_does_not_exist(string $path): void
    {
        $this->assertFalse(InternalLink::exists($path));
    }

    public function test_the_patient_registration_path_is_missing_until_its_route_exists(): void
    {
        if (Route::has('patient.appointments.create')) {
            $this->markTestSkipped('Route pendaftaran pasien sudah ada (fase 6): tautan banner #2 kini valid.');
        }

        $this->assertFalse(InternalLink::exists('/pasien/pendaftaran/baru'));
    }

    public function test_a_route_registered_later_is_recognised_including_parameters(): void
    {
        $this->assertFalse(InternalLink::exists('/rute-sementara/12'));

        Route::get('/rute-sementara/{id}', fn () => 'ok');

        $this->assertTrue(InternalLink::exists('/rute-sementara/12'));
        $this->assertTrue(InternalLink::exists('/rute-sementara/12?x=1'));
    }

    public function test_a_route_that_only_answers_other_methods_does_not_count(): void
    {
        Route::post('/hanya-post', fn () => 'ok');

        $this->assertFalse(InternalLink::exists('/hanya-post'));
    }
}
```

```php
            'https' => ['Situs Mitra', 'https://contoh.test/a', true],
            'label dengan spasi tepi' => ['  Cari Dokter  ', '  /dokter  ', true],
            'path internal yang tidak ada' => ['Halaman', '/tidak-ada', false],
            'http ditolak' => ['Situs', 'http://contoh.test', false],
            'javascript ditolak' => ['Klik', 'javascript:alert(1)', false],
            'protokol relatif ditolak' => ['Klik', '//evil.test', false],
            'data uri ditolak' => ['Klik', 'data:text/html,x', false],
            'https tanpa host' => ['Klik', 'https://', false],
            'label null' => [null, '/dokter', false],
            'label kosong' => ['', '/dokter', false],
            'label hanya spasi' => ['   ', '/dokter', false],
            'url null' => ['Cari Dokter', null, false],
            'url kosong' => ['Cari Dokter', '', false],
            'url hanya spasi' => ['Cari Dokter', '   ', false],
            'keduanya kosong' => [null, null, false],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('buttons')]
    public function test_has_usable_button(?string $label, ?string $url, bool $expected): void
    {
        $banner = new Banner(['title' => 'Banner Uji', 'button_label' => $label, 'button_url' => $url]);

        $this->assertSame($expected, $banner->hasUsableButton());
    }

    public function test_the_seeded_registration_banner_has_no_button_until_the_patient_route_exists(): void
    {
        if (Route::has('patient.appointments.create')) {
            $this->markTestSkipped('Route pendaftaran pasien sudah ada (fase 6): tombol banner #2 kini tampil.');
        }

        $banner = new Banner(['title' => 'Daftar Kunjungan Lebih Mudah', 'button_label' => 'Daftar Kunjungan', 'button_url' => '/pasien/pendaftaran/baru']);

        $this->assertFalse($banner->hasUsableButton());
    }

    public function test_a_stored_banner_gives_the_same_answer_as_an_unsaved_one(): void
    {
        $banner = Banner::query()->create(['title' => 'Tersimpan', 'button_label' => 'Cari Dokter', 'button_url' => '/dokter']);

        $this->assertTrue(Banner::query()->findOrFail($banner->id)->hasUsableButton());
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Content;

use App\Models\Article;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Page;
use App\Services\Content\HtmlSanitizer;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F4A-R11 / Review Focus F.2: `SanitizesRichText::isBlankRichText()` dapat dipanggil publik (ArticleRequest,
 * Task 8) dan mengenali isi yang kosong secara visual.
 */
class BlankRichTextTest extends TestCase
{
    /** @return array<string, array{0: string, 1: bool}> */
    public static function samples(): array
    {
        return [
            'string kosong' => ['', true],
            'paragraf quill kosong' => ['<p><br></p>', true],
            'beberapa paragraf kosong' => ['<p><br></p><p> </p>', true],
            'spasi tak terputus sebagai entitas' => ['<p>&nbsp;</p>', true],
            'spasi tak terputus literal' => ["<p>\u{00A0}</p>", true],
            'hanya spasi' => ['   ', true],
            'heading kosong' => ['<h2></h2>', true],
            'ada teks' => ['<p>Halo</p>', false],
            'teks di antara tag kosong' => ['<p><br></p><p>Isi</p>', false],
            'gambar saja' => ['<img src="/storage/editor/2026/10/a.jpg" alt="a">', false],
            'gambar dalam paragraf' => ['<p><img src="/storage/editor/2026/10/a.jpg" alt="a"></p>', false],
            'angka nol' => ['<p>0</p>', false],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('samples')]
    public function test_blank_detection_is_public_and_static_on_every_rich_text_model(string $html, bool $blank): void
    {
        $this->assertSame($blank, Article::isBlankRichText($html));
        $this->assertSame($blank, Page::isBlankRichText($html));
        $this->assertSame($blank, Clinic::isBlankRichText($html));
    }

    public function test_it_is_meant_to_run_on_the_sanitized_html(): void
    {
        $sanitizer = app(HtmlSanitizer::class);

        $this->assertTrue(Article::isBlankRichText($sanitizer->clean('<script>alert(1)</script>')));
        $this->assertTrue(Article::isBlankRichText($sanitizer->clean('<p style="color:red"><br></p>')));
        $this->assertTrue(Article::isBlankRichText($sanitizer->clean('<iframe src="https://evil.test"></iframe>')));
        $this->assertFalse(Article::isBlankRichText($sanitizer->clean('<script>x</script><p>Isi artikel</p>')));
        $this->assertTrue(Article::isBlankRichText($sanitizer->clean('<img src="https://evil.test/x.png" alt="x">')), 'Gambar luar dibuang sanitizer sehingga isi kosong.');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Content;

use App\Models\Article;
use App\Models\ArticleCategory;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F4A-R7 / Review Focus F.5: slug artikel yang sudah dihapus (soft delete) tidak dipakai ulang.
 */
class ContentSlugTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_a_new_article_with_the_same_title_as_a_deleted_one_gets_a_numbered_slug(): void
    {
        $old = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Pola Tidur yang Baik']);
        $old->delete();

        $this->assertSoftDeleted('articles', ['id' => $old->id]);

        $new = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Pola Tidur yang Baik']);

        $this->assertSame('pola-tidur-yang-baik', $old->slug);
        $this->assertSame('pola-tidur-yang-baik-2', $new->slug);
    }

    public function test_numbering_continues_across_deleted_and_live_articles(): void
    {
        $first = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Judul Sama']);
        $second = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Judul Sama']);
        $first->delete();
        $third = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Judul Sama']);
        $second->delete();
        $fourth = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Judul Sama']);

        $this->assertSame(
            ['judul-sama', 'judul-sama-2', 'judul-sama-3', 'judul-sama-4'],
            [$first->slug, $second->slug, $third->slug, $fourth->slug],
        );
        $this->assertSame(4, Article::withTrashed()->count());
    }

    public function test_a_force_deleted_slug_can_be_reused(): void
    {
        $old = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Dihapus Permanen']);
        $old->forceDelete();

        $new = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Dihapus Permanen']);

        $this->assertSame('dihapus-permanen', $new->slug);
        $this->assertSame(1, Article::withTrashed()->count());
    }

    public function test_unique_slug_with_ignore_id_ignores_the_row_itself_even_when_deleted(): void
    {
        $article = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Sendiri']);
        $article->delete();

        $this->assertSame('sendiri-2', Article::uniqueSlug('Sendiri'));
        $this->assertSame('sendiri', Article::uniqueSlug('Sendiri', $article->id));
    }

    public function test_the_slug_of_a_deleted_article_does_not_change_when_restored_or_when_the_title_changes(): void
    {
        $article = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Awal']);
        $article->delete();
        $article->restore();
        $article->update(['title' => 'Akhir']);

        $this->assertSame('awal', $article->fresh()->slug);
    }

    public function test_an_explicit_slug_equal_to_a_deleted_one_is_left_to_the_database(): void
    {
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Satu', 'slug' => 'slug-tetap'])->delete();

        $this->expectException(QueryException::class);

        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Dua', 'slug' => 'slug-tetap']);
    }

    public function test_models_without_soft_deletes_reuse_slugs_after_a_hard_delete(): void
    {
        $category = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Gizi']);
        $category->delete();

        $this->assertSame('gizi', ArticleCategory::uniqueSlug('Gizi'));
        $this->assertSame('gizi', $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Gizi'])->slug);

        $clinic = Clinic::factory()->create(['name' => 'Poliklinik Anak']);
        $this->assertSame('poliklinik-anak-2', Clinic::uniqueSlug('Poliklinik Anak'));
        $this->assertSame('poliklinik-anak', Clinic::uniqueSlug('Poliklinik Anak', $clinic->id));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Content;

use App\Enums\ActorType;
use App\Models\Article;
use App\Models\ArticleCategory;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\Banner;
use App\Models\Gallery;
use App\Models\InsurancePartner;
use App\Models\Page;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F4A-R8 / 12 §8.3: model konten fase 4a diobservasi AuditObserver dengan deskripsi berbahasa Indonesia.
 */
class ContentAuditTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private User $admin;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');
        $this->actingAs($this->admin);
    }

    private function log(string $action): AuditLog
    {
        return AuditLog::query()->where('action', $action)->latest('id')->firstOrFail();
    }

    public function test_entity_labels_exist_for_all_seven_models(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('Halaman', __('messages.entities.page'));
        $this->assertSame('Banner', __('messages.entities.banner'));
        $this->assertSame('Artikel', __('messages.entities.article'));
        $this->assertSame('Kategori artikel', __('messages.entities.article_category'));
        $this->assertSame('Album galeri', __('messages.entities.gallery'));
        $this->assertSame('FAQ', __('messages.entities.faq'));
        $this->assertSame('Mitra asuransi', __('messages.entities.insurance_partner'));
        $this->assertSame('Banner berhasil ditambahkan.', __('messages.created', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.banner')]));
        $this->assertSame('Artikel berhasil dihapus.', __('messages.deleted', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.article')]));
    }

    public function test_creating_each_model_writes_its_own_action(): void
    {
        $this->createPage('about');
        $this->createBanner();
        $this->createArticle();
        $this->createArticleCategory();
        $this->createGallery();
        $this->createFaq();
        $this->createInsurancePartner();

        $actions = AuditLog::query()->pluck('action')->all();
        sort($actions);

        $this->assertSame([
            'article.created',
            'article_category.created',
            'banner.created',
            'faq.created',
            'gallery.created',
            'insurance_partner.created',
            'page.created',
        ], $actions);
    }

    public function test_banner_lifecycle(): void
    {
        $banner = $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Promo']);

        $created = $this->log('banner.created');
        $this->assertSame('Banner "Promo" ditambahkan.', $created->description);
        $this->assertSame(ActorType::Staff, $created->actor_type);
        $this->assertSame($this->admin->id, (int) $created->user_id);
        $this->assertSame(Banner::class, $created->auditable_type);
        $this->assertSame($banner->id, (int) $created->auditable_id);
        $this->assertNull($created->old_values);
        $this->assertSame('Promo', $created->new_values['title']);

        AuditLog::query()->delete();
        $banner->update(['is_active' => false]);

        $updated = $this->log('banner.updated');
        $this->assertSame('Banner "Promo" diperbarui.', $updated->description);
        $this->assertEquals(['is_active' => 1], $updated->old_values);
        $this->assertEquals(['is_active' => 0], $updated->new_values);

        AuditLog::query()->delete();
        $banner->delete();

        $deleted = $this->log('banner.deleted');
        $this->assertSame('Banner "Promo" dihapus.', $deleted->description);
        $this->assertSame('Promo', $deleted->old_values['title']);
        $this->assertNull($deleted->new_values);
    }

    public function test_a_banner_loaded_from_the_database_can_be_audited_without_a_name_column(): void
    {
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Dimuat Ulang']);
        AuditLog::query()->delete();

        $loaded = Banner::query()->firstOrFail();
        $loaded->update(['subtitle' => 'Baru']);
        $loaded->delete();

        $this->assertSame('Banner "Dimuat Ulang" diperbarui.', $this->log('banner.updated')->description);
        $this->assertSame('Banner "Dimuat Ulang" dihapus.', $this->log('banner.deleted')->description);
    }

    public function test_faq_uses_the_question_as_its_name(): void
    {
        $faq = $this->createFaq(['question' => 'Bagaimana cara mendaftar?']);

        $this->assertSame('FAQ "Bagaimana cara mendaftar?" ditambahkan.', $this->log('faq.created')->description);

        $faq->delete();

        $this->assertSame('FAQ "Bagaimana cara mendaftar?" dihapus.', $this->log('faq.deleted')->description);
    }

    public function test_long_names_are_limited_to_eighty_characters(): void
    {
        $title = str_repeat('Promo Panjang ', 8);
        $this->createBanner(['title' => $title]);

        $expected = Str::limit($title, 80);

        $this->assertSame(83, strlen($expected));
        $this->assertSame('Banner "'.$expected.'" ditambahkan.', $this->log('banner.created')->description);

        $question = 'Bagaimana cara mendaftar kunjungan rawat jalan secara online dengan akun saya yang baru dibuat kemarin sore?';
        $this->createFaq(['question' => $question]);

        $this->assertSame('FAQ "'.Str::limit($question, 80).'" ditambahkan.', $this->log('faq.created')->description);
    }

    public function test_article_category_actions_and_description(): void
    {
        $category = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Gizi']);

        $this->assertSame('Kategori artikel "Gizi" ditambahkan.', $this->log('article_category.created')->description);

        $category->update(['description' => 'Informasi gizi.']);

        $this->assertSame('Kategori artikel "Gizi" diperbarui.', $this->log('article_category.updated')->description);

        $category->delete();

        $this->assertSame('Kategori artikel "Gizi" dihapus.', $this->log('article_category.deleted')->description);
        $this->assertSame(ArticleCategory::class, $this->log('article_category.deleted')->auditable_type);
    }

    public function test_article_lifecycle_including_soft_delete(): void
    {
        $article = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Cara Mencuci Tangan yang Benar']);

        $this->assertSame('Artikel "Cara Mencuci Tangan yang Benar" ditambahkan.', $this->log('article.created')->description);

        AuditLog::query()->delete();
        $article->update(['status' => 'draft']);

        $updated = $this->log('article.updated');
        $this->assertSame('Artikel "Cara Mencuci Tangan yang Benar" diperbarui.', $updated->description);
        $this->assertSame('draft', $updated->new_values['status']);
        $this->assertSame('published', $updated->old_values['status']);

        AuditLog::query()->delete();
        $article->delete();

        $deleted = $this->log('article.deleted');
        $this->assertSame('Artikel "Cara Mencuci Tangan yang Benar" dihapus.', $deleted->description);
        $this->assertSame(Article::class, $deleted->auditable_type);
        $this->assertSoftDeleted('articles', ['id' => $article->id]);
        $this->assertSame(1, AuditLog::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_article_body_is_logged_as_content_changed_only(): void
    {
        $article = $this->createArticle(['body' => '<p>Isi lama artikel ini cukup panjang.</p>']);
        AuditLog::query()->delete();

        $article->update(['body' => '<p>Isi baru yang rahasia.</p>']);

        $log = $this->log('article.updated');

        $this->assertSame(['body' => '[konten diubah]'], $log->new_values);
        $this->assertSame(['body' => '[konten diubah]'], $log->old_values);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('rahasia', (string) json_encode($log->new_values));
    }

    public function test_restoring_an_article_is_not_audited(): void
    {
        $article = $this->createArticle();
        $article->delete();
        AuditLog::query()->delete();

        $article->restore();

        $this->assertSame(0, AuditLog::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_gallery_and_insurance_partner_descriptions(): void
    {
        $gallery = $this->createGallery(['title' => 'Lobi dan Area Pendaftaran (Foto Contoh)']);
        $partner = $this->createInsurancePartner(['name' => 'Asuransi Contoh Sehat']);

        $this->assertSame('Album galeri "Lobi dan Area Pendaftaran (Foto Contoh)" ditambahkan.', $this->log('gallery.created')->description);
        $this->assertSame('Mitra asuransi "Asuransi Contoh Sehat" ditambahkan.', $this->log('insurance_partner.created')->description);

        $gallery->update(['is_published' => false]);
        $partner->update(['is_active' => false]);

        $this->assertSame('Album galeri "Lobi dan Area Pendaftaran (Foto Contoh)" diperbarui.', $this->log('gallery.updated')->description);
        $this->assertSame('Mitra asuransi "Asuransi Contoh Sehat" diperbarui.', $this->log('insurance_partner.updated')->description);

        $gallery->delete();
        $partner->delete();

        $this->assertSame('Album galeri "Lobi dan Area Pendaftaran (Foto Contoh)" dihapus.', $this->log('gallery.deleted')->description);
        $this->assertSame('Mitra asuransi "Asuransi Contoh Sehat" dihapus.', $this->log('insurance_partner.deleted')->description);
        $this->assertSame(Gallery::class, $this->log('gallery.deleted')->auditable_type);
        $this->assertSame(InsurancePartner::class, $this->log('insurance_partner.deleted')->auditable_type);
    }

    public function test_page_updates_are_audited_with_the_new_title_and_body_only_marked(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('about', ['body' => '<p>Isi lama.</p>']);

        $this->assertSame('Halaman "Profil Rumah Sakit" ditambahkan.', $this->log('page.created')->description);

        AuditLog::query()->delete();
        $page->update(['title' => 'Tentang Kami', 'body' => '<p>Isi baru.</p>', 'updated_by' => $this->admin->id]);

        $log = $this->log('page.updated');

        $this->assertSame('Halaman "Tentang Kami" diperbarui.', $log->description);
        $this->assertSame('Tentang Kami', $log->new_values['title']);
        $this->assertSame('Profil Rumah Sakit', $log->old_values['title']);
        $this->assertSame('[konten diubah]', $log->new_values['body']);
        $this->assertSame(Page::class, $log->auditable_type);
    }

    public function test_a_save_without_changes_writes_nothing(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('faq');
        $banner = $this->createBanner();
        AuditLog::query()->delete();

        $page->save();
        $banner->save();
        $banner->update(['title' => $banner->title]);

        $this->assertSame(0, AuditLog::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_without_a_logged_in_staff_the_actor_is_the_system(): void
    {
        auth()->forgetGuards();

        $this->createFaq(['question' => 'Tanpa login?']);

        $log = $this->log('faq.created');

        $this->assertSame(ActorType::System, $log->actor_type);
        $this->assertNull($log->user_id);
        $this->assertSame('FAQ "Tanpa login?" ditambahkan.', $log->description);
    }

    public function test_existing_models_keep_using_their_name(): void
    {
        $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Jantung']);
        $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Anak']);

        $this->assertSame('Poliklinik "Poliklinik Jantung" ditambahkan.', $this->log('clinic.created')->description);
        $this->assertSame('Spesialisasi "Anak" ditambahkan.', $this->log('specialty.created')->description);
    }
}
```
