<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Media;

use App\Models\Article;
use App\Models\Media;
use App\Models\Page;
use App\Services\Media\MediaService;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Tests\Support\ImageFixtures;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * D-55 / F4A-R9 (08 §5.2): gambar editor `pages.body` dan `articles.body` terikat ke pemilik saat disimpan,
 * dilepas bila tidak dirujuk lagi, dan `media:prune` tidak menghapus yang masih dipakai.
 */
class ContentEditorImagesTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private MediaService $service;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Storage::fake('public');
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);

        $this->service = app(MediaService::class);
    }

    private function editorImage(): Media
    {
        return $this->service->store(ImageFixtures::jpeg(400, 300), 'editor', null, ['alt_text' => 'Gambar editor']);
    }

    private function html(Media ...$images): string
    {
        $imgs = array_map(fn (Media $media): string => '<img src="/storage/'.$media->directory.'/'.$media->file_name.'" alt="x">', $images);

        return '<p>Isi halaman yang cukup panjang '.implode(' ', $imgs).'</p>';
    }

    private function age(Media $media, int $hours): void
    {
        $at = now()->subHours($hours);
        DB::table('media')->where('id', $media->id)->update(['created_at' => $at, 'updated_at' => $at]);
    }

    private function assertFilesExist(Media $media): void
    {
        Storage::disk('public')->assertExists($media->directory.'/'.$media->file_name);
    }

    private function assertFilesMissing(Media $media): void
    {
        Storage::disk('public')->assertMissing($media->directory.'/'.$media->file_name);
    }

    public function test_the_reference_columns_include_pages_and_articles(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(
            ['clinics' => ['description'], 'pages' => ['body'], 'articles' => ['body']],
            MediaService::EDITOR_REFERENCE_COLUMNS,
        );
    }

    public function test_saving_a_page_binds_the_referenced_editor_image_to_it(): void
    {
        $image = $this->editorImage();
        $other = $this->editorImage();

        $page = $this->createPage('about', ['body' => $this->html($image)]);

        $image->refresh();
        $this->assertSame(Page::class, $image->model_type);
        $this->assertSame($page->id, $image->model_id);
        $this->assertNull($other->fresh()->model_id);
        $this->assertCount(1, Page::query()->with('media')->findOrFail($page->id)->mediaIn('editor'));
    }

    public function test_saving_an_article_binds_the_referenced_editor_image_to_it(): void
    {
        $image = $this->editorImage();

        $article = $this->createArticle(['body' => $this->html($image)]);

        $image->refresh();
        $this->assertSame(Article::class, $image->model_type);
        $this->assertSame($article->id, $image->model_id);
    }

    public function test_an_image_owned_by_a_page_is_not_taken_over_by_an_article(): void
    {
        $image = $this->editorImage();
        $page = $this->createPage('about', ['body' => $this->html($image)]);

        $this->createArticle(['body' => $this->html($image)]);

        $this->assertSame(Page::class, $image->fresh()->model_type);
        $this->assertSame($page->id, $image->fresh()->model_id);
    }

    public function test_removing_the_image_from_the_page_body_releases_it(): void
    {
        $image = $this->editorImage();
        $page = $this->createPage('vision-mission', ['body' => $this->html($image)]);
        $this->age($image, 48);

        $page->update(['body' => '<p>Tanpa gambar lagi.</p>']);

        $image->refresh();
        $this->assertNull($image->model_type);
        $this->assertNull($image->model_id);
        $this->assertTrue($image->updated_at->greaterThan(now()->subMinute()));
    }

    public function test_removing_the_image_from_the_article_body_releases_it(): void
    {
        $image = $this->editorImage();
        $article = $this->createArticle(['body' => $this->html($image)]);

        $article->update(['body' => '<p>Tanpa gambar lagi dan cukup panjang untuk uji.</p>']);

        $this->assertNull($image->fresh()->model_id);
    }

    public function test_updating_other_attributes_does_not_release_the_image(): void
    {
        $image = $this->editorImage();
        $page = $this->createPage('about', ['body' => $this->html($image)]);

        $page->update(['title' => 'Judul Baru']);

        $this->assertSame($page->id, $image->fresh()->model_id);
    }

    public function test_prune_keeps_bound_images_and_removes_released_and_never_saved_ones(): void
    {
        $bound = $this->editorImage();
        $released = $this->editorImage();
        $neverSaved = $this->editorImage();
        $page = $this->createPage('about', ['body' => $this->html($bound, $released)]);
        $page->update(['body' => $this->html($bound)]);

        $this->travel(25)->hours();
        $this->age($neverSaved, 25);
        $this->age($released, 25);

        $report = $this->service->prune();

        $this->assertSame(2, $report->orphanRows);
        $this->assertNotNull($bound->fresh());
        $this->assertFilesExist($bound);
        $this->assertNull($released->fresh());
        $this->assertFilesMissing($released);
        $this->assertNull($neverSaved->fresh());
        $this->assertFilesMissing($neverSaved);
    }

    public function test_prune_skips_ownerless_images_still_referenced_by_a_page_or_an_article_body(): void
    {
        $inPage = $this->editorImage();
        $inArticle = $this->editorImage();
        $unreferenced = $this->editorImage();

        // Baris lama sebelum pengikatan diterapkan: pemilik NULL walau dirujuk (jalur yang melewati event model).
        $this->createPage('about')->forceFill(['body' => $this->html($inPage)])->saveQuietly();
        $this->createArticle()->forceFill(['body' => $this->html($inArticle)])->saveQuietly();

        foreach ([$inPage, $inArticle, $unreferenced] as $media) {
            $this->age($media, 30);
        }

        DB::table('media')->whereIn('id', [$inPage->id, $inArticle->id])->update(['model_type' => null, 'model_id' => null]);

        $report = $this->service->prune();

        $this->assertSame(1, $report->orphanRows);
        $this->assertNotNull($inPage->fresh());
        $this->assertNotNull($inArticle->fresh());
        $this->assertNull($unreferenced->fresh());
        $this->assertFilesExist($inPage);
        $this->assertFilesExist($inArticle);
        $this->assertFilesMissing($unreferenced);
    }

    public function test_prune_also_counts_references_inside_soft_deleted_articles(): void
    {
        $image = $this->editorImage();
        $article = $this->createArticle()->forceFill(['body' => $this->html($image)]);
        $article->saveQuietly();
        $article->delete();
        $this->age($image, 30);

        $this->assertSame(0, $this->service->prune()->orphanRows);
        $this->assertNotNull($image->fresh());
    }

    public function test_soft_deleting_an_article_keeps_its_editor_images_and_cover_and_prune_leaves_them(): void
    {
        $editor = $this->editorImage();
        $article = Article::factory()->withCover()->create(['body' => $this->html($editor)]);
        $cover = Media::query()->where('model_type', Article::class)->where('collection', 'cover')->firstOrFail();

        $article->delete();
        $this->travel(48)->hours();

        $report = $this->service->prune();

        $this->assertSame(0, $report->orphanRows);
        $this->assertSame($article->id, $editor->fresh()->model_id);
        $this->assertNotNull($cover->fresh());
        $this->assertFilesExist($editor);
        $this->assertFilesExist($cover);
    }

    public function test_force_deleting_an_article_deletes_its_editor_images_after_commit(): void
    {
        $image = $this->editorImage();
        $article = $this->createArticle(['body' => $this->html($image)]);

        $this->assertFilesExist($image);

        $article->forceDelete();

        $this->assertNull($image->fresh());
        $this->assertFilesMissing($image);
    }
}

- [ ] **Step 9: Tulis tes yang gagal (tool Write) `tests/Feature/Media/SoftDeleteMediaTest.php` (F4A-R32)**

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Media;

use App\Models\Article;
use App\Models\Media;
use App\Services\Media\MediaService;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Tests\Support\ImageFixtures;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F4A-R32: soft delete tidak menghapus media pemilik; hapus permanen atau model tanpa soft delete menghapusnya.
 */
class SoftDeleteMediaTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Storage::fake('public');
    }

    private function coverOf(Article $article): Media
    {
        return Media::query()->where('model_type', Article::class)->where('model_id', $article->id)->where('collection', 'cover')->firstOrFail();
    }

    public function test_soft_deleting_an_article_keeps_the_media_row_and_files(): void
    {
        $article = Article::factory()->withCover()->create();
        $media = $this->coverOf($article);
        $path = $media->directory.'/'.$media->file_name;

        $article->delete();

        $this->assertSoftDeleted('articles', ['id' => $article->id]);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('media', ['id' => $media->id, 'model_id' => $article->id]);
        Storage::disk('public')->assertExists($path);
        Storage::disk('public')->assertExists($media->thumb_path);
    }

    public function test_force_deleting_an_article_removes_the_media_row_and_files(): void
    {
        $article = Article::factory()->withCover()->create();
        $media = $this->coverOf($article);
        $path = $media->directory.'/'.$media->file_name;

        $article->delete();
        $article->forceDelete();

        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('articles', ['id' => $article->id]);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('media', ['id' => $media->id]);
        Storage::disk('public')->assertMissing($path);
        Storage::disk('public')->assertMissing($media->thumb_path);
    }

    public function test_restoring_an_article_keeps_its_cover(): void
    {
        $article = Article::factory()->withCover()->create();
        $article->delete();
        $article->restore();

        $this->assertSame(1, Article::query()->with('media')->findOrFail($article->id)->mediaIn('cover')->count());
    }

    public function test_models_without_soft_deletes_still_lose_their_media_on_delete(): void
    {
        $banner = $this->createBanner();
        $media = app(MediaService::class)->store(ImageFixtures::jpeg(1600, 600), 'image', $banner, ['alt_text' => 'Banner']);
        $path = $media->directory.'/'.$media->file_name;

        $banner->delete();

        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('media', ['id' => $media->id]);
        Storage::disk('public')->assertMissing($path);
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 12: Implementasi `app/Rules/InternalOrHttpsUrl.php` (tool Write)**

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Rules;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\ValidationRule;

/**
 * Tautan tombol banner (BR-124, 12 §3.1): path internal (diawali satu `/`, bukan `//`) atau URL `https://`
 * yang lolos FILTER_VALIDATE_URL. Skema lain (`http:`, `javascript:`, `data:`) ditolak. Path internal juga
 * menolak backslash, spasi, dan karakter kontrol karena browser memperlakukan `/\host` sebagai `//host`.
 * Aturan tidak dijalankan untuk nilai kosong; pasangkan dengan `nullable` atau `required`.
 */
final class InternalOrHttpsUrl implements ValidationRule
{
    public function validate(string $attribute, mixed $value, Closure $fail): void
    {
        if (! is_string($value) || ! $this->accepts($value)) {
            $fail('messages.rules.internal_or_https_url')->translate();
        }
    }

    private function accepts(string $value): bool
    {
        if ($value === '') {
            return false;
        }

        if ($value[0] === '/') {
            return ! str_starts_with($value, '//') && preg_match('/[\x00-\x20\x7F\\\\]/', $value) !== 1;
        }

        return str_starts_with($value, 'https://') && filter_var($value, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL) !== false;
    }
}
```

dengan

```php
    /**
     * Nama pada deskripsi: atribut pertama yang terisi dari `name`, `title`, `question`, dipotong 80 karakter
     * (F4A-R8). Dibaca dari atribut mentah dengan array_key_exists (F4A-R33) agar mode ketat tidak melempar untuk kolom yang tidak dimiliki model.
     */
    private function nameOf(Model $model): string
    {
        $attributes = $model->getAttributes();

        foreach (['name', 'title', 'question'] as $column) {
            if (array_key_exists($column, $attributes) && filled($attributes[$column])) {
                return Str::limit((string) $attributes[$column], 80);
            }
        }

        return '';
    }

    private function actor(): Actor
```

### Task 4: `PageSeeder` (semua lingkungan) dan wiring `DatabaseSeeder`

**Files:**
- Create: `database/seeders/PageSeeder.php`
- Modify: `database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php` (panggil `PageSeeder` di semua lingkungan; hapus komentar "PageSeeder ditambahkan di fase 4a.")
- Modify (tes): `tests/Feature/Settings/DatabaseSeederWiringTest.php` (urutan `PageSeeder` setelah `SettingsSeeder`, di luar blok demo)
- Modify (tes): `tests/Feature/Seeding/SeederProductionGuardTest.php` (15 halaman ikut tersemai di produksi)
- Test: `tests/Feature/Seeding/PageSeederTest.php`
- Tidak diubah: `DemoSeeder` (halaman bukan data demo), `SettingsSeeder`, dan tes `DemoSeederWiringTest` (daftar seeder master yang dilarang di `DatabaseSeeder` tidak memuat `PageSeeder`).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Page::KEYS`, `Page::KEYS_WITH_BODY`, `Page::DEFAULTS` (Task 2); `SettingsService::string('contact.address')`; `SettingsSeeder::DEFAULTS` (nilai cadangan alamat); `HtmlSanitizer` (lewat trait `SanitizesRichText`); `AuditObserver` untuk `Page` (Task 3).
- Produces:
  - `Database\Seeders\PageSeeder` dengan `public const BODIES` (lima key: `about`, `vision-mission`, `insurance-info`, `registration-guide`, `privacy-policy`) dan `public function run(SettingsService $settings): void`.
  - `public const ADDRESS_TOKEN = '{alamat}'` (nama tambahan kecil; penanda alamat pada isi `about`, tidak dipakai tugas lain).
  - Lima belas baris `pages` (`is_system = true`) di semua lingkungan, termasuk produksi, lewat `DatabaseSeeder`.

**Test IDs:** SEED-02 (produksi: `DatabaseSeeder` menyemai seeder inti **dan** 15 halaman, `DemoSeeder` tetap dilewati), CRD-11 (dasar: isi halaman sistem tersanitasi), BR-142 (`insurance-info` tidak mengklaim akreditasi atau kerja sama resmi), SEK-08 (isi seeder lolos sanitizer tanpa `class`/`style`), K-06 (teks kebijakan privasi bertanda contoh).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **`DatabaseSeeder`** (`database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php:14-25`) memanggil `[RolePermissionSeeder::class, SettingsSeeder::class]`, lalu `DemoSeeder` hanya di `local`/`testing`; di luar itu menampilkan peringatan `DemoSeeder dilewati (APP_ENV=…)`. Komentar baris 10 menyatakan "PageSeeder ditambahkan di fase 4a." Kontrak 13 §2.3: `$this->call([RolePermissionSeeder::class, SettingsSeeder::class, PageSeeder::class]);`.
- **Pola seeder idempoten** meniru `ClinicSeeder`: cek keberadaan per kunci, lewati yang ada. Bedanya, seeder inti tidak melempar di produksi. Suntingan admin tidak boleh tertimpa (13 §1 butir 5).
- **`forceFill()->save()` wajib** (kerangka C.4): `key` dan `is_system` bukan `$fillable`, dan `save()` menjalankan `SanitizesRichText` (event `saving`) serta observer audit. `saveQuietly()` dilarang karena melewati sanitasi.
- **Injeksi dependensi.** `Seeder::__invoke` memanggil `run()` lewat `$this->container->call([$this, 'run'], …)`, sehingga `run(SettingsService $settings)` mendapat instance scoped dari container. `SettingsSeeder` memanggil `SettingsService::forget()` di akhir, jadi alamat yang dibaca `PageSeeder` selalu segar.
- **Alamat** `contact.address` disisipkan ke paragraf pertama `about` dengan `e()`; bila baris pengaturan belum ada, dipakai nilai bawaan `SettingsSeeder::DEFAULTS['contact.address']['value']`.
- **Isi di luar tabel 13 §8.8.** 13 hanya memberi garis besar. Teks isi disusun untuk rencana ini dari 13 §8.8 dan 12 §7.6, tanpa klaim akreditasi atau kerja sama resmi (BR-142), tanpa tautan ke route yang belum ada, dan tanpa atribut `class`/`style`. Kotak peringatan `insurance-info` **tidak** ada di isi karena ditampilkan view #16 (kerangka E). Hanya tag yang diizinkan profil `rich_text`: `p`, `h2`, `ul`, `ol`, `li`, `strong`, `em`. Tanpa apostrof, tanda kutip, atau `&` agar keluaran sanitizer identik dengan masukan.
- **Audit.** Setelah Task 3, setiap `Page::save()` baru menulis `page.created` dengan pelaku sistem (tanpa login); lima belas baris audit itu wajar dan tidak mengganggu tes seeding lain (tidak ada tes lama yang menghitung seluruh `audit_logs` setelah seeding).
- **`SeederProductionGuardTest`** (`tests/Feature/Seeding/SeederProductionGuardTest.php:37-47`) menegaskan hanya peran, izin, pengaturan, dan nol data master/media di produksi; tambahan satu asersi `pages` = 15 mengunci kontrak baru.
- Jumlah tes ±25.

<?php

/**

class PageSeederTest extends TestCase

    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

    /** @return array<string, array{0: string}> */
    public static function bodyKeys(): array
    {
        return array_combine(Page::KEYS_WITH_BODY, array_map(fn (string $key): array => [$key], Page::KEYS_WITH_BODY));
    }

    private function body(string $key): string
    {
        return (string) DB::table('pages')->where('key', $key)->value('body');
    }

    private function expectedBody(string $key, ?string $address = null): string
    {
        $source = PageSeeder::BODIES[$key];

        if ($key === 'about') {
            $source = str_replace(PageSeeder::ADDRESS_TOKEN, e($address ?? SettingsSeeder::DEFAULTS['contact.address']['value']), $source);
        }

        return app(HtmlSanitizer::class)->clean($source);
    }

    public function test_it_seeds_the_fifteen_system_pages_in_key_order(): void
    {
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);
        $this->seed(PageSeeder::class);

        $this->assertSame(15, Page::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(Page::KEYS, Page::query()->orderBy('id')->pluck('key')->all());
        $this->assertSame(15, Page::query()->where('is_system', true)->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, Page::query()->whereNotNull('updated_by')->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, Page::query()->whereNotNull('meta_title')->count());
    }

    public function test_titles_subtitles_and_meta_descriptions_follow_the_defaults(): void
    {
        $this->seed(PageSeeder::class);

        foreach (Page::KEYS as $key) {
            $page = Page::query()->where('key', $key)->firstOrFail();

            $this->assertSame(Page::DEFAULTS[$key]['title'], $page->title, "judul {$key}");
            $this->assertSame(Page::DEFAULTS[$key]['subtitle'], $page->subtitle, "subjudul {$key}");
            $this->assertSame(Page::DEFAULTS[$key]['meta_description'], $page->meta_description, "meta {$key}");
            $this->assertLessThanOrEqual(160, mb_strlen((string) $page->meta_description), "panjang meta {$key}");
        }
    }

    public function test_only_the_five_keys_with_body_have_content(): void
    {
        $this->seed(PageSeeder::class);

        $this->assertSame(Page::KEYS_WITH_BODY, array_keys(PageSeeder::BODIES));

        foreach (Page::KEYS as $key) {
            $body = Page::query()->where('key', $key)->value('body');

            if (in_array($key, Page::KEYS_WITH_BODY, true)) {
                $this->assertNotNull($body, "body {$key}");
                $this->assertGreaterThan(200, mb_strlen($body), "panjang body {$key}");
            } else {
                $this->assertNull($body, "body {$key}");
            }
        }
    }

    public function test_each_body_is_stored_exactly_as_the_sanitizer_returns_it(string $key): void

        $stored = $this->body($key);

        $this->assertSame($this->expectedBody($key), $stored);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('class=', $stored);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('style=', $stored);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<script', $stored);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<a ', $stored, 'Tanpa tautan ke route yang belum ada.');
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('href', $stored);

        }
    }

    {

    public function test_database_seeder_seeds_the_pages_in_production_and_still_skips_the_demo(): void
    {
        $this->inEnvironment('production', function (): void {
            $this->artisan('db:seed', ['--class' => DatabaseSeeder::class, '--force' => true])
                ->expectsOutputToContain('DemoSeeder dilewati (APP_ENV=production)')
                ->assertExitCode(0);
        });

        $this->assertSame(15, Page::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(Page::KEYS, Page::query()->orderBy('id')->pluck('key')->all());
        $this->assertSame(19, WebsiteSetting::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, User::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, DB::table('media')->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, DB::table('articles')->count() + DB::table('banners')->count() + DB::table('faqs')->count() + DB::table('galleries')->count() + DB::table('insurance_partners')->count());
    }

    public function test_the_page_seeder_has_no_environment_guard(): void
    {
        $this->inEnvironment('production', function (): void {
            // Dipanggil langsung: `db:seed` tanpa --force menunggu konfirmasi di produksi.
            $this->app->make(PageSeeder::class)->run($this->app->make(SettingsService::class));
        });

        $this->assertSame(15, Page::query()->count());
    }

    private function inEnvironment(string $environment, Closure $callback): void
    {
        $original = $this->app['env'];
        $this->app['env'] = $environment;

        try {
            $callback();
        } finally {
            $this->app['env'] = $original;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Menyemai 15 halaman sistem (13 §8.8) di semua lingkungan. Idempoten per key: baris yang sudah ada
     * dilewati sehingga suntingan admin tidak tertimpa. `forceFill()` + `save()` agar `is_system` terisi
     * dan sanitasi rich text (SanitizesRichText) serta audit berjalan.
     */
    public function run(SettingsService $settings): void
    {
        $address = $settings->string('contact.address', (string) SettingsSeeder::DEFAULTS['contact.address']['value']);

        foreach (Page::KEYS as $key) {
            if (Page::query()->where('key', $key)->exists()) {
                continue;
            }

            $defaults = Page::DEFAULTS[$key];
            $body = self::BODIES[$key] ?? null;

            if ($key === 'about' && $body !== null) {
                $body = str_replace(self::ADDRESS_TOKEN, e($address), $body);
            }

            (new Page)->forceFill([
                'key' => $key,
                'title' => $defaults['title'],
                'subtitle' => $defaults['subtitle'],
                'body' => $body,
                'meta_title' => null,
                'meta_description' => $defaults['meta_description'],
                'is_system' => true,
                'updated_by' => null,
            ])->save();
        }
    }
}

### Task 5: Admin #39 Halaman statis, grup route konten, dan tab modul `content`

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Policies/PagePolicy.php`
- Create: `app/Http/Requests/Admin/PageRequest.php`
- Create: `app/Http/Controllers/Admin/PageController.php`
- Create: `resources/views/admin/pages/index.blade.php`, `resources/views/admin/pages/edit.blade.php`
- Modify: `routes/admin.php` (impor `PageController`; grup route konten `admin/konten` dengan tiga route halaman dan penanda `// Task 6` sampai `// Task 11`, disisipkan tepat sebelum komentar `// J. Media`)
- Modify: `config/navigation.php` (kunci baru `modules.content`, tujuh tab)
- Test: `tests/Feature/Admin/AdminPagesTest.php`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Admin/PageRequestTest.php`
- Tidak diubah: `app/Models/Page.php`, `database/seeders/PageSeeder.php` (T2/T4), bagian `admin` (sidebar "Konten Website" sudah ada di `config/navigation.php`), `bootstrap/app.php` (batas numerik `{page}` sudah ada).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - T2: `App\Models\Page` (`KEYS`, `KEYS_WITH_BODY`, `ROUTES`, `DEFAULTS`, `hasBody()`, `updater()`, `$fillable` = `title, subtitle, body, meta_title, meta_description, updated_by`; trait `SanitizesRichText` yang menyimpan `body` kosong sebagai NULL), `Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent::createPage()`.
  - T3: pendaftaran `AuditObserver` untuk `Page` (aksi `page.updated`, nama dari `title`), kunci lang `messages.entities.page` = "Halaman", pemetaan `MediaPolicy` untuk `Page`.
  - T4: `Database\Seeders\PageSeeder` (15 key; dipanggil tes lewat `$this->seed(PageSeeder::class)`).
  - Fase 2: komponen `x-layouts.admin`, `x-breadcrumb`, `x-module-tabs`, `x-form.input`, `x-form.rich-text`, `x-form.errors-summary`, `x-loading-button`; `App\Support\NavigationMenu`.
- Produces:
  - `App\Policies\PagePolicy` (`final`; `viewAny`, `view`, `update` = `content.manage`; `create`, `delete` = `false`).
  - `App\Http\Requests\Admin\PageRequest` (aturan V-30; `pageAttributes(): array`).
  - `App\Http\Controllers\Admin\PageController` (`index`, `edit`, `update`; tanpa `create`, `store`, `destroy`).
  - Route `admin.pages.index` (`GET /admin/konten/halaman`), `admin.pages.edit` (`GET /admin/konten/halaman/{page}/ubah`), `admin.pages.update` (`PUT|PATCH /admin/konten/halaman/{page}`), semuanya di bawah `permission:content.manage`.
  - **Grup route konten** di `routes/admin.php` persis kerangka C.5, dengan baris penanda `// Task 6: banner`, `// Task 7: kategori artikel`, `// Task 8: artikel`, `// Task 9: galeri`, `// Task 10: FAQ`, `// Task 11: mitra asuransi` yang diganti T6 sampai T11.
  - `config('navigation.modules.content')` dengan tujuh tab (Halaman, Banner, Artikel, Kategori Artikel, Galeri, FAQ, Mitra Asuransi), semuanya `permission` = `content.manage`. Tab ke route yang belum ada tersembunyi otomatis oleh `NavigationMenu`.
  - Flash `success`: "Halaman berhasil diperbarui.".

**Test IDs:** AKS #39 (baris `admin.pages.*`), CRD-13 (tidak ada `create`/`store`/`destroy` untuk halaman), SEK-15 (sanitasi `pages.body` lewat form), VAL (V-30), Review Focus 2 (rich text berbahaya atau kosong pada `pages.body`) dan Review Focus 5 (`DELETE`/`POST` ke `admin.pages.*` yang tidak ada gagal dengan 405/404).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **Pola ClinicController.** `app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ClinicController.php` memakai `$this->authorize()` di setiap method dan `DB::transaction` untuk simpan; `PageController` meniru pola itu tanpa media (gambar editor diikat otomatis oleh `SanitizesRichText::saved` lewat `MediaService::syncEditorImages`, `app/Models/Concerns/SanitizesRichText.php:57-67`).
2. **Sanitasi hanya di model.** `PageRequest` tidak membersihkan HTML (F2-R14, D-40). Hasil kosong (`<p><br></p>`) menjadi NULL karena `SanitizesRichText::bootSanitizesRichText` (`app/Models/Concerns/SanitizesRichText.php:33-40`). Kolom `pages.body` nullable, sehingga NULL aman.
3. **Daftar tanpa `x-data-table`.** F4A-R13: 15 baris tetap, tanpa paginasi dan tanpa filter. `x-data-table` membutuhkan paginator (`resources/views/components/data-table.blade.php` memanggil `$rows->firstItem()`), jadi index memakai tabel `table-cards` biasa dengan `data-label`.
4. **Urutan baris** = urutan `Page::KEYS` (bukan urutan abjad), diurutkan di PHP agar tidak memakai kata cadangan SQL `key`.
5. **Mode ketat.** `index` memuat `with('updater')` untuk kolom "Terakhir diubah". Halaman edit tidak memakai relasi apa pun.
6. **`key` hanya-baca.** Input kunci pada form tidak punya atribut `name`, dan `PageRequest` hanya menerima kunci yang ada di `rules()`, sehingga `key`, `is_system`, dan `updated_by` kiriman klien diabaikan. `updated_by` diisi controller dari pengguna login.
7. **Penegakan "tanpa tambah/hapus".** Tidak ada route `create`/`store`/`destroy`. `PagePolicy::create` dan `delete` bernilai `false` (Super Admin tetap lolos `Gate::before`, tetapi rutenya tidak ada). `DELETE /admin/konten/halaman/{id}` dan `POST /admin/konten/halaman` menghasilkan 405 karena URI itu terdaftar hanya untuk metode lain.
8. **Grup route berada di dalam grup G-ADMIN** (`auth`, `account:staff`, `active`, `password.changed`), sebelum blok media. `AdminRouteMiddlewareTest` (KNS-02) otomatis mencakup route baru; semuanya sudah ber-`permission:content.manage`.
9. **Tab modul.** `x-module-tabs group="content"` membaca `config('navigation.modules.content')`; tab yang route-nya belum ada disaring `NavigationMenu::resolveLink` (`app/Support/NavigationMenu.php`). Pada akhir T5 hanya tab "Halaman" yang tampil; tab lain muncul setelah T6 sampai T11.
10. Tidak ada perubahan JS atau SCSS; tidak ada `npm run build`.

<?php

class AdminPagesTest extends TestCase
{

    use InteractsWithStaff;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // Senin, 5 Oktober 2026 pukul 10.30 WIB.
        $this->travelTo(Carbon::parse('2026-10-05 10:30:00'));
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function payload(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return array_merge([
            'title' => 'Profil Rumah Sakit Baru',
            'subtitle' => 'Mengenal kami lebih dekat',
            'body' => '<p>Isi <strong>baru</strong> halaman profil.</p>',
            'meta_title' => 'Profil UNPAM HOSPITAL',
            'meta_description' => 'Profil singkat UNPAM HOSPITAL.',
        ], $overrides);
    }

    // --- Akses (AKS #39) ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string, int}>
     */
    public static function staffRoles(): array
    {
        return [
            'super admin' => ['super-admin', 200],
            'admin konten' => ['content-admin', 200],
            'petugas pendaftaran' => ['registration-officer', 403],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('staffRoles')]
    public function test_index_and_edit_access_per_staff_role(string $role, int $status): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('about');
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff($role));

        $this->get(route('admin.pages.index'))->assertStatus($status);
        $this->get(route('admin.pages.edit', $page))->assertStatus($status);
    }

    public function test_patient_gets_403(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('about');
        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->patient()->create());

        $this->get(route('admin.pages.index'))->assertForbidden();
        $this->get(route('admin.pages.edit', $page))->assertForbidden();
    }

    public function test_guest_is_redirected_to_admin_login(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('about');

        $this->get(route('admin.pages.index'))->assertRedirect(route('admin.login'));
        $this->get(route('admin.pages.edit', $page))->assertRedirect(route('admin.login'));
        $this->put(route('admin.pages.update', $page), $this->payload())->assertRedirect(route('admin.login'));
    }

    public function test_urls_use_the_indonesian_segments(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('about');

        $this->assertSame(url('/admin/konten/halaman'), route('admin.pages.index'));
        $this->assertSame(url('/admin/konten/halaman/'.$page->id.'/ubah'), route('admin.pages.edit', $page));
        $this->assertSame(url('/admin/konten/halaman/'.$page->id), route('admin.pages.update', $page));
    }

    public function test_non_numeric_id_is_a_404(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->get('/admin/konten/halaman/abc/ubah')
            ->assertNotFound();
    }

    // --- Tidak ada tambah/hapus (CRD-13, Review Focus 5) ----------------------------------------------

    public function test_there_are_no_create_store_destroy_or_show_routes_for_pages(): void
    {
        foreach (['create', 'store', 'destroy', 'show'] as $action) {
            $this->assertFalse(Route::has('admin.pages.'.$action), "admin.pages.{$action} tidak boleh ada.");
        }
    }

    public function test_delete_and_post_to_page_urls_fail_with_405_even_for_super_admin(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('about');
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('super-admin'));

        $this->delete('/admin/konten/halaman/'.$page->id)->assertStatus(405);
        $this->post('/admin/konten/halaman', $this->payload())->assertStatus(405);
        $this->get('/admin/konten/halaman/buat')->assertNotFound();

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('pages', ['id' => $page->id]);
        $this->assertSame(1, Page::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_page_policy_never_allows_create_or_delete_for_staff(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');
        $page = $this->createPage('about');

        $this->assertTrue(Gate::forUser($admin)->allows('viewAny', Page::class));
        $this->assertTrue(Gate::forUser($admin)->allows('view', $page));
        $this->assertTrue(Gate::forUser($admin)->allows('update', $page));
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::forUser($admin)->allows('create', Page::class));
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::forUser($admin)->allows('delete', $page));

        $policy = new PagePolicy;
        $this->assertFalse($policy->create($admin));
        $this->assertFalse($policy->delete($admin, $page));
    }

    // --- Daftar ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_index_lists_the_fifteen_seeded_pages_in_key_order_with_columns_in_strict_mode(): void
    {
        $this->seed(PageSeeder::class);
        $dewi = $this->createStaff('content-admin', ['name' => 'Dewi Editor']);
        $budi = $this->createStaff('content-admin', ['name' => 'Budi Konten']);
        Page::query()->where('key', 'about')->sole()->forceFill(['updated_by' => $dewi->id])->save();
        Page::query()->where('key', 'faq')->sole()->forceFill(['updated_by' => $budi->id])->save();

        $html = $this->actingAs($dewi)
            ->get(route('admin.pages.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Halaman')
            ->assertSee('Alamat')
            ->assertSee('Terakhir diubah')
            ->assertSee('oleh Dewi Editor')
            ->assertSee('oleh Budi Konten')
            ->assertSee('5 Okt 2026 10.30')
            ->getContent();

        preg_match_all('/data-label="Halaman">\s*<span class="fw-semibold">(.*?)<\/span>/s', $html, $titles);
        $expected = array_map(fn (string $key): string => Page::DEFAULTS[$key]['title'], Page::KEYS);
        $this->assertSame($expected, array_map(fn (string $title): string => html_entity_decode($title), $titles[1]));

        preg_match_all('/data-label="Isi">(.*?)<\/td>/s', $html, $bodies);
        $expectedBodies = array_map(fn (string $key): string => in_array($key, Page::KEYS_WITH_BODY, true) ? 'Ya' : '—', Page::KEYS);
        $this->assertSame($expectedBodies, array_map(fn (string $cell): string => trim(html_entity_decode($cell)), $bodies[1]));

        $this->assertSame(15, preg_match_all('#href="'.preg_quote(url('/admin/konten/halaman'), '#').'/\d+/ubah"#', $html));
    }

    public function test_index_shows_the_public_address_and_view_link_only_for_registered_routes(): void
    {
        $this->seed(PageSeeder::class);
        $this->assertTrue(Route::has('home'));
        $this->assertTrue(Route::has('clinics.index'));

        $html = $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->get(route('admin.pages.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->getContent();

        foreach (Page::ROUTES as $routeName) {
            if (! Route::has($routeName)) {
                continue;
            }

            $this->assertStringContainsString('<code>'.route($routeName, [], false).'</code>', $html, "Alamat {$routeName} tidak tampil.");
            $this->assertStringContainsString('href="'.route($routeName).'"', $html, "Tautan Lihat {$routeName} tidak tampil.");
        }
    }

    public function test_index_has_an_edit_link_per_page_but_no_add_or_delete_controls(): void
    {
        $this->seed(PageSeeder::class);
        $about = Page::query()->where('key', 'about')->sole();
        $privacy = Page::query()->where('key', 'privacy-policy')->sole();

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->get(route('admin.pages.index'))

            ->assertDontSee('Tambah Halaman')
            ->assertDontSee('data-confirm-action', false)
            ->assertDontSee('Hapus');
    }

    public function test_index_shows_module_tab_breadcrumb_and_sidebar_group(): void
    {
        $this->seed(PageSeeder::class);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->get(route('admin.pages.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Konten Website')
            ->assertSee('href="'.route('admin.pages.index').'"', false)
            ->assertSee('aria-label="Tab modul"', false)
            ->assertSee('aria-current="page"', false)
            ->assertSee('aria-label="Breadcrumb"', false)
            ->assertSee('Konten');
    }

    // --- Tab modul content ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_content_module_tabs_follow_the_documented_configuration(): void
    {
        $tabs = config('navigation.modules.content');

        $this->assertSame(
            [
                ['Halaman', 'admin.pages.index'],
                ['Banner', 'admin.banners.index'],
                ['Artikel', 'admin.articles.index'],
                ['Kategori Artikel', 'admin.article-categories.index'],
                ['Galeri', 'admin.galleries.index'],
                ['FAQ', 'admin.faqs.index'],
                ['Mitra Asuransi', 'admin.insurance-partners.index'],
            ],
            array_map(fn (array $tab): array => [$tab['label'], $tab['route']], $tabs),
        );

        foreach ($tabs as $tab) {
            $this->assertSame('content.manage', $tab['permission']);
        }

        $this->assertSame(['admin.pages.*'], $tabs[0]['active']);
    }

    public function test_module_tabs_are_hidden_from_the_registration_officer_and_filtered_by_existing_routes(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');
        $officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');

        $adminLabels = array_column(NavigationMenu::items('modules.content', $admin), 'label');
        $this->assertContains('Halaman', $adminLabels);

        foreach (config('navigation.modules.content') as $tab) {
            $this->assertSame(Route::has($tab['route']), in_array($tab['label'], $adminLabels, true), $tab['label']);
        }

        $this->assertSame([], NavigationMenu::items('modules.content', $officer));
    }

    // --- Edit --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_edit_form_for_a_page_with_body_shows_the_rich_text_editor_and_a_read_only_key(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('about', ['title' => 'Profil Lama', 'subtitle' => 'Sub lama', 'body' => '<p>Isi lama</p>', 'meta_title' => 'Meta lama']);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->get(route('admin.pages.edit', $page))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Ubah Profil Lama')
            ->assertSee('value="about"', false)
            ->assertSee('readonly', false)
            ->assertSee('value="Profil Lama"', false)
            ->assertSee('value="Sub lama"', false)
            ->assertSee('value="Meta lama"', false)
            ->assertSee('data-rich-text', false)
            ->assertSee('name="body"', false)
            ->assertSee('Isi lama')
            ->assertSee('name="meta_description"', false)
            ->assertSee('action="'.route('admin.pages.update', $page).'"', false)
            ->assertSee('name="_method" value="PUT"', false)
            ->assertDontSee('name="key"', false)
            ->assertDontSee('Halaman ini tidak memiliki isi yang dapat diedit.');
    }

    public function test_edit_form_for_a_page_without_body_has_no_editor_and_shows_the_explanation(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('home');

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->get(route('admin.pages.edit', $page))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Halaman ini tidak memiliki isi yang dapat diedit.')
            ->assertDontSee('data-rich-text', false)
            ->assertDontSee('name="body"', false)
            ->assertSee('name="title"', false)
            ->assertSee('name="subtitle"', false)
            ->assertSee('name="meta_title"', false);
    }

    // --- Update ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_update_saves_the_fields_sets_updated_by_and_writes_the_audit_row(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('about', ['body' => '<p>Isi lama</p>']);
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->put(route('admin.pages.update', $page), $this->payload())
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.pages.index'))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Halaman berhasil diperbarui.');

        $page->refresh();
        $this->assertSame('Profil Rumah Sakit Baru', $page->title);
        $this->assertSame('Mengenal kami lebih dekat', $page->subtitle);
        $this->assertSame('<p>Isi <strong>baru</strong> halaman profil.</p>', $page->body);
        $this->assertSame('Profil UNPAM HOSPITAL', $page->meta_title);
        $this->assertSame('Profil singkat UNPAM HOSPITAL.', $page->meta_description);
        $this->assertSame($admin->id, $page->updated_by);
        $this->assertSame('about', $page->key);
        $this->assertTrue($page->is_system);

        $audit = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'page.updated')->sole();
        $this->assertSame($page->id, $audit->auditable_id);
        $this->assertSame($admin->id, $audit->user_id);
        $this->assertSame('Halaman "Profil Rumah Sakit Baru" diperbarui.', $audit->description);
        $this->assertSame('[konten diubah]', $audit->new_values['body']);
    }

    public function test_update_may_use_patch_and_redirects_back_to_the_list_with_the_new_title(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('vision-mission');
        $admin = $this->createStaff('super-admin');

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->patch(route('admin.pages.update', $page), $this->payload(['title' => 'Visi dan Misi Baru']))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.pages.index'));

        $this->get(route('admin.pages.index'))->assertSee('Visi dan Misi Baru');
    }

    public function test_update_of_a_page_without_body_keeps_the_body_untouched(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('home');
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->put(route('admin.pages.update', $page), [
                'title' => 'Beranda Baru',
                'subtitle' => '',
                'meta_title' => '',
                'meta_description' => '',
            ])
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.pages.index'));

        $page->refresh();
        $this->assertSame('Beranda Baru', $page->title);
        $this->assertNull($page->subtitle);
        $this->assertNull($page->body);
        $this->assertNull($page->meta_title);
        $this->assertNull($page->meta_description);
        $this->assertSame($admin->id, $page->updated_by);
    }

    public function test_body_is_rejected_for_a_page_without_body_and_nothing_is_saved(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('home', ['title' => 'Judul Lama']);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('super-admin'))
            ->from(route('admin.pages.edit', $page))
            ->put(route('admin.pages.update', $page), $this->payload(['title' => 'Judul Tidak Tersimpan']))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.pages.edit', $page))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['body' => 'Halaman ini tidak memiliki isi yang dapat diedit.']);

        $page->refresh();
        $this->assertSame('Judul Lama', $page->title);
        $this->assertNull($page->body);
        $this->assertNull($page->updated_by);
    }

    public function test_invalid_input_keeps_old_input_and_shows_the_error_summary(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('about');

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->from(route('admin.pages.edit', $page))
            ->put(route('admin.pages.update', $page), $this->payload(['title' => '', 'subtitle' => 'Subjudul Kiriman']))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.pages.edit', $page));

        $this->get(route('admin.pages.edit', $page))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('data-errors-summary', false)
            ->assertSee('Judul wajib diisi.')
            ->assertSee('aria-invalid="true"', false)
            ->assertSee('value="Subjudul Kiriman"', false);
    }

    public function test_meta_limits_are_enforced_over_http(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('about');
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))->from(route('admin.pages.edit', $page));

        $this->put(route('admin.pages.update', $page), $this->payload(['meta_title' => str_repeat('a', 71)]))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['meta_title' => 'Meta title maksimal 70 karakter.']);

        $this->put(route('admin.pages.update', $page), $this->payload(['meta_description' => str_repeat('a', 161)]))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['meta_description' => 'Meta description maksimal 160 karakter.']);

        $this->put(route('admin.pages.update', $page), $this->payload(['meta_title' => str_repeat('a', 70), 'meta_description' => str_repeat('b', 160)]))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
    }

    // --- Rich text (Review Focus 2) -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_hostile_body_is_sanitized_when_saved_through_the_form(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('about');

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->put(route('admin.pages.update', $page), $this->payload([
                'body' => '<p style="color:red" class="x">Aman</p><script>alert(1)</script><img src="/storage/x.jpg" alt="ok" onerror="alert(1)"><a href="javascript:alert(1)">klik</a><iframe src="https://evil.test"></iframe>',
            ]))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.pages.index'));

        $body = (string) $page->fresh()->body;

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Aman', $body);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<script', $body);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('alert(1)</script', $body);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('onerror', $body);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('javascript:', $body);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<iframe', $body);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('style=', $body);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('class=', $body);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string}>
     */
    public static function blankBodies(): array
    {
        return [
            'paragraf kosong Quill' => ['<p><br></p>'],
            'hanya spasi tak terpisah' => ['<p>&nbsp;</p>'],
            'hanya spasi' => ['   '],
            'hanya script' => ['<script>alert(1)</script>'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('blankBodies')]
    public function test_a_body_that_is_blank_after_sanitizing_is_stored_as_null(string $body): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('about', ['body' => '<p>Isi lama</p>']);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->put(route('admin.pages.update', $page), $this->payload(['body' => $body]))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.pages.index'));

        $this->assertNull($page->fresh()->body);
    }

    // --- Kolom yang tidak boleh diubah klien ---------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_key_is_system_flag_and_updated_by_sent_by_the_client_are_ignored(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('about');
        $other = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->put(route('admin.pages.update', $page), $this->payload([
                'key' => 'hacked',
                'is_system' => '0',
                'updated_by' => (string) $other->id,
                'id' => '999',
            ]))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.pages.index'));

        $page->refresh();
        $this->assertSame('about', $page->key);
        $this->assertTrue($page->is_system);
        $this->assertSame($admin->id, $page->updated_by);
        $this->assertSame(1, Page::query()->count());
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('pages', ['key' => 'hacked']);
    }

    public function test_registration_officer_cannot_update_a_page(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('about', ['title' => 'Judul Asli']);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('registration-officer'))
            ->put(route('admin.pages.update', $page), $this->payload())
            ->assertForbidden();

        $this->assertSame('Judul Asli', $page->fresh()->title);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('audit_logs', ['action' => 'page.updated']);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use Tests\Support\InteractsWithFormRequests;

use Tests\TestCase;

/**

 */

{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use InteractsWithFormRequests;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function validPayload(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return array_merge([
            'title' => 'Profil Rumah Sakit',
            'subtitle' => 'Mengenal UNPAM HOSPITAL',
            'body' => '<p>Isi halaman.</p>',
            'meta_title' => 'Profil',
            'meta_description' => 'Profil singkat.',
        ], $overrides);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     * @return array<string, list<string>>
     */
    private function errorsFor(string $key, array $data): array
    {
        return $this->validationErrors(PageRequest::class, $data, null, ['page' => $this->createPage($key)], 'PUT');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string, array<string, mixed>, string, string}>
     */
    public static function invalidInputs(): array
    {
        return [
            'judul kosong' => ['about', ['title' => ''], 'title', 'Judul wajib diisi.'],

            'judul terlalu pendek' => ['about', ['title' => 'Ab'], 'title', 'Judul minimal 3 karakter.'],
            'judul terlalu panjang' => ['about', ['title' => str_repeat('a', 151)], 'title', 'Judul maksimal 150 karakter.'],
            'subjudul bukan teks' => ['about', ['subtitle' => ['a']], 'subtitle', 'Subjudul harus berupa teks.'],
            'subjudul terlalu panjang' => ['about', ['subtitle' => str_repeat('a', 256)], 'subtitle', 'Subjudul maksimal 255 karakter.'],
            'isi bukan teks' => ['about', ['body' => ['a']], 'body', 'Isi halaman harus berupa teks.'],
            'isi terlalu panjang' => ['about', ['body' => str_repeat('a', 100001)], 'body', 'Isi halaman maksimal 100.000 karakter.'],
            'isi untuk beranda' => ['home', ['body' => '<p>Tidak boleh</p>'], 'body', 'Halaman ini tidak memiliki isi yang dapat diedit.'],
            'isi untuk faq' => ['faq', ['body' => '<p>Tidak boleh</p>'], 'body', 'Halaman ini tidak memiliki isi yang dapat diedit.'],
            'isi untuk kontak' => ['contact', ['body' => '<p>Tidak boleh</p>'], 'body', 'Halaman ini tidak memiliki isi yang dapat diedit.'],
            'meta title bukan teks' => ['about', ['meta_title' => ['a']], 'meta_title', 'Meta title harus berupa teks.'],
            'meta title terlalu panjang' => ['about', ['meta_title' => str_repeat('a', 71)], 'meta_title', 'Meta title maksimal 70 karakter.'],
            'meta description bukan teks' => ['about', ['meta_description' => ['a']], 'meta_description', 'Meta description harus berupa teks.'],
            'meta description terlalu panjang' => ['about', ['meta_description' => str_repeat('a', 161)], 'meta_description', 'Meta description maksimal 160 karakter.'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $override
     */
    #[DataProvider('invalidInputs')]
    public function test_invalid_input_is_rejected_with_indonesian_messages(string $key, array $override, string $field, string $message): void
    {
        $errors = $this->errorsFor($key, $this->validPayload($override));

        $this->assertArrayHasKey($field, $errors);
        $this->assertSame($message, $errors[$field][0]);
    }

    public function test_every_page_key_without_body_prohibits_it_and_every_key_with_body_allows_it(): void
    {
        foreach (Page::KEYS as $key) {
            $errors = $this->errorsFor($key, $this->validPayload());

            if (in_array($key, Page::KEYS_WITH_BODY, true)) {
                $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('body', $errors, "Kunci {$key} seharusnya boleh memiliki isi.");
            } else {
                $this->assertArrayHasKey('body', $errors, "Kunci {$key} seharusnya melarang isi.");
            }

            Page::query()->where('key', $key)->delete();
        }
    }

    public function test_optional_fields_may_be_empty_and_an_empty_body_is_allowed_for_pages_without_body(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor('home', [
            'title' => 'Beranda',
            'subtitle' => null,
            'body' => null,
            'meta_title' => null,
            'meta_description' => null,
        ]));

        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor('clinics-index', [
            'title' => 'Layanan dan Poliklinik',
            'body' => '',
        ]));
    }

    public function test_boundary_lengths_are_accepted(): void
    {
        $errors = $this->errorsFor('about', $this->validPayload([
            'title' => str_repeat('a', 150),
            'subtitle' => str_repeat('b', 255),
            'body' => str_repeat('c', 100000),
            'meta_title' => str_repeat('d', 70),
            'meta_description' => str_repeat('e', 160),
        ]));

        $this->assertSame([], $errors);
    }

    public function test_page_attributes_contains_only_editable_columns_and_turns_blank_strings_into_null(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('about');
        $request = $this->makeFormRequest(PageRequest::class, $this->validPayload([
            'subtitle' => '   ',
            'meta_title' => '',
            'key' => 'hacked',
            'is_system' => '0',
            'updated_by' => '99',
        ]), null, ['page' => $page], 'PUT');
        $request->validateResolved();

        $this->assertSame([
            'title' => 'Profil Rumah Sakit',
            'subtitle' => null,
            'meta_title' => null,
            'meta_description' => 'Profil singkat.',
            'body' => '<p>Isi halaman.</p>',
        ], $request->pageAttributes());
    }

    public function test_page_attributes_omits_body_for_a_page_without_body(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('home');
        $request = $this->makeFormRequest(PageRequest::class, $this->validPayload(['body' => null]), null, ['page' => $page], 'PUT');
        $request->validateResolved();

        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('body', $request->pageAttributes());
    }

    public function test_only_staff_with_content_manage_may_use_the_request(): void
    {
        $page = $this->createPage('about');
        $officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');

        $this->assertTrue($this->makeFormRequest(PageRequest::class, [], null, ['page' => $page], 'PUT')->authorize());
        $this->assertTrue($this->makeFormRequest(PageRequest::class, [], $this->createStaff('super-admin'), ['page' => $page], 'PUT')->authorize());
        $this->assertFalse($this->makeFormRequest(PageRequest::class, [], $officer, ['page' => $page], 'PUT')->authorize());
        $this->assertFalse($this->makeFormRequest(PageRequest::class, [], null, [], 'PUT')->authorize(), 'Tanpa model halaman tidak ada yang boleh disimpan.');

        $this->expectException(AuthorizationException::class);

        $this->validationErrors(PageRequest::class, $this->validPayload(), $officer, ['page' => $page], 'PUT');
    }
}

<?php

/**

`app/Http/Requests/Admin/PageRequest.php`

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Models\Page;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * V-30 + BR-121: hanya judul, subjudul, isi (kunci ber-body), dan meta yang dapat diubah. `key`, `is_system`,
 * dan `updated_by` tidak ada di `rules()` sehingga tidak pernah masuk `validated()`. HTML `body` tidak dibersihkan
 * di sini: sanitasi dilakukan trait SanitizesRichText pada event `saving` (F2-R14, D-40).
 */
class PageRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $user = $this->user();
        $page = $this->route('page');

        return $user !== null && $page instanceof Page && $user->can('update', $page);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        $page = $this->route('page');
        $hasBody = $page instanceof Page && $page->hasBody();

        return [
            'title' => ['bail', 'required', 'string', 'min:3', 'max:150'],
            'subtitle' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'body' => ['nullable', Rule::prohibitedIf(! $hasBody), 'string', 'max:100000'],
            'meta_title' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:70'],
            'meta_description' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:160'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'title.required' => 'Judul wajib diisi.',
            'title.string' => 'Judul harus berupa teks.',
            'title.min' => 'Judul minimal 3 karakter.',
            'title.max' => 'Judul maksimal 150 karakter.',
            'subtitle.string' => 'Subjudul harus berupa teks.',
            'subtitle.max' => 'Subjudul maksimal 255 karakter.',
            'body.prohibited' => 'Halaman ini tidak memiliki isi yang dapat diedit.',
            'body.string' => 'Isi halaman harus berupa teks.',
            'body.max' => 'Isi halaman maksimal 100.000 karakter.',
            'meta_title.string' => 'Meta title harus berupa teks.',
            'meta_title.max' => 'Meta title maksimal 70 karakter.',
            'meta_description.string' => 'Meta description harus berupa teks.',
            'meta_description.max' => 'Meta description maksimal 160 karakter.',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Atribut model hasil validasi. `body` hanya disertakan untuk halaman yang memiliki isi.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function pageAttributes(): array
    {
        $data = $this->validated();
        $page = $this->route('page');

        $attributes = [
            'title' => trim((string) $data['title']),
            'subtitle' => $this->blankToNull($data['subtitle'] ?? null),
            'meta_title' => $this->blankToNull($data['meta_title'] ?? null),
            'meta_description' => $this->blankToNull($data['meta_description'] ?? null),
        ];

        if ($page instanceof Page && $page->hasBody()) {
            $attributes['body'] = $this->blankToNull($data['body'] ?? null);
        }

        return $attributes;
    }

    private function blankToNull(mixed $value): ?string
    {
        return is_string($value) && trim($value) !== '' ? trim($value) : null;
    }
}
```

`app/Http/Controllers/Admin/PageController.php`

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\PageRequest;
use App\Models\Page;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Halaman #39, tab Halaman (F4A-R24). Hanya `index`, `edit`, `update`: 15 halaman sistem tidak dapat
 * ditambah atau dihapus (BR-121). Daftar tetap 15 baris tanpa paginasi dan tanpa filter (F4A-R13).
 */
class PageController extends Controller
{
    public function index(): View
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', Page::class);

        $order = array_flip(Page::KEYS);
        $pages = Page::query()
            ->with('updater')
            ->get()
            ->sortBy(fn (Page $page): int => $order[$page->key] ?? PHP_INT_MAX)
            ->values();

        return view('admin.pages.index', ['pages' => $pages]);
    }

    public function edit(Page $page): View
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $page);

        return view('admin.pages.edit', ['page' => $page]);
    }

    public function update(PageRequest $request, Page $page): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $page);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $page): void {
            $page->update($request->pageAttributes() + ['updated_by' => $request->user()?->id]);
        });

        return redirect()->route('admin.pages.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.updated', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.page')]));
    }
}
```

### Task 6: Admin #39 Banner

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Policies/BannerPolicy.php`
- Create: `app/Http/Requests/Admin/BannerIndexRequest.php`, `app/Http/Requests/Admin/BannerRequest.php`
- Create: `app/Http/Controllers/Admin/BannerController.php`
- Create: `resources/views/admin/banners/index.blade.php`, `create.blade.php`, `edit.blade.php`, `_form.blade.php`
- Modify: `routes/admin.php` (impor `BannerController`; ganti baris penanda `// Task 6: banner` dengan `Route::resource('banner', …)`)
- Test: `tests/Feature/Admin/AdminBannersTest.php`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Admin/BannerRequestTest.php`
- Tidak diubah: `app/Models/Banner.php` (T2), `config/navigation.php` (tab Banner sudah ada dari T5; tab itu otomatis tampil begitu route `admin.banners.index` terdaftar).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - T2: `App\Models\Banner` (`$fillable`: `title, subtitle, button_label, button_url, sort_order, is_active, starts_at, ends_at`; `scopeOrdered()`; `scheduleLabel(): string` dengan nilai "Tayang"/"Terjadwal"/"Berakhir"/"Nonaktif"; relasi media koleksi `image` lewat `HasMedia`), `Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent::createBanner()`.
  - T3: `App\Rules\InternalOrHttpsUrl` (pesan "Tautan harus berupa alamat internal (diawali /) atau URL https."), audit `banner.*` lewat `AuditObserver`, `messages.entities.banner` = "Banner", pemetaan `MediaPolicy` Banner, kolom `description`/`name`/`title` untuk nama audit.
  - T5: grup route konten dengan penanda `// Task 6: banner` (delapan spasi), tab modul `content`, pola view admin.
  - Fase 2: `App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest`, `App\Rules\ImageRules` (koleksi `image`: maks 4096 KB, minimum 1200 x 400), `App\Services\Media\MediaService` (`replace`, `updateMeta`), `x-form.file`, `x-data-table`, `x-image` (`type="banner"`, rasio `3x1`).
- Produces:
  - `App\Policies\BannerPolicy` (`final`; semua method = `content.manage`).
  - `App\Http\Requests\Admin\BannerIndexRequest extends ListFilterRequest` (`applyTo(Builder $query): Builder`; status `aktif|nonaktif`; urut `urutan|judul`; `q` pada `title`).
  - `App\Http\Requests\Admin\BannerRequest` (V-31; `bannerAttributes(): array`, `imageFile(): ?UploadedFile`, `imageAlt(): string`).
  - `App\Http\Controllers\Admin\BannerController` (`index`, `create`, `store`, `edit`, `update`, `destroy`).
  - Route `admin.banners.index|create|store|edit|update|destroy` → `/admin/konten/banner`, `/admin/konten/banner/buat`, `/admin/konten/banner/{banner}/ubah`, `/admin/konten/banner/{banner}`, semuanya `permission:content.manage`.
  - Flash `success`: "Banner berhasil ditambahkan." / "Banner berhasil diperbarui." / "Banner berhasil dihapus.".

**Test IDs:** AKS #39 (baris `admin.banners.*`), VAL (V-31), MED-01/MED-02 (unggah banner: gambar valid tersimpan, SVG dan berkas berbahaya ditolak), Review Focus 4 (unggahan berbahaya: SVG berskrip, `shell.php.jpg`, PNG bernama `.jpg`, banner > 4 MB atau < 1200 x 400, alt kosong), CRD-04 (admin mengelola banner), Review Focus 1 (sisi admin: label periode untuk batas waktu tayang).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **Pola ClinicController/ClinicRequest.** Penyimpanan media mengikuti `ClinicController::saveMedia` (`app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ClinicController.php:90-107`): berkas baru → `MediaService::replace($owner, 'image', $file, ['alt_text' => $alt], $user)`; tanpa berkas tetapi `image_alt` dikirim → `MediaService::updateMeta` pada media yang ada (D-57). `ClinicRequest::validateExistingCoverAlt` (`app/Http/Requests/Admin/ClinicRequest.php:154-168`) menolak alt kosong bila gambar sudah ada.
2. **Koleksi `image`** (`MediaService::COLLECTIONS`, `app/Services/Media/MediaService.php:42-50`): tunggal, `max_kb` 4096, minimum `[1200, 400]`. `ImageRules::messages('image', 'image')` sudah menghasilkan "Ukuran banner maksimal 4 MB." dan "Dimensi banner minimal 1200 x 400 piksel dan maksimal 6000 x 6000 piksel." (`app/Rules/ImageRules.php:46-58`).
3. **PNG bernama `.jpg`.** `ImageRulesTest` (`tests/Feature/Media/ImageRulesTest.php:107`) memastikan isi PNG sungguhan lolos aturan; `MediaService` menyimpan dengan ekstensi dari format nyata (`.png`). Tes banner menegaskan berkas tersimpan sebagai `.png`, bukan `.jpg`. `shell.php.jpg` (kepala JPEG + kode PHP) dan SVG ditolak oleh aturan sehingga tidak ada baris `media` maupun berkas.
4. **`ends_at` setelah `starts_at`.** Aturan `after:starts_at` hanya dipasang bila `starts_at` terisi dan dapat diparse; jika tidak, Laravel akan membandingkan dengan teks harfiah `starts_at`. `CHECK chk_banners_period` (`ends_at > starts_at`) di DB selaras dengan aturan ini (setara kuat, bukan sama dengan).
5. **Zona waktu.** Input `datetime-local` (`Y-m-d\TH:i`) dikirim apa adanya dan diparse oleh cast `datetime` model dalam zona aplikasi `Asia/Jakarta` (F4A-R26); tes menegaskan nilai tersimpan `2026-10-10 08:00`.
6. **Periode di daftar.** Label dihitung di view dengan format `d M Y H.i`: "{mulai} – {selesai}" bila keduanya ada, "Mulai {mulai}" bila hanya awal, "Hingga {selesai}" bila hanya akhir, dan "Tanpa batas" bila keduanya kosong. Status memakai `Banner::scheduleLabel()` (F4A-R25) sehingga admin dan publik memakai satu perhitungan.
7. **Hapus permanen.** Banner tidak punya aturan rujukan. `HasMedia::bootHasMedia` menghapus baris `media` dan berkasnya saat model dihapus (`app/Models/Concerns/HasMedia.php:23-27`); controller membungkus `delete()` dalam `DB::transaction` agar berkas dihapus setelah commit.
8. **Mode ketat.** `index` memakai `with('media')` karena view memanggil `firstMedia('image')`; `edit` memakai `load('media')`. Tes daftar memakai lima baris.
9. **`kategori` pada `ListFilterRequest`.** Parameter bawaan `kategori`, `per_page`, dan `page` tetap ada pada basis; `BannerIndexRequest` hanya memakai `q`, `status`, dan `urut`.
10. Tidak ada perubahan JS atau SCSS; tidak ada `npm run build`.

    private function cells(string $html, string $label): array
    {

        return array_map(fn (string $cell): string => trim(html_entity_decode(strip_tags($cell))), $matches[1]);

    public function test_index_filters_by_status_keyword_and_sort(): void

        $this->assertSame(['Alfa Promo', 'Beta Promo'], $titles(['q' => 'promo', 'urut' => 'judul']));
        $this->assertSame(['100% Gratis'], $titles(['q' => '%']), 'Tanda % pada kata kunci di-escape.');
        $this->assertSame(['Gamma Lama', 'Beta Promo', 'Alfa Promo', '100% Gratis'], $titles(['urut' => '-judul']));

    public function test_content_admin_adds_a_banner_with_an_image_and_the_audit_row_is_written(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->post(route('admin.banners.store'), $this->payload())
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.banners.index'))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Banner berhasil ditambahkan.');

        $banner = Banner::query()->sole();
        $this->assertSame('Promo Pemeriksaan Gratis', $banner->title);
        $this->assertSame('Berlaku sampai akhir bulan', $banner->subtitle);
        $this->assertSame('Lihat Dokter', $banner->button_label);
        $this->assertSame('/dokter', $banner->button_url);
        $this->assertSame(2, $banner->sort_order);
        $this->assertTrue($banner->is_active);
        $this->assertNull($banner->starts_at);
        $this->assertNull($banner->ends_at);

        $media = Media::query()->sole();
        $this->assertSame('image', $media->collection);
        $this->assertSame(Banner::class, $media->model_type);
        $this->assertSame($banner->id, $media->model_id);
        $this->assertSame('Banner promo pemeriksaan', $media->alt_text);
        $this->assertSame('public', $media->disk);
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('image/'.now()->format('Y/m'), $media->directory);
        $this->assertNotNull($media->thumb_path);
        Storage::disk('public')->assertExists($media->directory.'/'.$media->file_name);
        Storage::disk('public')->assertExists($media->thumb_path);

        $audit = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'banner.created')->sole();
        $this->assertSame('Banner "Promo Pemeriksaan Gratis" ditambahkan.', $audit->description);
        $this->assertSame($admin->id, $audit->user_id);
    }

    /**
     * Pesan `null` = cukup ada galat pada field itu (pesan persisnya bergantung pada aturan Laravel mana yang gagal lebih dulu).
     *
     * @return array<string, array{array<string, mixed>, string, string|null}>
     */
    public static function invalidInputs(): array
    {
        $linkMessage = 'Tautan harus berupa alamat internal (diawali /) atau URL https.';

        return [
            'judul kosong' => [['title' => ''], 'title', 'Judul banner wajib diisi.'],
            'tautan javascript' => [['button_url' => 'javascript:alert(1)'], 'button_url', $linkMessage],
            'tautan data' => [['button_url' => 'data:text/html,x'], 'button_url', $linkMessage],
            'tautan http' => [['button_url' => 'http://contoh.test/a'], 'button_url', $linkMessage],
            'tautan protokol relatif' => [['button_url' => '//evil.test/a'], 'button_url', $linkMessage],
            'tautan tanpa garis miring' => [['button_url' => 'dokter'], 'button_url', $linkMessage],
            'label tanpa tautan' => [['button_label' => 'Lihat', 'button_url' => ''], 'button_url', 'Tautan tombol wajib diisi bila label diisi.'],
            'tautan tanpa label' => [['button_label' => '', 'button_url' => '/dokter'], 'button_label', 'Label tombol wajib diisi bila tautan diisi.'],
            'selesai sebelum mulai' => [['starts_at' => '2026-10-20T08:00', 'ends_at' => '2026-10-10T08:00'], 'ends_at', 'Waktu selesai tayang harus setelah waktu mulai tayang.'],
            'selesai sama dengan mulai' => [['starts_at' => '2026-10-20T08:00', 'ends_at' => '2026-10-20T08:00'], 'ends_at', 'Waktu selesai tayang harus setelah waktu mulai tayang.'],
            'mulai bukan tanggal' => [['starts_at' => 'kapan-saja'], 'starts_at', 'Format waktu mulai tayang tidak valid.'],
            'gambar wajib' => [['image' => null], 'image', 'Gambar banner wajib dipilih.'],
            'alt wajib' => [['image_alt' => ''], 'image_alt', 'Teks alternatif banner wajib diisi.'],
            'banner terlalu kecil' => [['image' => 'SMALL'], 'image', 'Dimensi banner minimal 1200 x 400 piksel dan maksimal 6000 x 6000 piksel.'],
            'banner lebih dari 4 MB' => [['image' => 'BIG'], 'image', 'Ukuran banner maksimal 4 MB.'],
            'banner SVG berskrip' => [['image' => 'SVG'], 'image', null],
            'banner teks bernama jpg' => [['image' => 'TEXT'], 'image', null],
            'banner PHP berkepala JPEG' => [['image' => 'PHP'], 'image', null],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $override
     */
    #[DataProvider('invalidInputs')]
    public function test_store_rejects_invalid_input_and_stores_nothing(array $override, string $field, ?string $message): void
    {
        $override = array_map(fn ($value) => $this->materialize($value), $override);

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->from(route('admin.banners.create'))
            ->post(route('admin.banners.store'), $this->payload($override))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.banners.create'));

        $response->assertSessionHasErrors($field);
        $errors = session('errors')->get($field);

        if ($message === null) {
            $this->assertNotEmpty($errors);
        } else {
            $this->assertContains($message, $errors);
        }

        $this->assertSame(0, Banner::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, Media::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame([], Storage::disk('public')->allFiles());
    }
