```php
            ->post(route('admin.banners.store'), $this->payload(['id' => 999, 'created_at' => '2000-01-01 00:00:00']))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $banner = Banner::query()->sole();
        $this->assertNotSame(999, $banner->id);
        $this->assertNotSame('2000-01-01', $banner->created_at?->toDateString());
    }

    // --- Ubah ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_update_changes_fields_toggles_status_and_clears_the_button(): void
    {
        $banner = $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Banner Lama', 'button_label' => 'Lama', 'button_url' => '/dokter', 'is_active' => true]);
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'));

        $this->put(route('admin.banners.update', $banner), $this->payload([
            'title' => 'Banner Baru',
            'button_label' => '',
            'button_url' => '',
            'is_active' => '0',
            'image' => null,
            'image_alt' => '',
        ]))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.banners.index'))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Banner berhasil diperbarui.');

        $banner->refresh();
        $this->assertSame('Banner Baru', $banner->title);
        $this->assertNull($banner->button_label);
        $this->assertNull($banner->button_url);
        $this->assertFalse($banner->is_active);
        $this->assertSame('Nonaktif', $banner->scheduleLabel());
        $this->assertNotContains($banner->id, Banner::query()->currentlyActive()->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', ['action' => 'banner.updated']);
        $this->assertSame(0, Media::query()->count(), 'Update tanpa berkas tidak membuat media.');
    }

    public function test_replacing_the_image_removes_the_old_file_after_commit(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))->post(route('admin.banners.store'), $this->payload([
            'image' => ImageFixtures::jpeg(1600, 600, 'lama.jpg'),
            'image_alt' => 'Gambar lama',
        ]));
        $banner = Banner::query()->sole();
        $old = Media::query()->sole();
        $oldPath = $old->directory.'/'.$old->file_name;

        $this->put(route('admin.banners.update', $banner), $this->payload([
            'image' => ImageFixtures::jpeg(1500, 700, 'baru.jpg'),
            'image_alt' => 'Gambar baru',
        ]))->assertSessionHasNoErrors()->assertRedirect(route('admin.banners.index'));

        $new = Media::query()->sole();
        $this->assertNotSame($old->id, $new->id);
        $this->assertSame('Gambar baru', $new->alt_text);
        Storage::disk('public')->assertMissing($oldPath);
        Storage::disk('public')->assertExists($new->directory.'/'.$new->file_name);
    }

    public function test_update_without_a_new_image_keeps_the_current_one_and_a_changed_alt_updates_it(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))->post(route('admin.banners.store'), $this->payload(['image_alt' => 'Alt lama']));
        $banner = Banner::query()->sole();
        $media = Media::query()->sole();

        $this->put(route('admin.banners.update', $banner), $this->payload(['image' => null, 'image_alt' => '  Alt baru  ']))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.banners.index'));

        $same = Media::query()->sole();
        $this->assertSame($media->id, $same->id);
        $this->assertSame('Alt baru', $same->alt_text);
        Storage::disk('public')->assertExists($same->directory.'/'.$same->file_name);
    }

    public function test_update_with_an_empty_alt_is_rejected_while_an_image_exists_and_nothing_is_saved(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))->post(route('admin.banners.store'), $this->payload(['image_alt' => 'Alt lama']));
        $banner = Banner::query()->sole();

        $this->put(route('admin.banners.update', $banner), $this->payload(['title' => 'Judul Tidak Tersimpan', 'image' => null, 'image_alt' => '  ']))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['image_alt' => 'Teks alternatif banner wajib diisi.']);

        $this->assertSame('Alt lama', Media::query()->sole()->alt_text);
        $this->assertSame('Promo Pemeriksaan Gratis', $banner->fresh()->title);
    }

    public function test_update_may_leave_the_image_out_when_the_banner_has_none_yet(): void
    {
        $banner = $this->createBanner();

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->put(route('admin.banners.update', $banner), $this->payload(['image' => null, 'image_alt' => '']))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.banners.index'));

        $this->assertSame(0, Media::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_update_with_a_dangerous_upload_is_rejected_and_the_old_image_stays(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))->post(route('admin.banners.store'), $this->payload());
        $banner = Banner::query()->sole();
        $media = Media::query()->sole();
        $files = Storage::disk('public')->allFiles();

        $this->put(route('admin.banners.update', $banner), $this->payload(['image' => ImageFixtures::svgWithScript('banner.svg')]))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors('image');
        $this->put(route('admin.banners.update', $banner), $this->payload(['image' => ImageFixtures::phpWithJpegHeader()]))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors('image');

        $this->assertSame($media->id, Media::query()->sole()->id);
        $this->assertSame($files, Storage::disk('public')->allFiles());
    }

    // --- Hapus ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_deleting_a_banner_removes_the_row_its_media_rows_and_files(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');
        $this->actingAs($admin)->post(route('admin.banners.store'), $this->payload(['title' => 'Banner Dihapus']));
        $banner = Banner::query()->sole();
        $media = Media::query()->sole();
        $paths = [$media->directory.'/'.$media->file_name, $media->thumb_path];

        $this->delete(route('admin.banners.destroy', $banner))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.banners.index'))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Banner berhasil dihapus.');

        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('banners', ['id' => $banner->id]);
        $this->assertSame(0, Media::query()->count());

        foreach ($paths as $path) {
            Storage::disk('public')->assertMissing($path);
        }

        $audit = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'banner.deleted')->sole();
        $this->assertSame('Banner "Banner Dihapus" dihapus.', $audit->description);
    }

    public function test_super_admin_can_delete_an_active_banner_too(): void
    {
        $banner = $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Banner Aktif']);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('super-admin'))
            ->delete(route('admin.banners.destroy', $banner))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.banners.index'));

        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('banners', ['id' => $banner->id]);
    }

    /**
     * Penanda berkas diubah menjadi UploadedFile di dalam tes (data provider berjalan sebelum GD siap).
     */
    private function materialize(mixed $value): mixed
    {
        return match ($value) {
            'SMALL' => ImageFixtures::jpeg(1000, 300, 'kecil.jpg'),
            'BIG' => ImageFixtures::oversizedJpeg(4200, 1600, 600, 'besar.jpg'),
            'SVG' => ImageFixtures::svgWithScript('banner.svg'),
            'TEXT' => ImageFixtures::textNamedJpg(),
            'PHP' => ImageFixtures::phpWithJpegHeader(),
            default => $value,
        };
    }
}
```

```php
    public function test_index_apply_to_orders_by_sort_order_then_id_and_escapes_like_characters(): void
    {
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'C Terakhir', 'sort_order' => 5]);
        $first = $this->createBanner(['title' => 'A Sama', 'sort_order' => 1]);
        $second = $this->createBanner(['title' => 'B Sama', 'sort_order' => 1]);
        $this->createBanner(['title' => '50% Diskon_Sehat', 'sort_order' => 9, 'is_active' => false]);

        $ids = fn (array $query): array => $this->indexRequest($query)->applyTo(Banner::query())->pluck('id')->all();
        $titles = fn (array $query): array => $this->indexRequest($query)->applyTo(Banner::query())->pluck('title')->all();

        $this->assertSame([$first->id, $second->id], array_slice($ids([]), 0, 2));
        $this->assertSame(['A Sama', 'B Sama', 'C Terakhir', '50% Diskon_Sehat'], $titles([]));
        $this->assertCount(1, $ids(['q' => '50%']));
        $this->assertCount(1, $ids(['q' => '_Sehat']));
        $this->assertCount(0, $ids(['q' => '%%']));
        $this->assertCount(3, $ids(['status' => 'aktif']));
        $this->assertCount(1, $ids(['status' => 'nonaktif']));
        $this->assertSame(['50% Diskon_Sehat', 'A Sama', 'B Sama', 'C Terakhir'], $titles(['urut' => 'judul']));
        $this->assertSame(['C Terakhir', 'B Sama', 'A Sama', '50% Diskon_Sehat'], $titles(['urut' => '-judul']));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Policies;

/**
```

`app/Http/Requests/Admin/BannerIndexRequest.php`

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

/**
 * Filter daftar banner (F4A-R14): `q` pada `title`, `status` aktif/nonaktif, `urut` urutan/judul (awalan "-" = menurun).
 * Parameter yang tidak valid diabaikan oleh basis (12 V-45), tidak pernah menjadi galat 500.
 */
class BannerIndexRequest extends ListFilterRequest
{
    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    protected function statusValues(): array
    {
        return ['aktif', 'nonaktif'];
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    protected function sortable(): array
    {
        return ['urutan', 'judul'];
    }

    /**
     * Tanpa `urut` dipakai scope ordered() (sort_order lalu id). Karakter `%`, `_`, dan `\` pada kata kunci di-escape.
     *
     * @param  Builder<Model>  $query
     * @return Builder<Model>
     */
    public function applyTo(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        $filters = $this->filters();
        $model = $query->getModel();

        if (isset($filters['q'])) {
            $like = '%'.str_replace(['\\', '%', '_'], ['\\\\', '\\%', '\\_'], $filters['q']).'%';
            $query->where($model->qualifyColumn('title'), 'like', $like);
        }

        $status = $filters['status'] ?? null;

        if ($status === 'aktif' || $status === 'nonaktif') {
            $query->where($model->qualifyColumn('is_active'), $status === 'aktif');
        }

        $sort = $filters['urut'] ?? null;

        if ($sort === null) {
            return $query->ordered()->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('id'));
        }

        $direction = str_starts_with($sort, '-') ? 'desc' : 'asc';

        if (ltrim($sort, '-') === 'judul') {
            return $query->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('title'), $direction)->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('id'));
        }

        return $query
            ->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('sort_order'), $direction)
            ->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('id'), $direction);
    }
}
```

`app/Http/Requests/Admin/BannerRequest.php`

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Models\Banner;
use App\Rules\ImageRules;
use App\Rules\InternalOrHttpsUrl;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;

/**
 * V-31 + BR-124 + F4A-R26. Satu kelas untuk tambah dan ubah (dibedakan dari parameter route `banner`).
 * `image` wajib saat tambah; saat ubah opsional (alt tanpa berkas memperbarui gambar yang ada, D-57).
 * `starts_at`/`ends_at` dikirim sebagai `datetime-local` (`Y-m-d\TH:i`) dan ditafsirkan dalam zona aplikasi.
 */
class BannerRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $user = $this->user();
        $banner = $this->route('banner');

        if ($user === null) {
            return false;
        }

        return $banner instanceof Banner
            ? $user->can('update', $banner)
            : $user->can('create', Banner::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        $banner = $this->route('banner');

        return [
            'title' => ['bail', 'required', 'string', 'min:3', 'max:100'],
            'subtitle' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:200'],
            'button_label' => ['nullable', 'required_with:button_url', 'string', 'max:30'],
            'button_url' => ['nullable', 'required_with:button_label', 'string', 'max:255', new InternalOrHttpsUrl],
            'sort_order' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'between:0,9999'],
            'is_active' => ['required', 'boolean'],
            'starts_at' => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'ends_at' => $this->endsAtRules(),
            'image' => $banner instanceof Banner
                ? ['nullable', ...ImageRules::for('image')]
                : ['bail', 'required', ...ImageRules::for('image')],
            'image_alt' => ['required_with:image', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * `after:starts_at` hanya dipasang bila `starts_at` terisi dan dapat diparse; tanpa itu Laravel membandingkan
     * dengan teks harfiah "starts_at".
     *
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    private function endsAtRules(): array
    {
        $rules = ['nullable', 'date'];
        $start = $this->input('starts_at');

        if (is_string($start) && trim($start) !== '' && strtotime($start) !== false) {
            $rules[] = 'after:starts_at';
        }

        return $rules;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return array_merge(
            ImageRules::messages('image', 'image'),
            [
                'title.required' => 'Judul banner wajib diisi.',
                'title.string' => 'Judul banner harus berupa teks.',
                'title.min' => 'Judul banner minimal 3 karakter.',
                'title.max' => 'Judul banner maksimal 100 karakter.',
                'subtitle.string' => 'Subjudul banner harus berupa teks.',
                'subtitle.max' => 'Subjudul banner maksimal 200 karakter.',
                'button_label.required_with' => 'Label tombol wajib diisi bila tautan diisi.',
                'button_label.string' => 'Label tombol harus berupa teks.',
                'button_label.max' => 'Label tombol maksimal 30 karakter.',
                'button_url.required_with' => 'Tautan tombol wajib diisi bila label diisi.',
                'button_url.string' => 'Tautan tombol harus berupa teks.',
                'button_url.max' => 'Tautan tombol maksimal 255 karakter.',
                'sort_order.integer' => 'Urutan harus berupa angka bulat.',
                'sort_order.between' => 'Urutan harus antara 0 dan 9999.',
                'is_active.required' => 'Status aktif tidak valid.',
                'is_active.boolean' => 'Status aktif tidak valid.',
                'starts_at.date' => 'Format waktu mulai tayang tidak valid.',
                'ends_at.date' => 'Format waktu selesai tayang tidak valid.',
                'ends_at.after' => 'Waktu selesai tayang harus setelah waktu mulai tayang.',
                'image.required' => 'Gambar banner wajib dipilih.',
                'image_alt.required_with' => 'Teks alternatif banner wajib diisi.',
                'image_alt.string' => 'Teks alternatif banner harus berupa teks.',
                'image_alt.max' => 'Teks alternatif banner maksimal 255 karakter.',
            ],
        );
    }

    public function withValidator(Validator $validator): void
    {
        $validator->after(function (Validator $validator): void {
            $this->validateExistingImageAlt($validator);
        });
    }

    /**
     * Alt gambar wajib untuk koleksi publik (BR-132): bila banner sudah punya gambar dan form mengirim alt kosong
     * tanpa berkas baru, tolak (alt lama tetap). Dengan berkas baru, `required_with:image` sudah menjaganya.
     */
    private function validateExistingImageAlt(Validator $validator): void
    {
        $banner = $this->route('banner');

        if (! $banner instanceof Banner || $this->imageFile() !== null || ! $this->has('image_alt') || $this->imageAlt() !== '') {
            return;
        }

        if ($banner->media()->where('collection', 'image')->exists()) {
            $validator->errors()->add('image_alt', 'Teks alternatif banner wajib diisi.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Atribut model hasil validasi (hanya kunci yang boleh diisi form).
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function bannerAttributes(): array
    {
        $data = $this->validated();

        return [
            'title' => trim((string) $data['title']),
            'subtitle' => $this->blankToNull($data['subtitle'] ?? null),
            'button_label' => $this->blankToNull($data['button_label'] ?? null),
            'button_url' => $this->blankToNull($data['button_url'] ?? null),
            'sort_order' => (int) ($data['sort_order'] ?? 0),
            'is_active' => (bool) $data['is_active'],
            'starts_at' => $this->blankToNull($data['starts_at'] ?? null),
            'ends_at' => $this->blankToNull($data['ends_at'] ?? null),
        ];
    }

    public function imageFile(): ?UploadedFile
    {
        $file = $this->file('image');

        return $file instanceof UploadedFile ? $file : null;
    }

    public function imageAlt(): string
    {
        $alt = $this->input('image_alt');

        return is_string($alt) ? trim($alt) : '';
    }

    private function blankToNull(mixed $value): ?string
    {
        return is_string($value) && trim($value) !== '' ? trim($value) : null;
    }
}
```

`app/Http/Controllers/Admin/BannerController.php`

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\BannerIndexRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\BannerRequest;
use App\Models\Banner;
use App\Services\Media\MediaService;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Halaman #39, tab Banner (F-ADM-19). Hapus permanen: baris `media` dan berkasnya ikut dibersihkan oleh
 * trait HasMedia; transaksi wajib agar berkas dihapus setelah commit.
 */
class BannerController extends Controller
{
    public function index(BannerIndexRequest $request): View
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', Banner::class);

        $banners = $request
            ->applyTo(Banner::query()->with('media'))
            ->paginate($request->perPage());

        return view('admin.banners.index', ['banners' => $banners]);
    }

    public function create(): View
    {
        $this->authorize('create', Banner::class);

        return view('admin.banners.create');
    }

    public function store(BannerRequest $request, MediaService $media): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', Banner::class);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $media): void {
            $banner = Banner::query()->create($request->bannerAttributes());
            $this->saveImage($request, $media, $banner);
        });

        return redirect()->route('admin.banners.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.created', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.banner')]));
    }

    public function edit(Banner $banner): View
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $banner);

        return view('admin.banners.edit', ['banner' => $banner->load('media')]);
    }

    public function update(BannerRequest $request, Banner $banner, MediaService $media): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $banner);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $media, $banner): void {
            $banner->update($request->bannerAttributes());
            $this->saveImage($request, $media, $banner);
        });

        return redirect()->route('admin.banners.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.updated', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.banner')]));
    }

    public function destroy(Banner $banner): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $banner);

        DB::transaction(fn (): ?bool => $banner->delete());

        return redirect()->route('admin.banners.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.deleted', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.banner')]));
    }

    private function saveImage(BannerRequest $request, MediaService $media, Banner $banner): void
    {
        $file = $request->imageFile();

        if ($file !== null) {
            $media->replace($banner, 'image', $file, ['alt_text' => $request->imageAlt()], $request->user());

            return;
        }

        if ($request->has('image_alt')) {
            // Tanpa berkas baru: alt yang diedit diterapkan ke gambar yang ada (caption tidak diubah).
            $existing = $banner->media()->where('collection', 'image')->first();

            if ($existing !== null && $existing->alt_text !== $request->imageAlt()) {
                $media->updateMeta($existing, $request->imageAlt(), $existing->caption);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

  - T2: `App\Models\ArticleCategory` (`$fillable`: `name, slug, description, sort_order`; `articles(): HasMany`; `scopeOrdered()` = `sort_order, name, id`; `slugMaxLength()` 120; slug dari `name` lewat `HasUniqueSlug`), `App\Models\Article` (`SoftDeletes`; FK `article_category_id` `nullOnDelete`), `Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent::createArticleCategory()`/`createArticle()`.
  - T3: `AuditObserver` untuk `ArticleCategory` (aksi `article_category.*`, nama dari `name`), `messages.entities.article_category` = "Kategori artikel".
  - T5: grup route konten dengan penanda `// Task 7: kategori artikel` (delapan spasi), tab modul `content`.
  - Fase 2: `App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest` (basis: `q`, `per_page`, `page`; `filters()`, `perPage()`), `App\Rules\NoHtml`, `x-data-table`, `x-form.input`, `x-form.textarea`, `x-confirm-modal`.
- Produces:
  - `App\Policies\ArticleCategoryPolicy` (`final`; semua method = `content.manage`).
  - `App\Http\Requests\Admin\ArticleCategoryRequest` (V-33; `categoryAttributes(): array`).
  - `App\Http\Controllers\Admin\ArticleCategoryController` (`index`, `create`, `store`, `edit`, `update`, `destroy`).
  - Route `admin.article-categories.index|create|store|edit|update|destroy` → `/admin/konten/kategori-artikel`, `/admin/konten/kategori-artikel/buat`, `/admin/konten/kategori-artikel/{articleCategory}/ubah`, `/admin/konten/kategori-artikel/{articleCategory}`, semuanya `permission:content.manage`.
  - Flash `success`: "Kategori artikel berhasil ditambahkan." / "Kategori artikel berhasil diperbarui." / "Kategori artikel berhasil dihapus.".

**Test IDs:** AKS #39 (baris `admin.article-categories.*`), VAL (V-33), CRD-08 sisi admin (kategori artikel), Review Focus 5 (hapus kategori membuat artikel menjadi tanpa kategori, termasuk untuk Super Admin).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **Kelas filter dasar.** F4A-R14: kategori artikel memakai `App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest` apa adanya. Kelas itu tidak punya `applyTo()`; controller membaca `$request->filters()['q']` dan menerapkan `LIKE` ter-escape (`\`, `%`, `_`) pada `name` (pola `MasterDataIndexRequest::applyTo`, `app/Http/Requests/Admin/MasterDataIndexRequest.php:41-48`). Karena `sortable()` kosong, parameter `urut` diabaikan dan urutan tetap `ordered()`.
2. **Jumlah artikel** memakai `withCount('articles')`. Karena `Article` memakai `SoftDeletes`, artikel yang dihapus lunak tidak dihitung; draf dan terjadwal ikut dihitung (jumlah artikel di kategori, bukan jumlah yang tayang).
3. **Hapus kategori.** FK `articles.article_category_id` berasaskan `ON DELETE SET NULL` (T1), sehingga hapus permanen kategori mengosongkan kategori pada artikel, termasuk artikel yang sudah dihapus lunak. Tidak ada aturan rujukan yang menolak hapus (09 §6.2); Super Admin dan Admin Konten sama.
4. **Nama unik.** `Rule::unique('article_categories', 'name')` hanya menjaga di level aplikasi (DB hanya UNIQUE `slug`; digest-data CELAH C-4). Pemeriksaan tidak peka huruf besar-kecil karena kolasi bawaan `utf8mb4_unicode_ci` (`config/database.php:57`); tes "beda huruf besar-kecil" bergantung pada kolasi itu.
5. **Slug.** Tidak ada input slug (F4A-R7). Slug dibuat sistem dari `name` saat `creating`, dipotong 120, dan tidak berubah saat nama diubah. Dua nama berbeda yang menghasilkan slug sama (mis. "Gizi" dan "Gizi!") mendapat sufiks `-2`.
6. **`description` mengandung NAME_ONLY.** `AuditLogger::NAME_ONLY` (`app/Services/Audit/AuditLogger.php:46`) mengganti nilai `description` pada audit menjadi `[konten diubah]`; tes audit hanya memeriksa `action` dan `description` baris audit, bukan nilai kolom.
7. **Pesan `NoHtml`.** Pola `SpecialtyRequest` (`app/Http/Requests/Admin/SpecialtyRequest.php:63`) memetakan kegagalan `NoHtml` lewat kunci `description.no_html`.
8. **Mode ketat.** Daftar tidak memakai relasi lain selain `articles_count`; tes memakai empat kategori.
9. Tidak ada perubahan JS atau SCSS; tidak ada `npm run build`.

```php
<?php

class AdminArticleCategoriesTest extends TestCase

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides

    private function payload(array $overrides = []): array
    {

            'sort_order' => '3',
        ], $overrides);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function cells(string $html, string $label): array
    {
        preg_match_all('/data-label="'.preg_quote($label, '/').'">\s*(.*?)\s*<\/td>/s', $html, $matches);

        return array_map(fn (string $cell): string => trim(html_entity_decode(strip_tags($cell))), $matches[1]);
    }

    public static function deleters(): array

    #[DataProvider('deleters')]
    public function test_deleting_a_category_leaves_its_articles_without_a_category(string $role): void
    {
        $category = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Akan Dihapus']);
        $published = $this->createArticle([], $category);
        $draft = $this->createArticle(['status' => 'draft', 'published_at' => null], $category);
        $trashed = $this->createArticle([], $category);
        $trashed->delete();
        $untouched = $this->createArticle([], $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Tetap Ada']));

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff($role))
            ->delete(route('admin.article-categories.destroy', $category))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.article-categories.index'))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Kategori artikel berhasil dihapus.');

        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('article_categories', ['id' => $category->id]);
        $this->assertNull($published->fresh()->article_category_id);
        $this->assertNull($draft->fresh()->article_category_id);
        $this->assertNull(Article::withTrashed()->findOrFail($trashed->id)->article_category_id);
        $this->assertNotNull($untouched->fresh()->article_category_id);
        $this->assertSame(4, Article::withTrashed()->count(), 'Tidak ada artikel yang ikut terhapus.');

        $audit = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'article_category.deleted')->sole();
        $this->assertSame('Kategori artikel "Akan Dihapus" dihapus.', $audit->description);
    }

    public function test_deleting_an_empty_category_works_and_the_list_updates(): void
    {
        $category = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Kosong']);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->delete(route('admin.article-categories.destroy', $category))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.article-categories.index'));

        $this->get(route('admin.article-categories.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertDontSee('Kosong')
            ->assertSee('Belum ada kategori artikel');
    }
}
```

```php
            'nama bukan teks' => [['name' => ['a']], 'name', 'Nama kategori harus berupa teks.'],

            'nama terlalu panjang' => [['name' => str_repeat('a', 101)], 'name', 'Nama kategori maksimal 100 karakter.'],
            'nama ganda' => [['name' => 'Kesehatan Umum'], 'name', 'Nama kategori sudah digunakan.'],
            'nama ganda beda huruf' => [['name' => 'KESEHATAN UMUM'], 'name', 'Nama kategori sudah digunakan.'],
            'deskripsi bukan teks' => [['description' => ['a']], 'description', 'Deskripsi harus berupa teks.'],
            'deskripsi terlalu panjang' => [['description' => str_repeat('a', 256)], 'description', 'Deskripsi maksimal 255 karakter.'],
            'deskripsi berisi tag' => [['description' => 'Teks <b>tebal</b>'], 'description', 'Deskripsi tidak boleh mengandung tag HTML.'],
            'deskripsi berisi script' => [['description' => '<script>alert(1)</script>'], 'description', 'Deskripsi tidak boleh mengandung tag HTML.'],
            'urutan bukan angka' => [['sort_order' => 'abc'], 'sort_order', 'Urutan harus berupa angka bulat.'],
            'urutan negatif' => [['sort_order' => '-1'], 'sort_order', 'Urutan harus antara 0 dan 9999.'],
            'urutan terlalu besar' => [['sort_order' => '10000'], 'sort_order', 'Urutan harus antara 0 dan 9999.'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $override
     */
    #[DataProvider('invalidInputs')]
    public function test_invalid_input_is_rejected_with_indonesian_messages_on_create(array $override, string $field, string $message): void
    {
        $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Kesehatan Umum']);

        $errors = $this->validationErrors(ArticleCategoryRequest::class, $this->validPayload($override));

        $this->assertArrayHasKey($field, $errors);
        $this->assertSame($message, $errors[$field][0]);
    }

    public function test_the_same_rules_apply_on_update_but_the_own_name_is_allowed(): void
    {
        $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Kesehatan Umum']);
        $category = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Gizi']);

        $own = $this->validationErrors(ArticleCategoryRequest::class, $this->validPayload(['name' => 'Gizi']), null, ['articleCategory' => $category], 'PUT');
        $this->assertSame([], $own);

        $ownOtherCase = $this->validationErrors(ArticleCategoryRequest::class, $this->validPayload(['name' => 'GIZI']), null, ['articleCategory' => $category], 'PUT');
        $this->assertSame([], $ownOtherCase);

        $taken = $this->validationErrors(ArticleCategoryRequest::class, $this->validPayload(['name' => 'Kesehatan Umum']), null, ['articleCategory' => $category], 'PUT');
        $this->assertSame('Nama kategori sudah digunakan.', $taken['name'][0]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{array<string, mixed>}>
     */
    public static function validVariants(): array
    {
        return [
            'lengkap' => [[]],
            'tanpa deskripsi' => [['description' => '']],
            'deskripsi null' => [['description' => null]],
            'tanpa urutan' => [['sort_order' => '']],
            'urutan 0' => [['sort_order' => '0']],
            'urutan 9999' => [['sort_order' => '9999']],
            'batas panjang' => [['name' => str_repeat('a', 100), 'description' => str_repeat('b', 255)]],
            'teks dengan tanda lebih kecil' => [['description' => 'Tekanan <90 dan >100 perlu diperiksa']],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $override
     */
    #[DataProvider('validVariants')]
    public function test_valid_variants_pass(array $override): void
    {
        $this->assertSame([], $this->validationErrors(ArticleCategoryRequest::class, $this->validPayload($override)));
    }

    public function test_category_attributes_contain_only_the_editable_columns(): void
    {
        $request = $this->makeFormRequest(ArticleCategoryRequest::class, $this->validPayload([
            'name' => '  Gizi Anak  ',
            'description' => '   ',
            'sort_order' => '',
            'slug' => 'dipaksa',
            'id' => '99',
        ]));
        $request->validateResolved();

        $this->assertSame([
            'name' => 'Gizi Anak',
            'description' => null,
            'sort_order' => 0,
        ], $request->categoryAttributes());
    }

    public function test_only_staff_with_content_manage_may_use_the_request(): void
    {
        $officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $category = $this->createArticleCategory();

        $this->assertTrue($this->makeFormRequest(ArticleCategoryRequest::class, [])->authorize());
        $this->assertTrue($this->makeFormRequest(ArticleCategoryRequest::class, [], $this->createStaff('super-admin'), ['articleCategory' => $category], 'PUT')->authorize());
        $this->assertFalse($this->makeFormRequest(ArticleCategoryRequest::class, [], $officer)->authorize());
        $this->assertFalse($this->makeFormRequest(ArticleCategoryRequest::class, [], $officer, ['articleCategory' => $category], 'PUT')->authorize());

        $this->expectException(AuthorizationException::class);

        $this->validationErrors(ArticleCategoryRequest::class, $this->validPayload(), $officer);
    }
}
```

`app/Http/Requests/Admin/ArticleCategoryRequest.php`

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Models\ArticleCategory;
use App\Rules\NoHtml;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * V-33: satu kelas untuk tambah dan ubah (dibedakan dari parameter route `articleCategory`).
 * `slug` tidak ada di form: dibuat sistem saat `creating` dan tidak berubah (F4A-R7, BR-15).
 */
class ArticleCategoryRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $user = $this->user();
        $category = $this->route('articleCategory');

        if ($user === null) {
            return false;
        }

        return $category instanceof ArticleCategory
            ? $user->can('update', $category)
            : $user->can('create', ArticleCategory::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        $category = $this->route('articleCategory');
        $category = $category instanceof ArticleCategory ? $category : null;

        return [
            'name' => [
                'bail',
                'required',
                'string',
                'min:3',
                'max:100',
                Rule::unique('article_categories', 'name')->ignore($category),
            ],
            'description' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255', new NoHtml],
            'sort_order' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'between:0,9999'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'name.required' => 'Nama kategori wajib diisi.',
            'name.string' => 'Nama kategori harus berupa teks.',
            'name.min' => 'Nama kategori minimal 3 karakter.',
            'name.max' => 'Nama kategori maksimal 100 karakter.',
            'name.unique' => 'Nama kategori sudah digunakan.',
            'description.string' => 'Deskripsi harus berupa teks.',
            'description.max' => 'Deskripsi maksimal 255 karakter.',
            'description.no_html' => 'Deskripsi tidak boleh mengandung tag HTML.',
            'sort_order.integer' => 'Urutan harus berupa angka bulat.',
            'sort_order.between' => 'Urutan harus antara 0 dan 9999.',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Atribut model hasil validasi (hanya kunci yang boleh diisi form; `slug` tidak termasuk).
     *
     * @return array{name: string, description: ?string, sort_order: int}
     */
    public function categoryAttributes(): array
    {
        $data = $this->validated();
        $description = $data['description'] ?? null;

        return [
            'name' => trim((string) $data['name']),
            'description' => is_string($description) && trim($description) !== '' ? trim($description) : null,
            'sort_order' => (int) ($data['sort_order'] ?? 0),
        ];
    }
}
```

`app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ArticleCategoryController.php`

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\ArticleCategoryRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest;
use App\Models\ArticleCategory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Halaman #39, tab Kategori Artikel (F-ADM-20). Hapus permanen: artikel di kategori itu menjadi tanpa kategori
 * lewat FK `nullOnDelete`, sehingga tidak ada aturan rujukan yang menolak hapus.
 */
class ArticleCategoryController extends Controller
{
    public function index(ListFilterRequest $request): View
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', ArticleCategory::class);

        $term = $request->filters()['q'] ?? null;

        $categories = ArticleCategory::query()
            ->withCount('articles')
            ->when($term !== null, fn (Builder $query): Builder => $query->where('name', 'like', $this->like($term)))
            ->ordered()
            ->paginate($request->perPage());

        return view('admin.article-categories.index', ['categories' => $categories]);
    }

    public function create(): View
    {
        $this->authorize('create', ArticleCategory::class);

        return view('admin.article-categories.create');
    }

    public function store(ArticleCategoryRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', ArticleCategory::class);

        DB::transaction(fn (): ArticleCategory => ArticleCategory::query()->create($request->categoryAttributes()));

        return redirect()->route('admin.article-categories.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.created', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.article_category')]));
    }

    public function edit(ArticleCategory $articleCategory): View
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $articleCategory);

        return view('admin.article-categories.edit', ['category' => $articleCategory]);
    }

    public function update(ArticleCategoryRequest $request, ArticleCategory $articleCategory): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $articleCategory);

        DB::transaction(fn (): bool => $articleCategory->update($request->categoryAttributes()));

        return redirect()->route('admin.article-categories.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.updated', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.article_category')]));
    }

    public function destroy(ArticleCategory $articleCategory): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $articleCategory);

        DB::transaction(fn (): ?bool => $articleCategory->delete());

        return redirect()->route('admin.article-categories.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.deleted', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.article_category')]));
    }

    /**
     * Pola LIKE dengan karakter `\`, `%`, dan `_` di-escape agar kata kunci diperlakukan sebagai teks biasa.
     */
    private function like(string $term): string
    {
        return '%'.str_replace(['\\', '%', '_'], ['\\\\', '\\%', '\\_'], $term).'%';
    }
}
```

  - T7: `ArticleCategory` yang dapat dikelola (opsi kategori pada form).
  - Fase 2: `App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest`, `App\Enums\ArticleStatus` (`options()`, label "Draf"/"Terbit"), `App\Services\Content\HtmlSanitizer`, `App\Services\Media\MediaService` (`replace`, `updateMeta`), `x-form.rich-text`, `x-form.radio-group`, `x-form.select`, `x-form.file`, `x-status-badge`, `x-data-table`.
- Produces:
  - `App\Policies\ArticlePolicy` (`final`; semua method = `content.manage`).
  - `App\Http\Requests\Admin\ArticleIndexRequest extends ListFilterRequest` (`applyTo(Builder $query): Builder`; status `draf|terbit`; `kategori` slug yang ada; urut `terbaru|judul`; `q` pada `title`).
  - `App\Http\Requests\Admin\ArticleRequest` (V-32, F4A-R10, F4A-R11; `articleAttributes(): array`, `coverFile(): ?UploadedFile`, `coverAlt(): string`).
  - `App\Http\Controllers\Admin\ArticleController` (`index`, `create`, `store`, `edit`, `update`, `destroy`).
  - Route `admin.articles.index|create|store|edit|update|destroy` → `/admin/konten/artikel`, `/admin/konten/artikel/buat`, `/admin/konten/artikel/{article}/ubah`, `/admin/konten/artikel/{article}`, semuanya `permission:content.manage`.
  - Flash `success`: "Artikel berhasil ditambahkan." / "Artikel berhasil diperbarui." / "Artikel berhasil dihapus.".
  - Pesan galat baru: "Isi artikel wajib diisi." juga untuk isi yang kosong setelah sanitasi (F4A-R11).

**Test IDs:** AKS #39 (baris `admin.articles.*`), VAL (V-32), MED-01/MED-02 (cover), CRD-08 sisi admin (artikel draf/terbit/terjadwal), Review Focus 1 (sisi admin: terjadwal dan kembali ke draf), Review Focus 2 (`<script>`, `onerror`, `javascript:`, isi kosong setelah sanitasi pada `articles.body`), Review Focus 4 (unggahan berbahaya pada cover), Review Focus 5 (soft delete, slug tidak dipakai ulang).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **Sanitasi di model, penolakan kosong di request.** `articles.body` NOT NULL, sedangkan `SanitizesRichText` menyimpan hasil kosong sebagai NULL (`app/Models/Concerns/SanitizesRichText.php:33-40`, D-58). `ArticleRequest::withValidator()->after()` menolak isi yang kosong secara visual setelah `HtmlSanitizer::clean()` dengan pesan "Isi artikel wajib diisi." (F4A-R11). Contoh yang lolos `min:50` tetapi kosong: `<p>&nbsp;</p>` diulang enam kali, atau hanya `<script>` ditambah paragraf kosong.
2. **Aturan `published_at` (F4A-R10).** `status = published` dan `published_at` kosong → server mengisi `now()` (zona aplikasi). `published_at` di masa depan = terjadwal (belum tayang); `Article::isScheduled()` memunculkan label "Terjadwal" di daftar. Kembali ke `draft` tidak mengosongkan `published_at`: untuk draf, kolom ini hanya ditulis bila form mengirim nilai, sehingga nilai kosong pada draf mempertahankan tanggal yang ada. Nilai `datetime-local` yang sama menitnya dengan nilai tersimpan (detik dibuang oleh input) tidak ditulis ulang, agar detik tidak hilang dan audit tidak berisik.
3. **Penulis.** `author_user_id` diisi pengguna login hanya pada `store` (controller menambahkannya setelah atribut tervalidasi) dan tidak berubah pada `update`; kiriman klien diabaikan karena tidak ada di `rules()`.
4. **Soft delete dan media.** 09 menetapkan media artikel yang dihapus lunak dipertahankan dan tidak disentuh `media:prune`. Penjaga `isForceDeleting()` pada hook `deleting` di `HasMedia` sudah ditangani T3 (F4A-R32); hapus permanen (`forceDelete()`) tetap membersihkan media. Tes di bawah mengasersi kedua perilaku itu.
5. **Slug.** Tidak ada input slug (F4A-R7). Slug dari `title`, dipotong 220, tidak berubah saat judul diedit. Pemeriksaan bentrok menghitung baris soft-deleted (T3), sehingga judul yang sama dengan artikel terhapus mendapat `-2`, bukan galat UNIQUE.
6. **Urutan daftar.** Default `Article::newestFirst()` = `published_at` menurun lalu `id` menurun. Pada MySQL/MariaDB nilai NULL (draf tanpa tanggal) berada di akhir pada urutan menurun dan di awal pada urutan menaik; tes menegaskan perilaku ini.
7. **Mode ketat.** `index` memuat `with(['category', 'author'])`; `edit` memuat `load(['media', 'author'])`. Daftar tidak memakai media. Tes daftar memakai empat artikel yang tampil (Terbit, Lama, Terjadwal, Draf) dengan kategori dan penulis berbeda, ditambah satu artikel terhapus yang tidak boleh tampil.
8. **Pengikatan route.** Parameter `{article}` memakai binding id bawaan (batas numerik di `bootstrap/app.php`); artikel soft-deleted tidak ditemukan sehingga `edit`/`update` mengembalikan 404. Route publik memakai `{article:slug}` (T13) dan tidak terkait.
9. **Unggahan cover.** Koleksi `cover` tunggal, 2 MB, minimum 800 x 450 (`MediaService::COLLECTIONS`); pesan dari `ImageRules::messages('cover', 'cover')`. Pola penyimpanan sama dengan `BannerController::saveImage` (T6): `replace` untuk berkas baru, `updateMeta` bila hanya alt yang berubah, dan alt kosong ditolak selama cover ada.
10. **Judul layar.** "Artikel" (daftar), "Tambah Artikel", dan "Ubah {judul}" (05 §8.3).
11. Tidak ada perubahan JS atau SCSS; tidak ada `npm run build`.

```php
<?php

use Tests\Support\ImageFixtures;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMedia;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Admin #39, tab Artikel (T8, V-32, F4A-R10/R11): CRUD, draf/terbit/terjadwal, penulis, sanitasi isi,
 * cover, soft delete, dan slug yang tidak dipakai ulang.
 */
class AdminArticlesTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use InteractsWithMedia;

    private ArticleCategory $category;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Storage::fake('public');

        // Senin, 5 Oktober 2026 pukul 10.00 WIB.
        $this->travelTo(Carbon::parse('2026-10-05 10:00:00'));
        $this->category = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Kesehatan Umum']);

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function payload(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return array_merge([
            'title' => 'Menjaga Kesehatan Jantung Sejak Dini',
            'article_category_id' => (string) $this->category->id,
            'excerpt' => 'Kebiasaan sederhana untuk menjaga kesehatan jantung.',

            'meta_description' => '',

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function cells(string $html, string $label): array
    {
        preg_match_all('/data-label="'.preg_quote($label, '/').'">\s*(.*?)\s*<\/td>/s', $html, $matches);

        return array_map(
            fn (string $cell): string => preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', trim(html_entity_decode(strip_tags($cell)))) ?? '',
            $matches[1],
        );
    }

    public function test_content_admin_saves_a_draft_with_the_author_slug_and_audit_row(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->post(route('admin.articles.store'), $this->payload())
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.articles.index'))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Artikel berhasil ditambahkan.');

        $article = Article::query()->sole();
        $this->assertSame('Menjaga Kesehatan Jantung Sejak Dini', $article->title);
        $this->assertSame('menjaga-kesehatan-jantung-sejak-dini', $article->slug);
        $this->assertSame(ArticleStatus::Draft, $article->status);
        $this->assertNull($article->published_at);
        $this->assertSame($this->category->id, $article->article_category_id);
        $this->assertSame($admin->id, $article->author_user_id);
        $this->assertSame('Kebiasaan sederhana untuk menjaga kesehatan jantung.', $article->excerpt);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Isi artikel yang cukup panjang.', $article->body);
        $this->assertNull($article->meta_title);
        $this->assertNull($article->meta_description);
        $this->assertFalse($article->isPubliclyVisible());
        $this->assertNotContains($article->id, Article::query()->published()->pluck('id')->all());

        $audit = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'article.created')->sole();
        $this->assertSame('Artikel "Menjaga Kesehatan Jantung Sejak Dini" ditambahkan.', $audit->description);
        $this->assertSame($admin->id, $audit->user_id);
    }

    public function test_publishing_without_a_date_fills_published_at_with_now(): void
    {

            ->post(route('admin.articles.store'), $this->payload(['status' => 'published', 'published_at' => '']))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $article = Article::query()->sole();
        $this->assertSame(ArticleStatus::Published, $article->status);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-05 10:00:00', $article->published_at?->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'));
        $this->assertTrue($article->isPubliclyVisible());
        $this->assertFalse($article->isScheduled());
        $this->assertContains($article->id, Article::query()->published()->pluck('id')->all());

    public function test_a_future_published_at_makes_the_article_scheduled_and_not_yet_public(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->post(route('admin.articles.store'), $this->payload(['status' => 'published', 'published_at' => '2026-10-20T08:30']))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $article = Article::query()->sole();
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-20 08:30', $article->published_at?->format('Y-m-d H:i'));
        $this->assertTrue($article->isScheduled());
        $this->assertFalse($article->isPubliclyVisible());
        $this->assertNotContains($article->id, Article::query()->published()->pluck('id')->all());

    public static function invalidInputs(): array

            'meta description terlalu panjang' => [['meta_description' => str_repeat('a', 161)], 'meta_description', 'Meta description maksimal 160 karakter.'],
            'alt cover wajib' => [['cover' => 'FILE', 'cover_alt' => ''], 'cover_alt', 'Teks alternatif gambar sampul wajib diisi.'],
            'cover terlalu kecil' => [['cover' => 'SMALL', 'cover_alt' => 'x'], 'cover', 'Dimensi gambar minimal 800 x 450 piksel dan maksimal 6000 x 6000 piksel.'],
            'cover lebih dari 2 MB' => [['cover' => 'BIG', 'cover_alt' => 'x'], 'cover', 'Ukuran gambar maksimal 2 MB.'],

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $override

    #[DataProvider('invalidInputs')]
    public function test_store_rejects_invalid_input_and_stores_nothing(array $override, string $field, ?string $message): void
    {
        $override = array_map(fn ($value) => $this->materialize($value), $override);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->from(route('admin.articles.create'))
            ->post(route('admin.articles.store'), $this->payload($override))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.articles.create'))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors($field);

        $errors = session('errors')->get($field);

        if ($message === null) {
            $this->assertNotEmpty($errors);
        } else {
            $this->assertContains($message, $errors);
        }

        $this->assertSame(0, Article::withTrashed()->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, Media::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame([], Storage::disk('public')->allFiles());
    }

    public function test_update_changes_fields_keeps_the_slug_and_writes_the_audit_row(): void

        $author = $this->createStaff('content-admin');
        $article = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Judul Lama Artikel', 'slug' => 'judul-lama-artikel', 'author_user_id' => $author->id], $this->category);
        $other = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Gaya Hidup']);
        $editor = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $this->actingAs($editor)
            ->put(route('admin.articles.update', $article), $this->payload([
                'title' => 'Judul Baru Artikel',
                'article_category_id' => (string) $other->id,

            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.articles.index'))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Artikel berhasil diperbarui.');

        $article->refresh();
        $this->assertSame('Judul Baru Artikel', $article->title);
        $this->assertSame('judul-lama-artikel', $article->slug, 'Slug tidak berubah saat judul diedit.');
        $this->assertSame($other->id, $article->article_category_id);
        $this->assertSame('Meta baru', $article->meta_title);
        $this->assertSame('Deskripsi meta baru.', $article->meta_description);
        $this->assertSame($author->id, $article->author_user_id, 'Penulis tidak berubah saat diedit staf lain.');

        $audit = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'article.updated')->sole();
        $this->assertSame('Artikel "Judul Baru Artikel" diperbarui.', $audit->description);
        $this->assertSame($editor->id, $audit->user_id);

    public function test_going_back_to_draft_keeps_the_published_at_date(): void
    {
        $article = $this->createArticle(['status' => 'published', 'published_at' => '2026-10-01 08:00:00'], $this->category);
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'));

        // Form mengirim kembali tanggal yang tampil.
        $this->put(route('admin.articles.update', $article), $this->payload(['status' => 'draft', 'published_at' => '2026-10-01T08:00']))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
        $article->refresh();
        $this->assertSame(ArticleStatus::Draft, $article->status);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-01 08:00:00', $article->published_at?->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'));

        // Kolom tanggal dikosongkan oleh admin: draf tidak mengosongkan published_at.
        $this->put(route('admin.articles.update', $article), $this->payload(['status' => 'draft', 'published_at' => '']))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-01 08:00:00', $article->fresh()->published_at?->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'));
        $this->assertFalse($article->fresh()->isPubliclyVisible());
        $this->assertNotContains($article->id, Article::query()->published()->pluck('id')->all());
    }

    /**

    public static function deleters(): array
    {

    #[DataProvider('deleters')]
    public function test_destroy_is_a_soft_delete_that_keeps_the_row_and_writes_the_audit_row(string $role): void
    {
        $article = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Artikel Akan Dihapus'], $this->category);
        $admin = $this->createStaff($role);

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->delete(route('admin.articles.destroy', $article))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.articles.index'))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Artikel berhasil dihapus.');

        $this->assertSoftDeleted('articles', ['id' => $article->id]);
        $this->assertSame(1, Article::withTrashed()->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, Article::query()->count());

        $audit = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'article.deleted')->sole();
        $this->assertSame('Artikel "Artikel Akan Dihapus" dihapus.', $audit->description);
        $this->assertSame($admin->id, $audit->user_id);

        $this->get(route('admin.articles.index'))->assertOk()->assertDontSee('Artikel Akan Dihapus');

    public function test_soft_delete_keeps_the_cover_media_and_files_but_force_delete_removes_them(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))->post(route('admin.articles.store'), $this->payload([
            'cover' => ImageFixtures::jpeg(1200, 675),
            'cover_alt' => 'Cover artikel',
        ]));
        $article = Article::query()->sole();
        $media = Media::query()->sole();
        $paths = [$media->directory.'/'.$media->file_name, $media->thumb_path];

        $this->delete(route('admin.articles.destroy', $article))->assertRedirect(route('admin.articles.index'));

        $this->assertSoftDeleted('articles', ['id' => $article->id]);
        $this->assertSame(1, Media::query()->count(), 'Media artikel yang dihapus lunak dipertahankan.');

        foreach ($paths as $path) {
            Storage::disk('public')->assertExists($path);
        }

        Article::withTrashed()->findOrFail($article->id)->forceDelete();

        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('articles', ['id' => $article->id]);
        $this->assertSame(0, Media::query()->count());

        foreach ($paths as $path) {
            Storage::disk('public')->assertMissing($path);
        }
    }

    public function test_a_deleted_articles_slug_is_not_reused_by_a_new_article_with_the_same_title(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'));

        $this->post(route('admin.articles.store'), $this->payload())->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
        $first = Article::query()->sole();
        $this->assertSame('menjaga-kesehatan-jantung-sejak-dini', $first->slug);

        $this->delete(route('admin.articles.destroy', $first))->assertRedirect(route('admin.articles.index'));

        $this->post(route('admin.articles.store'), $this->payload())
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.articles.index'));

        $second = Article::query()->sole();
        $this->assertNotSame($first->id, $second->id);
        $this->assertSame('menjaga-kesehatan-jantung-sejak-dini-2', $second->slug);
        $this->assertSame(2, Article::withTrashed()->count());
    }

    /**
     * Penanda berkas diubah menjadi UploadedFile di dalam tes (data provider berjalan sebelum GD siap).
     */
    private function materialize(mixed $value): mixed
    {
        return match ($value) {
            'FILE' => ImageFixtures::jpeg(1200, 675),
            'SMALL' => ImageFixtures::jpeg(700, 400, 'kecil.jpg'),
            'BIG' => ImageFixtures::oversizedJpeg(2100, 1200, 675, 'besar.jpg'),
            'SVG' => ImageFixtures::svgWithScript('cover.svg'),
            'TEXT' => ImageFixtures::textNamedJpg(),
            'PHP' => ImageFixtures::phpWithJpegHeader(),
            default => $value,
        };
    }
}
```

```php
     * Konteks ubah: `cover` memang opsional di kedua konteks, tetapi konteks ubah memakai model nyata.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     * @return array<string, list<string>>
     */
    private function updateErrors(array $data): array
    {
        return $this->validationErrors(ArticleRequest::class, $data, null, ['article' => $this->createArticle()], 'PUT');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{array<string, mixed>, string, string}>
     */
    public static function invalidInputs(): array
    {
        return [
            'judul kosong' => [['title' => ''], 'title', 'Judul artikel wajib diisi.'],
            'judul bukan teks' => [['title' => ['a']], 'title', 'Judul artikel harus berupa teks.'],
            'judul terlalu pendek' => [['title' => 'Abcd'], 'title', 'Judul artikel minimal 5 karakter.'],
            'judul terlalu panjang' => [['title' => str_repeat('a', 151)], 'title', 'Judul artikel maksimal 150 karakter.'],
            'kategori bukan angka' => [['article_category_id' => 'abc'], 'article_category_id', 'Kategori artikel tidak valid.'],
            'kategori tidak tersedia' => [['article_category_id' => '999999'], 'article_category_id', 'Kategori artikel yang dipilih tidak tersedia.'],
            'ringkasan kosong' => [['excerpt' => ''], 'excerpt', 'Ringkasan artikel wajib diisi.'],
            'ringkasan bukan teks' => [['excerpt' => ['a']], 'excerpt', 'Ringkasan artikel harus berupa teks.'],
            'ringkasan terlalu panjang' => [['excerpt' => str_repeat('a', 301)], 'excerpt', 'Ringkasan artikel maksimal 300 karakter.'],
            'isi kosong' => [['body' => ''], 'body', 'Isi artikel wajib diisi.'],
            'isi bukan teks' => [['body' => ['a']], 'body', 'Isi artikel harus berupa teks.'],
            'isi terlalu pendek' => [['body' => '<p>Pendek</p>'], 'body', 'Isi artikel minimal 50 karakter.'],
            'isi terlalu panjang' => [['body' => str_repeat('a', 200001)], 'body', 'Isi artikel maksimal 200.000 karakter.'],
            'isi kosong setelah sanitasi (nbsp)' => [['body' => str_repeat('<p>&nbsp;</p>', 6)], 'body', 'Isi artikel wajib diisi.'],
            'isi kosong setelah sanitasi (script)' => [['body' => '<script>alert("xss")</script>'.str_repeat('<p><br></p>', 3)], 'body', 'Isi artikel wajib diisi.'],
            'status kosong' => [['status' => ''], 'status', 'Status artikel wajib dipilih.'],
            'status tidak valid' => [['status' => 'diarsipkan'], 'status', 'Status artikel tidak valid.'],
            'tanggal terbit tidak valid' => [['published_at' => 'kapan-saja'], 'published_at', 'Format tanggal terbit tidak valid.'],
            'meta title bukan teks' => [['meta_title' => ['a']], 'meta_title', 'Meta title harus berupa teks.'],
            'meta title terlalu panjang' => [['meta_title' => str_repeat('a', 71)], 'meta_title', 'Meta title maksimal 70 karakter.'],
            'meta description terlalu panjang' => [['meta_description' => str_repeat('a', 161)], 'meta_description', 'Meta description maksimal 160 karakter.'],
            'alt cover bukan teks' => [['cover_alt' => ['a']], 'cover_alt', 'Teks alternatif gambar sampul harus berupa teks.'],
            'alt cover terlalu panjang' => [['cover_alt' => str_repeat('a', 256)], 'cover_alt', 'Teks alternatif gambar sampul maksimal 255 karakter.'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $override
     */
    #[DataProvider('invalidInputs')]
    public function test_invalid_input_is_rejected_with_indonesian_messages(array $override, string $field, string $message): void
    {
        $errors = $this->updateErrors($this->validPayload($override));

        $this->assertArrayHasKey($field, $errors);
        $this->assertSame($message, $errors[$field][0]);

    public function test_a_valid_payload_passes_on_create_and_update(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame([], $this->validationErrors(ArticleRequest::class, $this->validPayload()));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->updateErrors($this->validPayload()));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{array<string, mixed>}>
     */
    public static function validVariants(): array
    {
        return [
            'diterbitkan tanpa tanggal' => [['status' => 'published', 'published_at' => '']],

    /**

    #[DataProvider('validVariants')]
    public function test_valid_variants_pass(array $override): void

    public function test_a_body_that_has_visible_text_after_sanitizing_is_accepted_even_when_it_contains_hostile_markup(): void
    {

        $this->assertSame([], $this->updateErrors($this->validPayload(['body' => $body])));

    // --- articleAttributes() (F4A-R10) -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function attributesFor(array $data, ?Article $article = null): array
    {
        $routeParameters = $article === null ? [] : ['article' => $article];
        $request = $this->makeFormRequest(ArticleRequest::class, $data, null, $routeParameters, $article === null ? 'POST' : 'PUT');
        $request->validateResolved();

        return $request->articleAttributes();
    }

    public function test_publishing_with_an_empty_date_fills_published_at_with_now(): void
    {
        $attributes = $this->attributesFor($this->validPayload(['status' => 'published', 'published_at' => '']));

        $this->assertSame(ArticleStatus::Published, $attributes['status']);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-05 10:00:00', $attributes['published_at']->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'));
    }

    public function test_a_given_date_is_passed_through_for_published_and_draft(): void
    {
        $published = $this->attributesFor($this->validPayload(['status' => 'published', 'published_at' => '2026-10-20T08:30']));
        $draft = $this->attributesFor($this->validPayload(['status' => 'draft', 'published_at' => '2026-10-01T08:00']));

        $this->assertSame('2026-10-20T08:30', $published['published_at']);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-01T08:00', $draft['published_at']);

    public function test_a_draft_without_a_date_does_not_touch_published_at(): void
    {
        $attributes = $this->attributesFor($this->validPayload(['status' => 'draft', 'published_at' => '']));

    {

        $same = $this->attributesFor($this->validPayload(['status' => 'published', 'published_at' => '2026-10-03T09:15']), $article);
        $changed = $this->attributesFor($this->validPayload(['status' => 'published', 'published_at' => '2026-10-03T09:16']), $article);

        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('published_at', $same);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-03T09:16', $changed['published_at']);

    public function test_an_empty_category_becomes_null(): void
    {
        $this->assertNull($this->attributesFor($this->validPayload(['article_category_id' => '']))['article_category_id']);
    }

    public function test_cover_helpers_trim_the_alt_and_return_null_without_a_file(): void
    {
        $request = $this->makeFormRequest(ArticleRequest::class, $this->validPayload(['cover_alt' => '  Cover  ']));

        $this->assertNull($request->coverFile());

    public function test_only_staff_with_content_manage_may_use_the_request(): void
    {
        $officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $article = $this->createArticle();

        $this->assertTrue($this->makeFormRequest(ArticleRequest::class, [])->authorize());
        $this->assertTrue($this->makeFormRequest(ArticleRequest::class, [], $this->createStaff('super-admin'), ['article' => $article], 'PUT')->authorize());
        $this->assertFalse($this->makeFormRequest(ArticleRequest::class, [], $officer)->authorize());
        $this->assertFalse($this->makeFormRequest(ArticleRequest::class, [], $officer, ['article' => $article], 'PUT')->authorize());

        $this->expectException(AuthorizationException::class);

        $this->validationErrors(ArticleRequest::class, $this->validPayload(), $officer);
    }

    /**

     */
    private function indexRequest(array $query): ArticleIndexRequest
    {
        $request = ArticleIndexRequest::create('/_uji/filter', 'GET', $query);
        $request->setContainer($this->app);
        $request->setRedirector($this->app->make('redirect'));

    public function test_index_filters_accept_valid_values(): void
    {
        $category = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Gizi', 'slug' => 'gizi']);

        $request = $this->indexRequest(['q' => 'jantung', 'status' => 'terbit', 'kategori' => $category->slug, 'urut' => '-judul']);

        $this->assertEquals(['q' => 'jantung', 'status' => 'terbit', 'kategori' => 'gizi', 'urut' => '-judul'], $request->filters());
    }

    public function test_index_filters_ignore_invalid_values_without_an_error(): void
    {
        $request = $this->indexRequest(['q' => str_repeat('a', 101), 'status' => 'zzz', 'kategori' => "\0", 'urut' => 'kuota', 'kembali' => 'https://situs-lain.test']);

        $this->assertSame([], $request->filters());

    public function test_index_filters_ignore_array_values(): void
    {
        $request = $this->indexRequest(['q' => ['x'], 'kategori' => ['x'], 'status' => ['x'], 'urut' => ['x']]);

        $this->assertSame([], $request->filters());
    }

    public function test_index_apply_to_filters_and_orders_the_query(): void
    {
        $gizi = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Gizi', 'slug' => 'gizi']);
        $umum = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Umum', 'slug' => 'umum']);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Bubur Sehat', 'published_at' => '2026-10-01 08:00:00'], $gizi);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Cuci Tangan', 'published_at' => '2026-10-03 08:00:00'], $umum);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Antibiotik 100%', 'status' => 'draft', 'published_at' => null], $umum);

        $titles = fn (array $query): array => $this->indexRequest($query)->applyTo(Article::query())->pluck('title')->all();

        $this->assertSame(['Cuci Tangan', 'Bubur Sehat', 'Antibiotik 100%'], $titles([]));
        $this->assertSame(['Antibiotik 100%'], $titles(['status' => 'draf']));
        $this->assertSame(['Cuci Tangan', 'Bubur Sehat'], $titles(['status' => 'terbit']));
        $this->assertSame(['Bubur Sehat'], $titles(['kategori' => 'gizi']));
        $this->assertSame(['Antibiotik 100%'], $titles(['q' => '100%']));
        $this->assertSame([], $titles(['q' => '%%']));
        $this->assertSame(['Antibiotik 100%', 'Bubur Sehat', 'Cuci Tangan'], $titles(['urut' => 'judul']));
        $this->assertSame(['Cuci Tangan', 'Bubur Sehat', 'Antibiotik 100%'], $titles(['urut' => '-judul']));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * Filter daftar artikel admin (F4A-R14): `q` pada `title`, `status` draf/terbit, `kategori` (slug yang ada),
 * `urut` terbaru/judul (awalan "-" = kebalikan). Parameter yang tidak valid diabaikan oleh basis (12 V-45).
 */
class ArticleIndexRequest extends ListFilterRequest
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::rules(), [
            'kategori' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:150', Rule::exists('article_categories', 'slug')],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    protected function statusValues(): array
    {
        return ['draf', 'terbit'];
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    protected function sortable(): array
    {
        return ['terbaru', 'judul'];
    }

    /**
     * Tanpa `urut` dipakai scope newestFirst() (published_at menurun, lalu id menurun). Karakter `%`, `_`, dan `\`
     * pada kata kunci di-escape.
     *
     * @param  Builder<Model>  $query
     * @return Builder<Model>
     */
    public function applyTo(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        $filters = $this->filters();
        $model = $query->getModel();

        if (isset($filters['q'])) {
            $like = '%'.str_replace(['\\', '%', '_'], ['\\\\', '\\%', '\\_'], $filters['q']).'%';
            $query->where($model->qualifyColumn('title'), 'like', $like);
        }

        $status = $filters['status'] ?? null;

        if ($status === 'draf' || $status === 'terbit') {
            $query->where($model->qualifyColumn('status'), $status === 'draf' ? 'draft' : 'published');
        }

        if (isset($filters['kategori'])) {
            $query->inCategory($filters['kategori']);
        }

        $sort = $filters['urut'] ?? null;

        if ($sort === null || $sort === 'terbaru') {
            return $query->newestFirst();
        }

        if ($sort === '-terbaru') {
            return $query->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('published_at'))->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('id'));
        }

        $direction = str_starts_with($sort, '-') ? 'desc' : 'asc';

        return $query->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('title'), $direction)->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('id'));
    }
}
```

`app/Http/Requests/Admin/ArticleRequest.php`

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Enums\ArticleStatus;
use App\Models\Article;
use App\Rules\ImageRules;
use App\Services\Content\HtmlSanitizer;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;

/**
 * V-32 + F4A-R10 + F4A-R11. Satu kelas untuk tambah dan ubah (dibedakan dari parameter route `article`).
 * `slug` dan `author_user_id` tidak ada di `rules()`: slug dibuat sistem (F4A-R7) dan penulis diisi controller.
 * HTML `body` dibersihkan oleh trait SanitizesRichText pada event `saving`; di sini hanya ditolak bila kosong
 * setelah sanitasi, karena `articles.body` NOT NULL (D-58 tidak dapat berlaku).
 */
class ArticleRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $user = $this->user();
        $article = $this->route('article');

        if ($user === null) {
            return false;
        }

        return $article instanceof Article
            ? $user->can('update', $article)
            : $user->can('create', Article::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'title' => ['bail', 'required', 'string', 'min:5', 'max:150'],
            'article_category_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', Rule::exists('article_categories', 'id')],
            'excerpt' => ['bail', 'required', 'string', 'max:300'],
            'body' => ['bail', 'required', 'string', 'min:50', 'max:200000'],
            'status' => ['bail', 'required', Rule::enum(ArticleStatus::class)],
            'published_at' => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'meta_title' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:70'],
            'meta_description' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:160'],
            'cover' => ['nullable', ...ImageRules::for('cover')],
            'cover_alt' => ['required_with:cover', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return array_merge(
            ImageRules::messages('cover', 'cover'),
            [
                'title.required' => 'Judul artikel wajib diisi.',
                'title.string' => 'Judul artikel harus berupa teks.',
                'title.min' => 'Judul artikel minimal 5 karakter.',
                'title.max' => 'Judul artikel maksimal 150 karakter.',
                'article_category_id.integer' => 'Kategori artikel tidak valid.',
                'article_category_id.exists' => 'Kategori artikel yang dipilih tidak tersedia.',
                'excerpt.required' => 'Ringkasan artikel wajib diisi.',
                'excerpt.string' => 'Ringkasan artikel harus berupa teks.',
                'excerpt.max' => 'Ringkasan artikel maksimal 300 karakter.',
                'body.required' => 'Isi artikel wajib diisi.',
                'body.string' => 'Isi artikel harus berupa teks.',
                'body.min' => 'Isi artikel minimal 50 karakter.',
                'body.max' => 'Isi artikel maksimal 200.000 karakter.',
                'status.required' => 'Status artikel wajib dipilih.',
                'status.enum' => 'Status artikel tidak valid.',
                'published_at.date' => 'Format tanggal terbit tidak valid.',
                'meta_title.string' => 'Meta title harus berupa teks.',
                'meta_title.max' => 'Meta title maksimal 70 karakter.',
                'meta_description.string' => 'Meta description harus berupa teks.',
                'meta_description.max' => 'Meta description maksimal 160 karakter.',
                'cover_alt.required_with' => 'Teks alternatif gambar sampul wajib diisi.',
                'cover_alt.string' => 'Teks alternatif gambar sampul harus berupa teks.',
                'cover_alt.max' => 'Teks alternatif gambar sampul maksimal 255 karakter.',
            ],
        );
    }

    public function withValidator(Validator $validator): void
    {
        $validator->after(function (Validator $validator): void {
            $this->validateBodyIsNotBlankAfterSanitizing($validator);
            $this->validateExistingCoverAlt($validator);
        });
    }

    /**
     * F4A-R11: isi yang lolos `min:50` tetapi kosong secara visual setelah sanitasi (mis. hanya `&nbsp;` atau
     * hanya `<script>`) ditolak dengan pesan yang sama dengan isi kosong.
     */
    private function validateBodyIsNotBlankAfterSanitizing(Validator $validator): void
    {
        if ($validator->errors()->has('body')) {
            return;
        }

        $body = $this->input('body');

        if (! is_string($body)) {
            return;
        }

        if (Article::isBlankRichText(app(HtmlSanitizer::class)->clean($body))) {
            $validator->errors()->add('body', 'Isi artikel wajib diisi.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Alt cover wajib untuk koleksi publik (BR-132): bila artikel sudah punya cover dan form mengirim alt kosong
     * tanpa berkas baru, tolak (alt lama tetap). Dengan berkas baru, `required_with:cover` sudah menjaganya.
     */
    private function validateExistingCoverAlt(Validator $validator): void
    {
        $article = $this->route('article');

        if (! $article instanceof Article || $this->coverFile() !== null || ! $this->has('cover_alt') || $this->coverAlt() !== '') {
            return;
        }

        if ($article->media()->where('collection', 'cover')->exists()) {
            $validator->errors()->add('cover_alt', 'Teks alternatif gambar sampul wajib diisi.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Atribut model hasil validasi (hanya kunci yang boleh diisi form; `slug` dan `author_user_id` tidak termasuk).
     * `published_at` (F4A-R10):
     *   - terbit tanpa tanggal → `now()`;
     *   - tanggal yang sama menitnya dengan nilai tersimpan → tidak ditulis ulang (detik tidak hilang);
     *   - draf tanpa tanggal → kolom tidak disentuh (kembali ke draf tidak mengosongkan `published_at`).
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function articleAttributes(): array
    {
        $data = $this->validated();
        $article = $this->route('article');
        $status = ArticleStatus::from((string) $data['status']);
        $publishedAt = $this->blankToNull($data['published_at'] ?? null);

        $attributes = [
            'article_category_id' => filled($data['article_category_id'] ?? null) ? (int) $data['article_category_id'] : null,
            'title' => trim((string) $data['title']),
            'excerpt' => trim((string) $data['excerpt']),
            'body' => (string) $data['body'],
            'status' => $status,
            'meta_title' => $this->blankToNull($data['meta_title'] ?? null),
            'meta_description' => $this->blankToNull($data['meta_description'] ?? null),
        ];

        if ($publishedAt === null && $status === ArticleStatus::Published) {
            $attributes['published_at'] = now();
        } elseif ($publishedAt !== null && ! $this->sameMinuteAsStored($article, $publishedAt)) {
            $attributes['published_at'] = $publishedAt;
        }

        return $attributes;
    }

    public function coverFile(): ?UploadedFile
    {
        $file = $this->file('cover');

        return $file instanceof UploadedFile ? $file : null;
    }

    public function coverAlt(): string
    {
        $alt = $this->input('cover_alt');

        return is_string($alt) ? trim($alt) : '';
    }

    private function sameMinuteAsStored(mixed $article, string $submitted): bool
    {
        return $article instanceof Article
            && $article->published_at !== null
            && $article->published_at->format('Y-m-d\TH:i') === $submitted;
    }

    private function blankToNull(mixed $value): ?string
    {
        return is_string($value) && trim($value) !== '' ? trim($value) : null;
    }
}
```
