`app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ArticleController.php`

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\ArticleIndexRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\ArticleRequest;
use App\Models\Article;
use App\Models\ArticleCategory;
use App\Services\Media\MediaService;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Halaman #39, tab Artikel (F-ADM-20). Hapus = soft delete: baris dan media dipertahankan, slug tidak dipakai ulang.
 * `author_user_id` diisi pengguna pembuat saat `store` dan tidak berubah saat `update` (F4A-R10).
 */
class ArticleController extends Controller
{
    public function index(ArticleIndexRequest $request): View
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', Article::class);

        $articles = $request
            ->applyTo(Article::query()->with(['category', 'author']))
            ->paginate($request->perPage());

        return view('admin.articles.index', [
            'articles' => $articles,
            'categories' => ArticleCategory::query()->ordered()->get(),
        ]);
    }

    public function create(): View
    {
        $this->authorize('create', Article::class);

        return view('admin.articles.create', ['categoryOptions' => $this->categoryOptions()]);
    }

    public function store(ArticleRequest $request, MediaService $media): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', Article::class);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $media): void {
            $article = Article::query()->create($request->articleAttributes() + ['author_user_id' => $request->user()?->id]);
            $this->saveCover($request, $media, $article);
        });

        return redirect()->route('admin.articles.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.created', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.article')]));
    }

    public function edit(Article $article): View
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $article);

        return view('admin.articles.edit', [
            'article' => $article->load(['media', 'author']),
            'categoryOptions' => $this->categoryOptions(),
        ]);
    }

    public function update(ArticleRequest $request, Article $article, MediaService $media): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $article);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $media, $article): void {
            $article->update($request->articleAttributes());
            $this->saveCover($request, $media, $article);
        });

        return redirect()->route('admin.articles.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.updated', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.article')]));
    }

    /**
     * Soft delete: tidak ada UI pemulihan (pemulihan lewat tinker). Media cover dipertahankan.
     */
    public function destroy(Article $article): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $article);

        DB::transaction(fn (): ?bool => $article->delete());

        return redirect()->route('admin.articles.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.deleted', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.article')]));
    }

    private function saveCover(ArticleRequest $request, MediaService $media, Article $article): void
    {
        $file = $request->coverFile();

        if ($file !== null) {
            $media->replace($article, 'cover', $file, ['alt_text' => $request->coverAlt()], $request->user());

            return;
        }

        if ($request->has('cover_alt')) {
            // Tanpa berkas baru: alt yang diedit diterapkan ke cover yang ada (caption tidak diubah).
            $existing = $article->media()->where('collection', 'cover')->first();

            if ($existing !== null && $existing->alt_text !== $request->coverAlt()) {
                $media->updateMeta($existing, $request->coverAlt(), $existing->caption);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, string> id => nama, urut `ordered()`
     */
    private function categoryOptions(): array
    {
        return ArticleCategory::query()->ordered()->get()->pluck('name', 'id')->all();
    }
}
```

### Task 9: Admin #39 Galeri dan foto album

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Policies/GalleryPolicy.php`
- Create: `app/Http/Requests/Admin/GalleryIndexRequest.php`
- Create: `app/Http/Requests/Admin/GalleryRequest.php`
- Create: `app/Http/Requests/Admin/StoreGalleryPhotosRequest.php`
- Create: `app/Http/Controllers/Admin/GalleryController.php`
- Create: `resources/views/admin/galleries/index.blade.php`, `create.blade.php`, `edit.blade.php`, `_form.blade.php`
- Modify: `routes/admin.php` (satu `use` dan penanda `// Task 9: galeri`)
- Test: `tests/Feature/Admin/AdminGalleriesTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Admin/AdminGalleryPhotosTest.php`
- Tidak diubah: `MediaController`, `MediaService`, `MediaPolicy` (pemetaan `Gallery` dibuat T3), `config/navigation.php` (tab "Galeri" dibuat T5), model `Gallery` (T2).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - T2: `App\Models\Gallery` (`fillable`: `title`, `slug`, `description`, `is_published`, `sort_order`; `MAX_PHOTOS = 100`; `scopeOrdered`; `coverMedia()`; trait `HasMedia` dan `HasUniqueSlug` dengan slug dari `title`), `GalleryFactory`, dan `tests/Support/InteractsWithContent.php` (`createGallery()`, `addGalleryPhoto()`).
  - T3: `MediaPolicy::manages()` memetakan `Gallery` ke `content.manage`; `AuditObserver` didaftarkan untuk `Gallery` (aksi `gallery.created|updated|deleted`); kunci `messages.entities.gallery` = "Album galeri".
  - T5: grup route `konten` di `routes/admin.php` dengan penanda `// Task 9: galeri`, route `admin.pages.index` (dipakai breadcrumb), dan `config('navigation.modules.content')`.
  - Fase 2: `MediaService::store(UploadedFile, 'photos', Gallery, ['alt_text', 'caption'], User)` (sort_order lanjutan diatur `nextSortOrder`), `MediaController` (`admin.media.update`, `admin.media.reorder`, `admin.media.destroy`), `ImageRules::for('photos')` / `ImageRules::messages()`, `MasterDataIndexRequest` sebagai pola, `ListFilterRequest`.
- Produces:
  - `App\Http\Controllers\Admin\GalleryController`: `index`, `create`, `store`, `edit`, `update`, `destroy` (tanpa `show`), dan `storePhotos`.
  - Route (semua `permission:content.manage`, di bawah `/admin/konten`): `admin.galleries.index|create|store|edit|update|destroy` → `/admin/konten/galeri`, `/admin/konten/galeri/buat`, `/admin/konten/galeri/{gallery}/ubah`, `/admin/konten/galeri/{gallery}`; `admin.galleries.photos.store` → `POST /admin/konten/galeri/{gallery}/foto`. Tujuh route.
  - `App\Policies\GalleryPolicy` (`final`, semua method memerlukan `content.manage`).
  - `Admin\GalleryIndexRequest::applyTo(Builder $query): Builder` (filter `q` pada `title`, `status` `terbit|draf`, `urut` `urutan|judul`).
  - `Admin\GalleryRequest::galleryAttributes(): array`.
  - `Admin\StoreGalleryPhotosRequest`: `photoFiles(): array`, `altText(int|string $index): string`, `caption(int|string $index): ?string`; konstanta `MAX_PER_UPLOAD = 10`.
  - Flash `success`: "Album galeri berhasil ditambahkan." / "… diperbarui." / "… dihapus." dan "{n} foto berhasil ditambahkan ke album.".
  - Judul layout: "Galeri", "Tambah Album", "Ubah Album {judul}".

**Test IDs:** CRD-09 (bagian album dan foto), CRD-13 (hapus album beserta berkas fotonya), SEK-09 dan SEK-10 (SVG, `shell.php.jpg`, teks bernama `.jpg` pada form galeri), MED-05 dan VAL-06 (batas ukuran, dimensi, alt wajib), VAL-07 (filter admin tidak valid), AKS-04 (mutasi galeri), Review Focus 4 (unggahan berbahaya, 11 foto, album 100 foto) dan Review Focus 5 (hapus album menghapus berkas).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **Pola yang ditiru.** `app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ClinicController.php` (otorisasi `authorize()` di controller, transaksi `DB::transaction`, flash `messages.created|updated|deleted`), `ClinicRequest` (`authorize()` dari route model, `messages()` dengan `ImageRules::messages(...)`, galeri 20 foto dengan `gallery_alt` per indeks) dan `resources/views/admin/clinics/edit.blade.php:22-88` (kartu galeri: form `admin.media.update`, dua form `admin.media.reorder` berisi `ids[]` yang sudah ditukar, tombol hapus yang membuka satu `x-confirm-modal` lewat `data-confirm-action`). Form tidak boleh bersarang, jadi kartu foto dan form unggah berada di luar form album.
2. **Perbedaan dari galeri poliklinik.** Album dibuat tanpa foto (F4A-R23): `store` mengalihkan ke `admin.galleries.edit`, bukan ke daftar. Unggah foto memakai route tersendiri `admin.galleries.photos.store` dengan 5 slot `photos[i]`, `alt_texts[i]`, `captions[i]` (nama berbeda dari `gallery`/`gallery_alt` poliklinik). Batas 10 berkas sekali kirim (V-34) dan total 100 foto (`Gallery::MAX_PHOTOS`); koleksi bernama `photos`, bukan `gallery`.
3. **Sort order.** `MediaService::createMedia()` mengisi `sort_order` dengan `nextSortOrder()` (nilai maksimum koleksi + 1), jadi foto baru otomatis di belakang foto lama dan urutan antarslot mengikuti urutan pemrosesan. Sampul album = foto pertama (`sort_order`, `id`) dari `Gallery::coverMedia()`, jadi menaikkan foto lain mengganti sampul.
4. **Penegakan akses media.** `admin.media.update|reorder|destroy` sudah menerima `content.manage` di middleware `routes/admin.php`; izin akhir ditentukan `MediaPolicy::manages()` menurut `model_type`. Tanpa pemetaan `Gallery` (T3), content-admin mendapat 403 dari `reorder`, sehingga tes reorder di tugas ini sekaligus mengunci pemetaan T3.
5. **Mode ketat.** Daftar memuat `with('media')` (untuk `coverMedia()`) dan `withCount(['media as photos_count' => …])` untuk kolom jumlah foto. `withCount` pada relasi `media` yang punya `orderBy` aman: Laravel membuang `orders` pada subkueri agregat. Halaman ubah memanggil `$gallery->load('media')` sebelum `mediaIn('photos')`.
6. **Slug.** Form tidak punya input slug (F4A-R7). `Gallery` memakai `HasUniqueSlug` dengan sumber `title`, jadi dua album berjudul sama mendapat `-2`, dan slug tidak berubah saat judul diubah.
7. **Atomisitas unggah.** `storePhotos()` membungkus semua berkas dalam satu `DB::transaction`. Kegagalan pemrosesan berkas (mis. PNG rusak) melempar `ValidationException` dari `MediaService` dengan kunci `file` dan membatalkan baris `media` yang sudah dibuat (rollback seluruhnya). Pada unggah beberapa berkas yang salah satunya rusak, berkas fisik dari berkas valid yang diproses sebelum berkas rusak tetap tertinggal di disk sebagai yatim (tanpa baris `media`) sampai dibersihkan `media:prune`; ini kompromi yang diterima. Tes mengunci kasus satu berkas rusak: tanpa baris `media` dan tanpa berkas.
8. **Tidak ada perubahan JS atau SCSS**, jadi tidak ada `npm run build`. Prefix route `admin.` dan batas numerik `gallery` sudah ada di `bootstrap/app.php`.
9. **Indentasi route.** Penanda berada di dalam grup `konten` (bersarang di grup G-ADMIN), jadi baris lanjutan memakai indentasi 8 spasi. Bila indentasi penanda berbeda, Pint merapikannya pada langkah Pint.

```php
    public function test_deleting_an_album_removes_its_photos_and_files_but_not_other_albums_crd13(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');
        $this->actingAs($admin);

        $this->post(route('admin.galleries.store'), $this->payload(['title' => 'Album Dihapus']));
        $gallery = Gallery::query()->where('title', 'Album Dihapus')->sole();

        $this->post(route('admin.galleries.photos.store', $gallery), [
            'photos' => [0 => ImageFixtures::jpeg(700, 500, 'a.jpg'), 1 => ImageFixtures::jpeg(700, 500, 'b.jpg')],
            'alt_texts' => [0 => 'Foto A', 1 => 'Foto B'],
        ])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $other = $this->createGallery(['title' => 'Album Aman']);
        $otherPhoto = $this->addGalleryPhoto($other, ['sort_order' => 1]);

        $paths = Media::query()
            ->where('model_id', $gallery->id)
            ->get()
            ->flatMap(fn (Media $media): array => [$media->directory.'/'.$media->file_name, $media->thumb_path])
            ->all();
        $this->assertCount(4, $paths);

        foreach ($paths as $path) {
            Storage::disk('public')->assertExists($path);
        }

        $this->delete(route('admin.galleries.destroy', $gallery))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.galleries.index'))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Album galeri berhasil dihapus.');

        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('galleries', ['id' => $gallery->id]);
        $this->assertSame(0, Media::query()->where('model_id', $gallery->id)->count());

        foreach ($paths as $path) {
            Storage::disk('public')->assertMissing($path);
        }

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('galleries', ['id' => $other->id]);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('media', ['id' => $otherPhoto->id]);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', ['action' => 'gallery.deleted']);
        $this->assertSame(2, DB::table('audit_logs')->where('action', 'media.deleted')->count());
    }

    public function test_registration_officer_patient_and_guest_cannot_use_gallery_routes(): void
    {
        $gallery = $this->createGallery(['title' => 'Album Aman']);

        $requests = [
            ['GET', route('admin.galleries.create'), []],
            ['POST', route('admin.galleries.store'), $this->payload(['title' => 'Tidak Boleh'])],
            ['GET', route('admin.galleries.edit', $gallery), []],
            ['PUT', route('admin.galleries.update', $gallery), $this->payload(['title' => 'Diubah Paksa'])],
            ['DELETE', route('admin.galleries.destroy', $gallery), []],
            ['POST', route('admin.galleries.photos.store', $gallery), ['alt_texts' => [0 => 'x']]],
        ];

        foreach ([$this->createStaff('registration-officer'), User::factory()->patient()->create()] as $user) {
            $this->actingAs($user);

            foreach ($requests as [$method, $url, $data]) {
                $this->call($method, $url, $data)->assertForbidden();
            }
        }

        $this->app['auth']->forgetGuards();

        foreach ($requests as [$method, $url, $data]) {
            $this->call($method, $url, $data)->assertRedirect(route('admin.login'));
        }

        $this->assertSame('Album Aman', $gallery->fresh()->title);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('galleries', ['title' => 'Tidak Boleh']);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('galleries', ['id' => $gallery->id]);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use App\Models\Gallery;
use App\Models\Media;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Rules\ImageRules;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\ImageFixtures;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Foto album (T9, F4A-R23): unggah lewat `admin.galleries.photos.store` (5 slot, V-34), batas 10 berkas per kirim
 * dan 100 foto per album, unggahan berbahaya (SEK-09/SEK-10), serta alt/urutan/hapus lewat `admin.media.*`
 * oleh content-admin (pemetaan MediaPolicy T3).
 */
class AdminGalleryPhotosTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private Gallery $gallery;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Storage::fake('public');
        $this->gallery = $this->createGallery(['title' => 'Album Unggah']);
    }

    private function uploadUrl(): string
    {
        return route('admin.galleries.photos.store', $this->gallery);
    }

    private function editUrl(): string
    {
        return route('admin.galleries.edit', $this->gallery);
    }

    /**
     * Isian $count slot berurutan (indeks 0..): foto 700x500 beserta teks alternatif.
     *
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    private function photoPayload(int $count): array
    {
        $photos = [];
        $alts = [];

    public function test_two_photos_are_stored_in_slot_order_with_their_own_alt_and_caption_crd09(): void

    public function test_registration_officer_and_patient_cannot_change_gallery_photos_and_a_guest_is_redirected(): void
    {
        $photo = $this->addGalleryPhoto($this->gallery, ['sort_order' => 1, 'alt_text' => 'Tetap']);

        $requests = [
            ['POST', $this->uploadUrl(), ['alt_texts' => [0 => 'x']]],
            ['PATCH', route('admin.media.update', $photo), ['alt_text' => 'Diubah paksa']],
            ['POST', route('admin.media.reorder'), ['ids' => [$photo->id]]],
            ['DELETE', route('admin.media.destroy', $photo), []],
        ];

        foreach ([$this->createStaff('registration-officer'), User::factory()->patient()->create()] as $user) {
            $this->actingAs($user);

            foreach ($requests as [$method, $url, $data]) {
                $this->call($method, $url, $data)->assertForbidden();
            }
        }

        $this->app['auth']->forgetGuards();

        foreach ($requests as [$method, $url, $data]) {
            $this->call($method, $url, $data)->assertRedirect(route('admin.login'));
        }

        $this->assertSame('Tetap', $photo->fresh()->alt_text);
        $this->assertSame(1, Media::query()->where('collection', 'photos')->count());
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Implementasi `GalleryIndexRequest` (tool Write) `app/Http/Requests/Admin/GalleryIndexRequest.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

/**
 * Filter daftar album galeri (F4A-R14): `q` pada `title`, `status` terbit/draf, `urut` urutan/judul.
 * Parameter yang tidak valid diabaikan oleh basis (12 V-45), tidak pernah menjadi galat 500.
 */
class GalleryIndexRequest extends ListFilterRequest
{
    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    protected function statusValues(): array
    {
        return ['terbit', 'draf'];
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    protected function sortable(): array
    {
        return ['urutan', 'judul'];
    }

    /**
     * Menerapkan pencarian, status, dan urutan. Tanpa `urut` dipakai scope ordered() (sort_order lalu id).
     * Karakter `%`, `_`, dan `\` pada kata kunci di-escape.
     *
     * @param  Builder<Model>  $query
     * @return Builder<Model>
     */
    public function applyTo(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        $filters = $this->filters();
        $model = $query->getModel();

        if (isset($filters['q'])) {
            $like = '%'.str_replace(['\\', '%', '_'], ['\\\\', '\\%', '\\_'], $filters['q']).'%';
            $query->where($model->qualifyColumn('title'), 'like', $like);
        }

        $status = $filters['status'] ?? null;

        if ($status === 'terbit' || $status === 'draf') {
            $query->where($model->qualifyColumn('is_published'), $status === 'terbit');
        }

        $sort = $filters['urut'] ?? null;

        if ($sort === null) {
            return $query->ordered();
        }

        $direction = str_starts_with($sort, '-') ? 'desc' : 'asc';

        if (ltrim($sort, '-') === 'judul') {
            return $query->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('title'), $direction)->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('id'));
        }

        return $query->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('sort_order'), $direction)->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('id'));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Models\Gallery;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

/**
 * V-34 (bagian album): satu kelas untuk tambah dan ubah. `slug` dibuat sistem (F4A-R7); foto diunggah lewat
 * StoreGalleryPhotosRequest setelah album ada (F4A-R23).
 */
class GalleryRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $user = $this->user();
        $gallery = $this->route('gallery');

        if ($user === null) {
            return false;
        }

        return $gallery instanceof Gallery
            ? $user->can('update', $gallery)
            : $user->can('create', Gallery::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'title' => ['bail', 'required', 'string', 'min:3', 'max:100'],
            'description' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:500'],
            'is_published' => ['required', 'boolean'],
            'sort_order' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'between:0,9999'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'title.required' => 'Judul album wajib diisi.',
            'title.string' => 'Judul album harus berupa teks.',
            'title.min' => 'Judul album minimal 3 karakter.',
            'title.max' => 'Judul album maksimal 100 karakter.',
            'description.string' => 'Deskripsi album harus berupa teks.',
            'description.max' => 'Deskripsi album maksimal 500 karakter.',
            'is_published.required' => 'Status terbit tidak valid.',
            'is_published.boolean' => 'Status terbit tidak valid.',
            'sort_order.integer' => 'Urutan harus berupa angka bulat.',
            'sort_order.between' => 'Urutan harus antara 0 dan 9999.',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Atribut model hasil validasi (tanpa `slug`).
     *
     * @return array{title: string, description: ?string, is_published: bool, sort_order: int}
     */
    public function galleryAttributes(): array
    {
        $data = $this->validated();

        return [
            'title' => (string) $data['title'],
            'description' => $data['description'] ?? null,
            'is_published' => (bool) $data['is_published'],
            'sort_order' => (int) ($data['sort_order'] ?? 0),
        ];
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Implementasi `StoreGalleryPhotosRequest` (tool Write) `app/Http/Requests/Admin/StoreGalleryPhotosRequest.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Models\Gallery;
use App\Rules\ImageRules;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;

/**
 * V-34 (bagian foto): `POST /admin/konten/galeri/{gallery}/foto`. Lima slot `photos[i]` dengan `alt_texts[i]` dan
 * `captions[i]`; maksimal 10 berkas per kirim, dan jumlah foto album ditambah yang baru maksimal
 * `Gallery::MAX_PHOTOS` (100).
 */
class StoreGalleryPhotosRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public const MAX_PER_UPLOAD = 10;

    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $gallery = $this->route('gallery');

        return $gallery instanceof Gallery && $this->user()?->can('update', $gallery) === true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        $rules = [
            'photos' => ['bail', 'required', 'array', 'min:1', 'max:'.self::MAX_PER_UPLOAD],
            'photos.*' => ImageRules::for('photos'),
            'alt_texts' => ['nullable', 'array'],
            'captions' => ['nullable', 'array'],
            'captions.*' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
        ];

        foreach (array_keys($this->photoFiles()) as $index) {
            $rules['alt_texts.'.$index] = ['required', 'string', 'max:255'];
        }

        return $rules;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return array_merge(
            ImageRules::messages('photos.*', 'photos'),
            [
                'photos.required' => 'Pilih minimal satu foto.',
                'photos.array' => 'Pilih minimal satu foto.',
                'photos.min' => 'Pilih minimal satu foto.',
                'photos.max' => 'Maksimal 10 foto per unggahan.',
                'alt_texts.array' => 'Teks alternatif setiap foto wajib diisi.',
                'alt_texts.*.required' => 'Teks alternatif setiap foto wajib diisi.',
                'alt_texts.*.string' => 'Teks alternatif setiap foto wajib diisi.',
                'alt_texts.*.max' => 'Teks alternatif maksimal 255 karakter.',
                'captions.array' => 'Keterangan foto tidak valid.',
                'captions.*.string' => 'Keterangan foto tidak valid.',
                'captions.*.max' => 'Keterangan foto maksimal 255 karakter.',
            ],
        );
    }

    /**
     * Batas 100 foto berlaku untuk jumlah yang sudah ada ditambah yang baru diunggah (V-34).
     *
     * @return array<int, callable>
     */
    public function after(): array
    {
        return [function (Validator $validator): void {
            $incoming = count($this->photoFiles());

            if ($incoming === 0 || $validator->errors()->has('photos')) {
                return;
            }

            $gallery = $this->route('gallery');

            if (! $gallery instanceof Gallery) {
                return;
            }

            $existing = $gallery->media()->where('collection', 'photos')->count();

            if ($existing + $incoming > Gallery::MAX_PHOTOS) {
                $validator->errors()->add('photos', 'Album sudah mencapai batas 100 foto.');
            }
        }];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int|string, UploadedFile>
     */
    public function photoFiles(): array
    {
        $files = $this->file('photos');

        return is_array($files) ? array_filter($files, fn ($file): bool => $file instanceof UploadedFile) : [];
    }

    public function altText(int|string $index): string
    {
        $value = $this->input('alt_texts.'.$index);

        return is_string($value) ? trim($value) : '';
    }

    public function caption(int|string $index): ?string
    {
        $value = $this->input('captions.'.$index);

        if (! is_string($value) || trim($value) === '') {
            return null;
        }

        return trim($value);
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Implementasi `GalleryController` (tool Write) `app/Http/Controllers/Admin/GalleryController.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\GalleryIndexRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\GalleryRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\StoreGalleryPhotosRequest;
use App\Models\Gallery;
use App\Services\Media\MediaService;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Admin #39 tab Galeri (F-ADM-21). Album dibuat tanpa foto lalu dialihkan ke halaman ubah agar foto langsung
 * diunggah (F4A-R23, menyimpang dari D-47). Alt/keterangan, urutan, dan hapus foto memakai `admin.media.*`.
 */
class GalleryController extends Controller
{
    public function index(GalleryIndexRequest $request): View
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', Gallery::class);

        $galleries = $request
            ->applyTo(Gallery::query()
                ->with('media')
                ->withCount(['media as photos_count' => fn ($query) => $query->where('collection', 'photos')]))
            ->paginate($request->perPage());

        return view('admin.galleries.index', ['galleries' => $galleries]);
    }

    public function create(): View
    {
        $this->authorize('create', Gallery::class);

        return view('admin.galleries.create');
    }

    public function store(GalleryRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', Gallery::class);

        $gallery = DB::transaction(fn (): Gallery => Gallery::query()->create($request->galleryAttributes()));

        return redirect()->route('admin.galleries.edit', $gallery)
            ->with('success', __('messages.created', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.gallery')]));
    }

    public function edit(Gallery $gallery): View
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $gallery);

        return view('admin.galleries.edit', ['gallery' => $gallery->load('media')]);
    }

    public function update(GalleryRequest $request, Gallery $gallery): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $gallery);

        DB::transaction(fn (): bool => $gallery->update($request->galleryAttributes()));

        return redirect()->route('admin.galleries.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.updated', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.gallery')]));
    }

    /**
     * Hapus permanen; seluruh foto dan berkasnya ikut terhapus lewat trait HasMedia (BR-133, CRD-13).
     * Transaksi wajib agar berkas baru dihapus setelah commit.
     */
    public function destroy(Gallery $gallery): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $gallery);

        DB::transaction(fn (): ?bool => $gallery->delete());

        return redirect()->route('admin.galleries.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.deleted', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.gallery')]));
    }

    /**
     * Unggah sampai 10 foto sekali kirim; `sort_order` dilanjutkan oleh MediaService (maksimum koleksi + 1).
     */
    public function storePhotos(StoreGalleryPhotosRequest $request, Gallery $gallery, MediaService $media): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $gallery);

        $user = $request->user();
        $files = $request->photoFiles();

        DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $media, $gallery, $user, $files): void {
            foreach ($files as $index => $file) {
                $media->store($file, 'photos', $gallery, [
                    'alt_text' => $request->altText($index),
                    'caption' => $request->caption($index),
                ], $user);
            }
        });

        return redirect()->route('admin.galleries.edit', $gallery)
            ->with('success', count($files).' foto berhasil ditambahkan ke album.');
    }
}
```

  - T3: `AuditObserver` didaftarkan untuk `Faq` (aksi `faq.created|updated|deleted`, deskripsi memakai `question` dipotong 80 karakter); `messages.entities.faq` = "FAQ".
  - T5: grup route `konten` dengan penanda `// Task 10: FAQ`, route `admin.pages.index` (breadcrumb), `config('navigation.modules.content')`.
  - Fase 2: `ListFilterRequest` (basis filter), `App\Rules\NoHtml`.
- Produces:
  - `App\Http\Controllers\Admin\FaqController`: `index`, `create`, `store`, `edit`, `update`, `destroy` (tanpa `show`).
  - Route (semua `permission:content.manage`): `admin.faqs.index|create|store|edit|update|destroy` → `/admin/konten/faq`, `/admin/konten/faq/buat`, `/admin/konten/faq/{faq}/ubah`, `/admin/konten/faq/{faq}`. Enam route.
  - `App\Policies\FaqPolicy` (`final`, semua method memerlukan `content.manage`).
  - `Admin\FaqIndexRequest::applyTo(Builder $query): Builder` (filter `q` pada `question`, `status` `terbit|draf`, `kategori` ∈ `Faq::CATEGORIES`, `urut` `urutan|pertanyaan`).
  - `Admin\FaqRequest::faqAttributes(): array`.
  - Flash `success`: "FAQ berhasil ditambahkan." / "FAQ berhasil diperbarui." / "FAQ berhasil dihapus.".
  - Judul layout: "FAQ", "Tambah FAQ", "Ubah FAQ".

**Test IDs:** CRD-10 (bagian FAQ: CRUD dan terbit/draf), CRD-13 (`faqs` hapus permanen), VAL-01 (pesan per field, ringkasan galat, nilai lama), VAL-07 (filter admin tidak valid), AKS-04 (mutasi FAQ).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **Pola yang ditiru.** `SpecialtyController` / `ClinicController` (otorisasi di controller, flash `messages.*`), `SpecialtyRequest` (satu kelas tambah-ubah, `NoHtml`, kunci pesan `field.no_html`), `MasterDataIndexRequest` (filter `q` ter-escape, `status`, `urut`).
2. **`NoHtml` dan pesan.** Aturan `NoHtml` gagal dengan kunci aturan `no_html`; Laravel mengambil pesan dari `messages()` pada kunci `question.no_html` / `answer.no_html` (pola `SpecialtyRequest` dan `StoreDoctorRequest`). Pola tag sungguhan saja yang ditolak, jadi jawaban "tekanan <90 dan >100" lolos (dikunci di tes).
3. **Urutan = field `sort_order`** (F4A-R22): tidak ada route reorder. Daftar admin diurutkan `ordered()` (sort_order, id) secara bawaan.
4. **`FaqIndexRequest` menimpa `rules()`** hanya untuk `kategori`: basis memberi `nullable|string|max:150`, kelas ini menambah `Rule::in(Faq::CATEGORIES)` supaya nilai di luar daftar (mis. `tidak-ada` atau `%00`) diabaikan bersama peringatan "Filter tidak valid dan diabaikan.". `ListFilterRequest::filters()` membaca kunci dari `rules()` sehingga override ini otomatis berlaku. Nilai larik (`?kategori[]=x`) gagal `string` dan juga diabaikan.
5. **Hapus permanen** (BR-127/09 §6.6): tanpa soft delete dan tanpa penolakan; tidak ada relasi keluar.
6. **Tanpa media dan tanpa slug**, jadi `FaqController` sederhana dan tidak memakai `MediaService`.
7. **Mode ketat.** `Faq` tidak punya relasi; `category_label` dihitung dari konstanta. Tes daftar memakai 4 baris.
8. **Tidak ada perubahan JS atau SCSS**, jadi tidak ada `npm run build`.
9. **Indentasi route.** Baris lanjutan setelah penanda memakai 8 spasi (penanda berada di dalam grup `konten` yang bersarang di grup G-ADMIN); Pint merapikan bila berbeda.

```php
    public function test_registration_officer_patient_and_guest_cannot_use_faq_routes(): void
    {
        $faq = $this->createFaq(['question' => 'Pertanyaan aman?']);

        $requests = [
            ['GET', route('admin.faqs.create'), []],
            ['POST', route('admin.faqs.store'), $this->payload(['question' => 'Tidak boleh dibuat?'])],
            ['GET', route('admin.faqs.edit', $faq), []],
            ['PUT', route('admin.faqs.update', $faq), $this->payload(['question' => 'Diubah paksa?'])],
            ['DELETE', route('admin.faqs.destroy', $faq), []],
        ];

        foreach ([$this->createStaff('registration-officer'), User::factory()->patient()->create()] as $user) {
            $this->actingAs($user);

            foreach ($requests as [$method, $url, $data]) {
                $this->call($method, $url, $data)->assertForbidden();
            }
        }

        $this->app['auth']->forgetGuards();

        foreach ($requests as [$method, $url, $data]) {
            $this->call($method, $url, $data)->assertRedirect(route('admin.login'));
        }

        $this->assertSame('Pertanyaan aman?', $faq->fresh()->question);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('faqs', ['question' => 'Tidak boleh dibuat?']);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('faqs', ['id' => $faq->id]);
    }
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use App\Models\Faq;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * 12 V-35 (BR-127): pesan Indonesia per field untuk form FAQ; HTML pada pertanyaan dan jawaban ditolak (`NoHtml`).
 */
class AdminFaqValidationTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{array<string, mixed>, string, string}>
     */
    public static function invalidInputs(): array
    {
        return [
            'kategori kosong' => [['category' => ''], 'category', 'Kategori FAQ wajib dipilih.'],
            'kategori tidak ada di daftar' => [['category' => 'lain-lain'], 'category', 'Kategori FAQ tidak valid.'],
            'kategori berupa larik' => [['category' => ['bpjs']], 'category', 'Kategori FAQ tidak valid.'],
            'pertanyaan kosong' => [['question' => ''], 'question', 'Pertanyaan wajib diisi.'],
            'pertanyaan bukan teks' => [['question' => ['a']], 'question', 'Pertanyaan harus berupa teks.'],
            'pertanyaan terlalu pendek' => [['question' => 'Apa?'], 'question', 'Pertanyaan minimal 5 karakter.'],
            'pertanyaan terlalu panjang' => [['question' => str_repeat('a', 256)], 'question', 'Pertanyaan maksimal 255 karakter.'],
            'pertanyaan berisi html' => [['question' => 'Apa itu <b>BPJS</b>?'], 'question', 'Pertanyaan tidak boleh mengandung tag HTML.'],
            'jawaban kosong' => [['answer' => ''], 'answer', 'Jawaban wajib diisi.'],
            'jawaban bukan teks' => [['answer' => ['a']], 'answer', 'Jawaban harus berupa teks.'],
            'jawaban terlalu pendek' => [['answer' => 'Ya'], 'answer', 'Jawaban minimal 5 karakter.'],
            'jawaban terlalu panjang' => [['answer' => str_repeat('a', 2001)], 'answer', 'Jawaban maksimal 2000 karakter.'],
            'jawaban berisi html' => [['answer' => 'Klik <a href="https://x.test">di sini</a>.'], 'answer', 'Jawaban tidak boleh mengandung tag HTML.'],
            'jawaban berisi skrip' => [['answer' => 'Halo <script>alert(1)</script>'], 'answer', 'Jawaban tidak boleh mengandung tag HTML.'],
            'urutan bukan angka' => [['sort_order' => 'abc'], 'sort_order', 'Urutan harus berupa angka bulat.'],
            'urutan terlalu besar' => [['sort_order' => '10000'], 'sort_order', 'Urutan harus antara 0 dan 9999.'],
            'urutan negatif' => [['sort_order' => '-1'], 'sort_order', 'Urutan harus antara 0 dan 9999.'],
            'status terbit hilang' => [['is_published' => null], 'is_published', 'Status terbit tidak valid.'],
            'status terbit tidak valid' => [['is_published' => 'mungkin'], 'is_published', 'Status terbit tidak valid.'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function valid(): array
    {
        return [
            'category' => 'umum',
            'question' => 'Di mana lokasi rumah sakit?',
            'answer' => 'Lokasi lengkap tercantum di halaman Kontak.',
            'sort_order' => '1',
            'is_published' => '1',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $override
     */
    #[DataProvider('invalidInputs')]
    public function test_store_rejects_invalid_input_with_indonesian_messages(array $override, string $field, string $message): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->from(route('admin.faqs.create'))
            ->post(route('admin.faqs.store'), array_merge($this->valid(), $override))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.faqs.create'))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors([$field => $message]);

        $this->assertSame(0, Faq::query()->count());
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $override
     */
    #[DataProvider('invalidInputs')]
    public function test_update_applies_the_same_rules_and_keeps_the_old_row(array $override, string $field, string $message): void
    {
        $faq = $this->createFaq(['category' => 'bpjs', 'question' => 'Pertanyaan asli?', 'answer' => 'Jawaban asli.']);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->from(route('admin.faqs.edit', $faq))
            ->put(route('admin.faqs.update', $faq), array_merge($this->valid(), $override))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.faqs.edit', $faq))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors([$field => $message]);

        $faq->refresh();
        $this->assertSame('Pertanyaan asli?', $faq->question);
        $this->assertSame('Jawaban asli.', $faq->answer);
        $this->assertSame('bpjs', $faq->category);
    }

    public function test_every_listed_category_is_accepted(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'));

        foreach (Faq::CATEGORIES as $position => $category) {
            $this->post(route('admin.faqs.store'), array_merge($this->valid(), [
                'category' => $category,
                'question' => 'Pertanyaan kategori '.$category.'?',
                'sort_order' => (string) $position,
            ]))->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
        }

        $this->assertSame(Faq::CATEGORIES, Faq::query()->orderBy('sort_order')->pluck('category')->all());
    }

    public function test_invalid_form_keeps_old_input_and_shows_an_error_summary(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->from(route('admin.faqs.create'))
            ->post(route('admin.faqs.store'), array_merge($this->valid(), ['question' => '', 'answer' => 'Jawaban lama saya']))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.faqs.create'));

        $this->get(route('admin.faqs.create'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('data-errors-summary', false)
            ->assertSee('Pertanyaan wajib diisi.')
            ->assertSee('aria-invalid="true"', false)
            ->assertSee('Jawaban lama saya');
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Implementasi `FaqIndexRequest` (tool Write) `app/Http/Requests/Admin/FaqIndexRequest.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest;
use App\Models\Faq;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * Filter daftar FAQ (F4A-R14): `q` pada `question`, `status` terbit/draf, `kategori` salah satu `Faq::CATEGORIES`,
 * `urut` urutan/pertanyaan. Parameter yang tidak valid diabaikan oleh basis (12 V-45), tidak pernah galat 500.
 */
class FaqIndexRequest extends ListFilterRequest
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::rules(), [
            'kategori' => ['nullable', 'string', Rule::in(Faq::CATEGORIES)],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::messages(), [
            'kategori.in' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    protected function statusValues(): array
    {
        return ['terbit', 'draf'];
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    protected function sortable(): array
    {
        return ['urutan', 'pertanyaan'];
    }

    /**
     * Menerapkan pencarian, kategori, status, dan urutan. Tanpa `urut` dipakai scope ordered() (sort_order lalu id).
     * Karakter `%`, `_`, dan `\` pada kata kunci di-escape.
     *
     * @param  Builder<Model>  $query
     * @return Builder<Model>
     */
    public function applyTo(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        $filters = $this->filters();
        $model = $query->getModel();

        if (isset($filters['q'])) {
            $like = '%'.str_replace(['\\', '%', '_'], ['\\\\', '\\%', '\\_'], $filters['q']).'%';
            $query->where($model->qualifyColumn('question'), 'like', $like);
        }

        if (isset($filters['kategori']) && in_array($filters['kategori'], Faq::CATEGORIES, true)) {
            $query->where($model->qualifyColumn('category'), $filters['kategori']);
        }

        $status = $filters['status'] ?? null;

        if ($status === 'terbit' || $status === 'draf') {
            $query->where($model->qualifyColumn('is_published'), $status === 'terbit');
        }

        $sort = $filters['urut'] ?? null;

        if ($sort === null) {
            return $query->ordered();
        }

        $direction = str_starts_with($sort, '-') ? 'desc' : 'asc';

        if (ltrim($sort, '-') === 'pertanyaan') {
            return $query->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('question'), $direction)->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('id'));
        }

        return $query->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('sort_order'), $direction)->orderBy($model->qualifyColumn('id'));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Models\Faq;
use App\Rules\NoHtml;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * V-35 (BR-127): satu kelas untuk tambah dan ubah. Pertanyaan dan jawaban adalah teks biasa (`NoHtml`);
 * jawaban dirender dengan `{{ }}` di halaman publik.
 */
class FaqRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $user = $this->user();
        $faq = $this->route('faq');

        if ($user === null) {
            return false;
        }

        return $faq instanceof Faq
            ? $user->can('update', $faq)
            : $user->can('create', Faq::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'category' => ['bail', 'required', Rule::in(Faq::CATEGORIES)],
            'question' => ['bail', 'required', 'string', 'min:5', 'max:255', new NoHtml],
            'answer' => ['bail', 'required', 'string', 'min:5', 'max:2000', new NoHtml],
            'sort_order' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'between:0,9999'],
            'is_published' => ['required', 'boolean'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'category.required' => 'Kategori FAQ wajib dipilih.',
            'category.in' => 'Kategori FAQ tidak valid.',
            'question.required' => 'Pertanyaan wajib diisi.',
            'question.string' => 'Pertanyaan harus berupa teks.',
            'question.min' => 'Pertanyaan minimal 5 karakter.',
            'question.max' => 'Pertanyaan maksimal 255 karakter.',
            'question.no_html' => 'Pertanyaan tidak boleh mengandung tag HTML.',
            'answer.required' => 'Jawaban wajib diisi.',
            'answer.string' => 'Jawaban harus berupa teks.',
            'answer.min' => 'Jawaban minimal 5 karakter.',
            'answer.max' => 'Jawaban maksimal 2000 karakter.',
            'answer.no_html' => 'Jawaban tidak boleh mengandung tag HTML.',
            'sort_order.integer' => 'Urutan harus berupa angka bulat.',
            'sort_order.between' => 'Urutan harus antara 0 dan 9999.',
            'is_published.required' => 'Status terbit tidak valid.',
            'is_published.boolean' => 'Status terbit tidak valid.',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Atribut model hasil validasi.
     *
     * @return array{category: string, question: string, answer: string, sort_order: int, is_published: bool}
     */
    public function faqAttributes(): array
    {
        $data = $this->validated();

        return [
            'category' => (string) $data['category'],
            'question' => (string) $data['question'],
            'answer' => (string) $data['answer'],
            'sort_order' => (int) ($data['sort_order'] ?? 0),
            'is_published' => (bool) $data['is_published'],
        ];
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Implementasi `FaqController` (tool Write) `app/Http/Controllers/Admin/FaqController.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\FaqIndexRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\FaqRequest;
use App\Models\Faq;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Admin #39 tab FAQ (F-ADM-22). Urutan tampil = field `sort_order` (F4A-R22), tanpa route reorder.
 * Hapus permanen tanpa penolakan: FAQ tidak dirujuk tabel lain.
 */
class FaqController extends Controller
{
    public function index(FaqIndexRequest $request): View
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', Faq::class);

        $faqs = $request->applyTo(Faq::query())->paginate($request->perPage());

        return view('admin.faqs.index', ['faqs' => $faqs]);
    }

    public function create(): View
    {
        $this->authorize('create', Faq::class);

        return view('admin.faqs.create');
    }

    public function store(FaqRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', Faq::class);

        DB::transaction(fn (): Faq => Faq::query()->create($request->faqAttributes()));

        return redirect()->route('admin.faqs.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.created', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.faq')]));
    }

    public function edit(Faq $faq): View
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $faq);

        return view('admin.faqs.edit', ['faq' => $faq]);
    }

    public function update(FaqRequest $request, Faq $faq): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $faq);

        DB::transaction(fn (): bool => $faq->update($request->faqAttributes()));

        return redirect()->route('admin.faqs.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.updated', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.faq')]));
    }

    public function destroy(Faq $faq): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $faq);

        DB::transaction(fn (): ?bool => $faq->delete());

        return redirect()->route('admin.faqs.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.deleted', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.faq')]));
    }
}
```

  - T2: `App\Models\InsurancePartner` (`TYPES`, `TYPE_LABELS`, `fillable`: `name`, `slug`, `type`, `description`, `website_url`, `is_active`, `sort_order`; `scopeActive`, `scopeOrdered` (sort_order, name, id); atribut `type_label`; `deletionBlockedReason(): ?string` dengan teks BR-180 `"Mitra asuransi masih dipakai oleh {$n} data. Nonaktifkan saja."`; trait `HasMedia` dan `HasUniqueSlug` dengan sumber slug `name`), `InsurancePartnerFactory`, `InteractsWithContent::createInsurancePartner()`.
  - T3: `MediaPolicy::manages()` memetakan `InsurancePartner` ke `content.manage`; `AuditObserver` didaftarkan untuk `InsurancePartner` (aksi `insurance_partner.created|updated|deleted`); `messages.entities.insurance_partner` = "Mitra asuransi".
  - T5: grup route `konten` dengan penanda `// Task 11: mitra asuransi`, route `admin.pages.index` (breadcrumb), `config('navigation.modules.content')`.
  - Fase 2: `MasterDataIndexRequest::applyTo(Builder, array $searchColumns)` (filter `q`, `status` aktif/nonaktif, `urut` nama/urutan), `MediaService::replace()` / `updateMeta()`, `ImageRules::for('logo')` / `ImageRules::messages()`, `NoHtml`, `x-form.file`, `x-form.radio-group`.
  - Fase 3: `tests/Support/InteractsWithSchedules.php` (`createSession()`, `bookAppointment()`), `AppointmentFactory`, kolom `appointments.insurance_partner_id` (FK `RESTRICT`).
- Produces:
  - `App\Http\Controllers\Admin\InsurancePartnerController`: `index`, `create`, `store`, `edit`, `update`, `destroy` (tanpa `show`).
  - Route (semua `permission:content.manage`): `admin.insurance-partners.index|create|store|edit|update|destroy` → `/admin/konten/asuransi`, `/admin/konten/asuransi/buat`, `/admin/konten/asuransi/{insurancePartner}/ubah`, `/admin/konten/asuransi/{insurancePartner}`. Enam route.
  - `App\Policies\InsurancePartnerPolicy` (`final`, semua method memerlukan `content.manage`).
  - `Admin\InsurancePartnerRequest`: `insurancePartnerAttributes(): array`, `logoFile(): ?UploadedFile`, `logoAlt(): string`.
  - Penolakan hapus lewat flash `error` = `__('messages.delete_blocked', ['reason' => $partner->deletionBlockedReason()])`, juga untuk Super Admin (F4A-R21, pola D-44).
  - Flash `success`: "Mitra asuransi berhasil ditambahkan." / "… diperbarui." / "… dihapus.".
  - Judul layout: "Mitra Asuransi", "Tambah Mitra", "Ubah {nama}".

**Test IDs:** CRD-10 (bagian mitra asuransi), CRD-13 (`insurance_partners` bersyarat: ditolak bila dirujuk, terhapus beserta logo bila tidak), SEK-09 dan SEK-10 (SVG, `shell.php.jpg`, teks bernama `.jpg` pada unggah logo), MED-05 dan VAL-06 (batas ukuran, dimensi logo, alt wajib), VAL-01, VAL-07, AKS-04, Review Focus 4 (logo < 120 x 40, alt kosong) dan Review Focus 5 (mitra yang dirujuk appointment: flash alasan BR-180, bukan 500 FK).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **Pola yang ditiru.** `ClinicController` (otorisasi di controller, `saveMedia` dengan `replace` atau `updateMeta` bila hanya alt yang berubah, penolakan hapus lewat flash `error` yang berlaku juga untuk Super Admin), `ClinicRequest` (alt cover yang kosong ditolak bila cover sudah ada; `required_with` bila berkas dikirim), `AdminClinicIndexTest` dan `AdminClinicCrudTest` (bentuk tes daftar dan CRUD).
2. **FK `RESTRICT`.** `appointments.insurance_partner_id` mengacu `insurance_partners.id` dengan `RESTRICT` (`ScheduleSchemaTest::test_an_insurance_partner_used_by_an_appointment_cannot_be_deleted`). Karena itu penolakan hapus harus terjadi sebelum `delete()`: `destroy()` memanggil `deletionBlockedReason()` lebih dulu dan mengalihkan dengan flash `error`; tanpa itu hasilnya `QueryException` (500). Tes membuat rujukan lewat `InteractsWithSchedules::bookAppointment()` dengan `payment_type => PaymentType::Asuransi` dan `insurance_partner_id`; kolom itu `fillable` pada `Appointment` dan factory menulisnya langsung.
3. **`Appointment::insurancePartner()` tetap tidak ada (D-60).** Hitungan rujukan hanya lewat `InsurancePartner::appointments()` (`hasMany`) dan hanya berupa angka (F4A-R30); layar ini tidak membaca data pasien.
4. **Tombol Hapus selalu tampil** (F4A-R21): tidak ada pembedaan di daftar seperti poliklinik. Penolakan terjadi di controller, jadi pengguna melihat alasan BR-180 dan saran "Nonaktifkan saja.". Nonaktifkan = ubah `is_active` lewat form ubah (tes memastikan baris tetap ada dan `scopeActive` tidak lagi memuatnya).
5. **Validasi `website_url`** memakai `url:https` (hanya skema https), `max:255`; `http://`, `javascript:`, dan `https://` tanpa host ditolak dengan "Alamat situs harus berupa URL https yang valid.". Keunikan `name` memakai `Rule::unique(...)->ignore($partner)`; kolasi `utf8mb4_unicode_ci` membuat perbedaan huruf besar-kecil tetap dianggap sama.
6. **Logo.** Koleksi `logo` bersifat tunggal (`ImageRules::for('logo')`: maks 2 MB, minimal 120 x 40, maksimal 6000 x 6000). Berkas baru memakai `MediaService::replace` (berkas lama dihapus setelah commit); tanpa berkas baru, perubahan alt diterapkan lewat `updateMeta`. Pemilik media bertipe `InsurancePartner`, jadi baris `media` tidak yatim dan bukan logo situs (`model_type` NULL) yang dilindungi `site.logo_media_id`.
7. **Mode ketat.** Daftar memuat `with('media')` dan view memakai `firstMedia('logo')`; halaman ubah memanggil `$insurancePartner->load('media')`. Tes daftar memakai 4 baris.
8. **Tidak ada perubahan JS atau SCSS**, jadi tidak ada `npm run build`.
9. **Indentasi route.** Baris lanjutan setelah penanda memakai 8 spasi; Pint merapikan bila berbeda.
10. **Kondisi balapan** (appointment baru dibuat di antara pemeriksaan dan `delete()`) tetap berujung pada FK `RESTRICT` sebagai pengaman terakhir; ia sengaja tidak ditangkap karena jendela waktunya milidetik dan data tidak rusak.

```php
class AdminInsurancePartnersTest extends TestCase

        $oldPath = $old->directory.'/'.$old->file_name;

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->put(route('admin.insurance-partners.update', $partner), $this->payload([
                'name' => 'Mitra Logo',
                'logo' => ImageFixtures::jpeg(500, 250, 'baru.jpg'),
                'logo_alt' => 'Logo baru',
            ]))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertNotSame($old->id, $new->id);

    {

        $partner = InsurancePartner::query()->sole();
        $paths = Media::query()->get()->flatMap(fn (Media $media): array => [$media->directory.'/'.$media->file_name, $media->thumb_path])->all();
        $this->assertCount(2, $paths);

        $this->delete(route('admin.insurance-partners.destroy', $partner))

    /**

    public static function deleters(): array

    #[DataProvider('deleters')]
    public function test_a_partner_referenced_by_appointments_is_not_deleted_even_for_super_admin(string $role): void
    {
        $partner = $this->createInsurancePartner(['name' => 'Mitra Dirujuk']);
        $logo = $this->attachLogo($partner, 'Logo dirujuk');
        $this->referenceFrom($partner, 2);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff($role))
            ->delete(route('admin.insurance-partners.destroy', $partner))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.insurance-partners.index'))
            ->assertSessionHas('error', 'Mitra asuransi masih dipakai oleh 2 data. Nonaktifkan saja.');

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('insurance_partners', ['id' => $partner->id]);
        $this->assertSame(2, Appointment::query()->where('insurance_partner_id', $partner->id)->count());
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('media', ['id' => $logo->id]);
        Storage::disk('public')->assertExists($logo->directory.'/'.$logo->file_name);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('audit_logs', ['action' => 'insurance_partner.deleted']);
    }

    public function test_a_referenced_partner_can_still_be_deactivated(): void
    {
        $partner = $this->createInsurancePartner(['name' => 'Mitra Dirujuk']);
        $this->referenceFrom($partner, 1);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('super-admin'))
            ->put(route('admin.insurance-partners.update', $partner), $this->payload(['name' => 'Mitra Dirujuk', 'is_active' => '0']))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('insurance_partners', ['id' => $partner->id, 'is_active' => 0]);
        $this->assertSame(
            'Mitra asuransi masih dipakai oleh 1 data. Nonaktifkan saja.',
            $partner->fresh()->deletionBlockedReason(),
        );
    }

    public function test_non_numeric_id_is_a_404(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->get('/admin/konten/asuransi/abc/ubah')
            ->assertNotFound();
    }

    public function test_registration_officer_patient_and_guest_cannot_use_partner_routes(): void
    {
        $partner = $this->createInsurancePartner(['name' => 'Mitra Aman']);

        $requests = [
            ['GET', route('admin.insurance-partners.create'), []],
            ['POST', route('admin.insurance-partners.store'), $this->payload(['name' => 'Tidak Boleh'])],
            ['GET', route('admin.insurance-partners.edit', $partner), []],
            ['PUT', route('admin.insurance-partners.update', $partner), $this->payload(['name' => 'Diubah Paksa'])],
            ['DELETE', route('admin.insurance-partners.destroy', $partner), []],
        ];

        foreach ([$this->createStaff('registration-officer'), User::factory()->patient()->create()] as $user) {
            $this->actingAs($user);

            foreach ($requests as [$method, $url, $data]) {
                $this->call($method, $url, $data)->assertForbidden();
            }
        }

        $this->app['auth']->forgetGuards();

        foreach ($requests as [$method, $url, $data]) {
            $this->call($method, $url, $data)->assertRedirect(route('admin.login'));
        }

        $this->assertSame('Mitra Aman', $partner->fresh()->name);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('insurance_partners', ['name' => 'Tidak Boleh']);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('insurance_partners', ['id' => $partner->id]);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Models\InsurancePartner;
use App\Rules\ImageRules;
use App\Rules\NoHtml;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;

/**
 * V-36 (BR-128, BR-129): satu kelas untuk tambah dan ubah. `slug` dibuat sistem (F4A-R7); logo bersifat tunggal
 * (`logo` dengan `logo_alt`).
 */
class InsurancePartnerRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $user = $this->user();
        $partner = $this->route('insurancePartner');

        if ($user === null) {
            return false;
        }

        return $partner instanceof InsurancePartner
            ? $user->can('update', $partner)
            : $user->can('create', InsurancePartner::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        $partner = $this->route('insurancePartner');
        $partner = $partner instanceof InsurancePartner ? $partner : null;

        return [
            'name' => ['bail', 'required', 'string', 'min:3', 'max:100', Rule::unique('insurance_partners', 'name')->ignore($partner)],
            'type' => ['bail', 'required', Rule::in(InsurancePartner::TYPES)],
            'description' => ['bail', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:500', new NoHtml],
            'website_url' => ['nullable', 'string', 'url:https', 'max:255'],
            'is_active' => ['required', 'boolean'],
            'sort_order' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'between:0,9999'],
            'logo' => ['nullable', ...ImageRules::for('logo')],
            'logo_alt' => ['required_with:logo', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return array_merge(
            ImageRules::messages('logo', 'logo'),
            [
                'name.required' => 'Nama mitra wajib diisi.',
                'name.string' => 'Nama mitra harus berupa teks.',
                'name.min' => 'Nama mitra minimal 3 karakter.',
                'name.max' => 'Nama mitra maksimal 100 karakter.',
                'name.unique' => 'Nama mitra sudah digunakan.',
                'type.required' => 'Jenis mitra wajib dipilih.',
                'type.in' => 'Jenis mitra tidak valid.',
                'description.string' => 'Deskripsi harus berupa teks.',
                'description.max' => 'Deskripsi maksimal 500 karakter.',
                'description.no_html' => 'Deskripsi tidak boleh mengandung tag HTML.',
                'website_url.string' => 'Alamat situs harus berupa URL https yang valid.',
                'website_url.url' => 'Alamat situs harus berupa URL https yang valid.',
                'website_url.max' => 'Alamat situs maksimal 255 karakter.',
                'is_active.required' => 'Status aktif tidak valid.',
                'is_active.boolean' => 'Status aktif tidak valid.',
                'sort_order.integer' => 'Urutan harus berupa angka bulat.',
                'sort_order.between' => 'Urutan harus antara 0 dan 9999.',
                'logo_alt.required_with' => 'Teks alternatif logo wajib diisi.',
                'logo_alt.string' => 'Teks alternatif logo harus berupa teks.',
                'logo_alt.max' => 'Teks alternatif logo maksimal 255 karakter.',
            ],
        );
    }

    /**
     * Alt logo wajib untuk koleksi publik (BR-132): bila logo sudah ada dan form mengirim alt kosong tanpa berkas
     * baru, tolak (alt lama tetap). Dengan berkas baru, `required_with:logo` sudah menjaganya.
     *
     * @return array<int, callable>
     */
    public function after(): array
    {
        return [function (Validator $validator): void {
            $partner = $this->route('insurancePartner');

            if (! $partner instanceof InsurancePartner || $this->logoFile() !== null || ! $this->has('logo_alt') || $this->logoAlt() !== '') {
                return;
            }

            if ($partner->media()->where('collection', 'logo')->exists()) {
                $validator->errors()->add('logo_alt', 'Teks alternatif logo wajib diisi.');
            }
        }];
    }

    /**
     * Atribut model hasil validasi (tanpa `slug`).
     *
     * @return array{name: string, type: string, description: ?string, website_url: ?string, is_active: bool, sort_order: int}
     */
    public function insurancePartnerAttributes(): array
    {
        $data = $this->validated();

        return [
            'name' => (string) $data['name'],
            'type' => (string) $data['type'],
            'description' => $data['description'] ?? null,
            'website_url' => $data['website_url'] ?? null,
            'is_active' => (bool) $data['is_active'],
            'sort_order' => (int) ($data['sort_order'] ?? 0),
        ];
    }

    public function logoFile(): ?UploadedFile
    {
        $file = $this->file('logo');

        return $file instanceof UploadedFile ? $file : null;
    }

    public function logoAlt(): string
    {
        return trim((string) $this->input('logo_alt'));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\InsurancePartnerRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\MasterDataIndexRequest;
use App\Models\InsurancePartner;
use App\Services\Media\MediaService;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Admin #39 tab Mitra Asuransi (F-ADM-23). Mitra yang dirujuk appointment tidak dapat dihapus (BR-180, FK RESTRICT);
 * penolakan dilakukan di controller supaya berlaku juga untuk Super Admin (F4A-R21, pola D-44).
 */
class InsurancePartnerController extends Controller
{
    public function index(MasterDataIndexRequest $request): View
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', InsurancePartner::class);

        $partners = $request
            ->applyTo(InsurancePartner::query()->with('media'), ['name'])
            ->paginate($request->perPage());

        return view('admin.insurance-partners.index', ['partners' => $partners]);
    }

    public function create(): View
    {
        $this->authorize('create', InsurancePartner::class);

        return view('admin.insurance-partners.create');
    }

    public function store(InsurancePartnerRequest $request, MediaService $media): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', InsurancePartner::class);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $media): void {
            $partner = InsurancePartner::query()->create($request->insurancePartnerAttributes());
            $this->saveLogo($request, $media, $partner);
        });

        return redirect()->route('admin.insurance-partners.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.created', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.insurance_partner')]));
    }

    public function edit(InsurancePartner $insurancePartner): View
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $insurancePartner);

        return view('admin.insurance-partners.edit', ['partner' => $insurancePartner->load('media')]);
    }

    public function update(InsurancePartnerRequest $request, InsurancePartner $insurancePartner, MediaService $media): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $insurancePartner);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $media, $insurancePartner): void {
            $insurancePartner->update($request->insurancePartnerAttributes());
            $this->saveLogo($request, $media, $insurancePartner);
        });

        return redirect()->route('admin.insurance-partners.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.updated', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.insurance_partner')]));
    }

    /**
     * Penolakan di controller (bukan Policy) supaya berlaku juga untuk Super Admin. Logo ikut terhapus lewat trait
     * HasMedia; transaksi wajib agar berkas dihapus setelah commit.
     */
    public function destroy(InsurancePartner $insurancePartner): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $insurancePartner);

        $reason = $insurancePartner->deletionBlockedReason();

        if ($reason !== null) {
            return redirect()->route('admin.insurance-partners.index')
                ->with('error', __('messages.delete_blocked', ['reason' => $reason]));
        }

        DB::transaction(fn (): ?bool => $insurancePartner->delete());

        return redirect()->route('admin.insurance-partners.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.deleted', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.insurance_partner')]));
    }

    private function saveLogo(InsurancePartnerRequest $request, MediaService $media, InsurancePartner $partner): void
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $logo = $request->logoFile();

        if ($logo !== null) {
            $media->replace($partner, 'logo', $logo, ['alt_text' => $request->logoAlt()], $user);

            return;
        }

        if ($request->has('logo_alt')) {
            // Tanpa berkas baru: alt yang diedit diterapkan ke logo yang ada (caption tidak diubah).
            $existing = $partner->media()->where('collection', 'logo')->first();

            if ($existing !== null && $existing->alt_text !== $request->logoAlt()) {
                $media->updateMeta($existing, $request->logoAlt(), $existing->caption);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - Task 2: `App\Models\Page` (`KEYS`, `DEFAULTS`, `forKey()`, accessor `seo_title`, `seo_description`), `App\Models\InsurancePartner` (`scopeActive`, `scopeOrdered`, accessor `type_label`, relasi `media`), `Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent` (`createPage`, `createInsurancePartner`).

  - Task 11: admin mitra asuransi (hanya pengisi data; tugas ini tidak memanggilnya).
  - Fase 1-3: `x-layouts.public`, `x-breadcrumb`, `x-page-header`, `x-empty-state`, `x-image` (tipe `logo`), `Public\ClinicController`, `Public\DoctorController`, `Public\ScheduleController`, `SettingsService` (`string()`), `Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff`, `ImageFixtures`.
- Produces:
  - Prop `fullTitle` (bawaan `false`) pada `x-layouts.public` (F4A-R20): bila `true`, `<title>` berisi `{{ $title }}` saja tanpa sufiks nama situs.
  - Komponen anonim `x-open-graph` (F4A-R19): props `title`, `description`, `image`, `type`, `canonical`.
  - Partial `public.partials._page-body` (F4A-R18): satu-satunya tempat `pages.body` dirender dengan `{!! !!}`.
  - `App\Http\Controllers\Public\PageController` (`about`, `visionMission`, `insurance`, `registrationGuide`, `privacy`; helper privat `render()`).
  - Route `about` (`/profil`), `vision-mission` (`/visi-misi`), `insurance` (`/bpjs-asuransi`), `registration-guide` (`/panduan-pendaftaran`), `privacy` (`/kebijakan-privasi`).
  - View `public.about`, `public.vision-mission`, `public.insurance`, `public.registration-guide`, `public.privacy`.
  - #4/#6/#8 kini membaca `Page::forKey('clinics-index'|'doctors-index'|'schedules-index')` lewat variabel `$page`.

**Test IDs:** CRD-08 bagian halaman statis, EMP-01 (halaman tanpa baris `pages` tetap 200 dengan teks bawaan), EMP-03 (halaman berisi kosong tampil empty-state), SEK-15 (statis, `RawOutputScanTest`), BR-123 (fallback SEO), BR-128 (mitra berlabel "Contoh"), F-PUB-02/03/10/11/17, Review Focus 2 (rich text berbahaya atau kosong pada `pages.body`), F4A-R3, F4A-R4, F4A-R5, F4A-R18, F4A-R19, F4A-R20, F4A-R21.

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Layout.** `resources/views/components/layouts/public.blade.php:1` memuat `@props(['title', 'metaDescription' => null, 'noindex' => false])` dan baris 53 `<title>{{ $title }} — {{ $siteName }}</title>`. Perubahan hanya dua baris itu; hasil render tanpa `fullTitle` identik karakter per karakter (tes judul fase 1-3 tetap hijau). `x-layouts.patient` membungkus layout publik dan tidak meneruskan `fullTitle`, sehingga bawaan `false` berlaku.
- **Pola `@push('head')`.** `clinics/show.blade.php` mendorong meta `og:*` dari dalam slot layout. Slot dievaluasi sebelum layout dirender, jadi `@stack('head')` (layout baris 60) menerimanya. `x-open-graph` dipakai dengan cara yang sama.
- **Mengapa `forKey` tak melempar 404.** Tes fase 2-3 (`PublicClinicPagesTest`, `PublicDoctorIndexTest`, `PublicScheduleTest`, matriks AKS) berjalan di DB tanpa baris `pages`; F4A-R4 membuat `Page::forKey()` mengembalikan instance tak tersimpan dari `Page::DEFAULTS`. Nilai bawaan #6 dan #8 sama persis dengan teks statis lama (13 §8.8), jadi `PublicDoctorIndexTest` (`<title>Cari Dokter — …`, subjudul, meta description) dan `PublicScheduleTest` (baris 106-115) tidak berubah. Hanya #4 berubah (F4A-R3): hasil Grep tes yang mengunci teks lama hanyalah `tests/Feature/Public/PublicClinicPagesTest.php:100-101` ("Layanan Kami" dan "Poliklinik dan layanan penunjang UNPAM HOSPITAL."); tidak ada tes lain (`PublicClinicDetailTest`, `AdminPageMatrixTest`, `ErrorPagesTest`) yang mengasersi judul atau meta #4. Breadcrumb tiga halaman itu tetap statis ("Layanan", "Dokter", "Jadwal Dokter"), seperti kerangka (halaman fase 2-3 tidak direfaktor) dan seperti asersi lama.
- **Breadcrumb halaman berbasis `Page` (F4A-R31).** Label breadcrumb memakai teks statis pendek 05 §8 ("Profil", "Visi dan Misi", "BPJS dan Asuransi", "Panduan Pendaftaran", "Kebijakan Privasi"); `<h1>` dari `x-page-header` tetap `pages.title`. Tes memakai helper `crumb($key)`.
- **Pemindai `{!! !!}`.** `RawOutputScanTest` membaca baris demi baris dan mencocokkan `str_contains($line, '{!!')`. Partial `_page-body` harus berisi tepat satu baris, tanpa komentar yang memuat karakter tersebut.
- **Pengaman tautan mitra.** `insurance_partners.website_url` divalidasi `url:https` di admin (T11), tetapi view tetap hanya merender tautan bila nilainya diawali `https://` (pertahanan berlapis terhadap baris yang diisi lewat jalur lain, mis. `javascript:`).
- **Rute fase lain.** Tombol "Daftar Kunjungan", "Daftar Akun", "Kontak", dan tautan "FAQ" memakai `Route::has()` (F4A-R15). `faq` baru terdaftar di Task 14 dan `contact` di fase 4b; tes memeriksa kedua keadaan secara dinamis.
- Jumlah tes baru: ±62 (komponen 6, halaman konten ±46, pemasangan #4/#6/#8 10) ditambah 2 tes di `LayoutsTest`; `PublicClinicPagesTest` dan `RawOutputScanTest` hanya diedit.
