```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\View;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Blade;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * `x-open-graph` (F4A-R19): meta Open Graph dan canonical untuk halaman 4a. Anonim, tanpa JS, semua nilai di-escape.
 */
class OpenGraphComponentTest extends TestCase
{
    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $data */
    private function render(string $attributes, array $data = []): string
    {
        return Blade::render('<x-open-graph '.$attributes.' />', $data);
    }

    public function test_it_renders_type_and_title_only_by_default(): void
    {
        $html = $this->render('title="Judul Uji"');

        $this->assertStringContainsString('<meta property="og:type" content="website">', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<meta property="og:title" content="Judul Uji">', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('og:description', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('og:image', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('rel="canonical"', $html);
    }

    public function test_description_image_and_canonical_are_rendered_when_filled(): void
    {
        $html = $this->render(
            ':title="$title" :description="$description" :image="$image" :canonical="$canonical" type="article"',
            [
                'title' => 'Artikel Uji',
                'description' => 'Ringkasan artikel uji.',
                'image' => 'https://contoh.test/storage/cover.jpg',
                'canonical' => 'https://contoh.test/artikel/uji',
            ],
        );

        $this->assertStringContainsString('<meta property="og:type" content="article">', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<meta property="og:title" content="Artikel Uji">', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<meta property="og:description" content="Ringkasan artikel uji.">', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<meta property="og:image" content="https://contoh.test/storage/cover.jpg">', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<link rel="canonical" href="https://contoh.test/artikel/uji">', $html);
    }

    public function test_blank_description_image_and_canonical_are_omitted(): void
    {
        $html = $this->render(':title="$title" :description="$blank" :image="null" :canonical="$blank"', ['title' => 'Judul', 'blank' => '']);

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('og:description', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('og:image', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('rel="canonical"', $html);
    }

    public function test_every_value_is_escaped(): void
    {
        $html = $this->render(
            ':title="$title" :description="$title" :image="$title" :canonical="$title"',
            ['title' => 'Judul "uji" <b>tebal</b> & lain'],
        );

        $this->assertStringContainsString('content="Judul &quot;uji&quot; &lt;b&gt;tebal&lt;/b&gt; &amp; lain"', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<b>tebal</b>', $html);
        $this->assertSame(0, preg_match('/\son[a-z]+\s*=/i', $html));
    }

    public function test_it_is_an_anonymous_component_without_inline_script(): void
    {
        $this->assertFileExists(resource_path('views/components/open-graph.blade.php'));
        $this->assertFileDoesNotExist(resource_path('views/components/open-graph.php'));
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<script', $this->render('title="Judul Uji"'));
    }

    public function test_title_is_required(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(\Throwable::class);

        $this->render('description="tanpa judul"');
    }
}
```

`tests/Feature/Public/PublicContentPagesTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Public;

use App\Models\InsurancePartner;
use App\Models\Page;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Media\MediaService;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\ImageFixtures;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Halaman berbasis `pages` (F4A-R4/R5/R18): #2 Profil, #3 Visi dan Misi, #16 BPJS dan Asuransi, #17 Panduan
 * Pendaftaran, dan Kebijakan Privasi. DB kosong tetap 200 dengan teks bawaan (EMP-01); isi kosong tampil empty-state
 * (EMP-03); isi rich text tersanitasi (Review Focus 2).
 */
class PublicContentPagesTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Storage::fake('public');
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{string, string, string, string, string, string}> */
    public static function pageCases(): array
    {
        return [
            'about' => ['about', 'about', '/profil', 'Profil Rumah Sakit', 'Mengenal UNPAM HOSPITAL', 'Profil UNPAM HOSPITAL, rumah sakit prototipe di Universitas Pamulang Kampus 2 Viktor.'],
            'vision-mission' => ['vision-mission', 'vision-mission', '/visi-misi', 'Visi dan Misi', 'Arah dan komitmen pelayanan', 'Visi dan misi contoh UNPAM HOSPITAL.'],
            'insurance-info' => ['insurance-info', 'insurance', '/bpjs-asuransi', 'Informasi BPJS dan Asuransi', 'Persyaratan dan pembayaran', 'Informasi contoh tentang BPJS Kesehatan dan asuransi di UNPAM HOSPITAL.'],
            'registration-guide' => ['registration-guide', 'registration-guide', '/panduan-pendaftaran', 'Panduan Pendaftaran Pasien', 'Langkah mendaftar kunjungan rawat jalan', 'Panduan mendaftar kunjungan rawat jalan online maupun di loket.'],
            'privacy-policy' => ['privacy-policy', 'privacy', '/kebijakan-privasi', 'Kebijakan Privasi', 'Cara kami memperlakukan data Anda', 'Kebijakan privasi dan persetujuan penggunaan data pasien UNPAM HOSPITAL.'],
        ];
    }

    private function fakeRoute(string $name, string $uri): void
    {
        if (! Route::has($name)) {
            Route::middleware('web')->get($uri, fn () => 'x')->name($name);
            Route::getRoutes()->refreshNameLookups();
        }
    }

    /** Blok tautan terkait di akhir halaman (bukan menu atau footer). */
    private function relatedLinks(string $html): string
    {
        $this->assertSame(1, preg_match('/<nav[^>]*aria-label="Tautan terkait".*?<\/nav>/s', $html, $match), 'Blok tautan terkait tidak ditemukan.');

        return $match[0];
    }

    /** Label breadcrumb statis pendek (F4A-R31); judul <h1> tetap `pages.title`. */
    private function crumb(string $key): string
    {
        return [
            'about' => 'Profil',
            'vision-mission' => 'Visi dan Misi',
            'insurance-info' => 'BPJS dan Asuransi',
            'registration-guide' => 'Panduan Pendaftaran',
            'privacy-policy' => 'Kebijakan Privasi',
        ][$key];
    }

    private function defaultMetaDescription(): string
    {
        return 'Informasi layanan, dokter, jadwal, dan pendaftaran kunjungan rawat jalan di '.config('app.name').'.';
    }

    // --- DB kosong: teks bawaan dan empty-state (F4A-R4, EMP-01) --------------------------------

    #[DataProvider('pageCases')]
    public function test_it_renders_the_default_texts_and_an_empty_state_on_an_empty_database(string $key, string $route, string $uri, string $title, string $subtitle, string $meta): void
    {
        $this->assertSame($uri, route($route, [], false));
        $this->assertSame(0, Page::query()->count());

        $response = $this->get(route($route))->assertOk();

        $response->assertSee('<title>'.$title.' — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('<meta name="description" content="'.$meta.'">', false)
            ->assertSee($subtitle)
            ->assertSee('Konten sedang disiapkan')
            ->assertSee('Isi halaman ini sedang disiapkan oleh admin.')
            ->assertSee('<meta property="og:title" content="'.$title.'">', false)
            ->assertSee('<meta property="og:description" content="'.$meta.'">', false)
            ->assertSee('<link rel="canonical" href="'.route($route).'">', false)
            ->assertSee('aria-label="Breadcrumb"', false)
            ->assertSee('<li class="breadcrumb-item active" aria-current="page">'.$this->crumb($key).'</li>', false)
            ->assertDontSee('page-body')
            ->assertDontSee('<meta name="robots"', false);
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($response->getContent(), '<h1'));
        $this->assertSame(0, Page::query()->count(), 'Halaman publik tidak boleh membuat baris pages.');
    }

    // --- baris pages: judul, subjudul, SEO, isi (F4A-R5) -----------------------------------------

    #[DataProvider('pageCases')]
    public function test_it_renders_the_page_row_with_its_own_seo_fields_and_body(string $key, string $route): void
    {
        $this->createPage($key, [
            'title' => 'Judul Kustom',
            'subtitle' => 'Subjudul kustom',
            'body' => '<h2>Bagian Satu</h2><p>Isi kustom halaman.</p>',
            'meta_title' => 'Meta Judul Kustom',
            'meta_description' => 'Meta deskripsi kustom.',
        ]);

        $response = $this->get(route($route))->assertOk();

        $response->assertSee('<title>Meta Judul Kustom — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('<meta name="description" content="Meta deskripsi kustom.">', false)
            ->assertSee('<h1 class="mb-1">Judul Kustom</h1>', false)
            ->assertSee('Subjudul kustom')
            ->assertSee('<div class="rich-text page-body">', false)
            ->assertSee('<h2>Bagian Satu</h2>', false)
            ->assertSee('Isi kustom halaman.')
            ->assertSee('<meta property="og:title" content="Meta Judul Kustom">', false)
            ->assertSee('<meta property="og:description" content="Meta deskripsi kustom.">', false)
            ->assertSee('<li class="breadcrumb-item active" aria-current="page">'.$this->crumb($key).'</li>', false)
            ->assertDontSee('Konten sedang disiapkan');
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($response->getContent(), '<h1'));
    }

    #[DataProvider('pageCases')]
    public function test_title_falls_back_to_the_page_title_and_description_to_the_subtitle(string $key, string $route): void
    {
        $this->createPage($key, [
            'title' => 'Judul Kustom',
            'subtitle' => 'Subjudul sebagai deskripsi',
            'body' => '<p>Isi.</p>',
            'meta_title' => null,
            'meta_description' => null,
        ]);

        $this->get(route($route))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('<title>Judul Kustom — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('<meta name="description" content="Subjudul sebagai deskripsi">', false)
            ->assertSee('<meta property="og:title" content="Judul Kustom">', false);
    }

    #[DataProvider('pageCases')]
    public function test_description_falls_back_to_the_site_default_and_og_description_is_omitted(string $key, string $route): void
    {
        $this->createPage($key, [
            'subtitle' => null,
            'body' => '<p>Isi.</p>',
            'meta_title' => null,
            'meta_description' => null,
        ]);

        $this->get(route($route))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('<meta name="description" content="'.$this->defaultMetaDescription().'">', false)
            ->assertDontSee('og:description', false);
    }

    // --- rich text berbahaya atau kosong (Review Focus 2, F4A-R18) -------------------------------

    #[DataProvider('pageCases')]
    public function test_a_dangerous_body_is_stored_clean_and_rendered_clean(string $key, string $route): void
    {
        $this->createPage($key, [
            'body' => '<p>Teks aman</p><script>alert(1)</script><p onclick="x()" style="color:red">Gaya</p>'
                .'<img src="x" onerror="alert(2)"><a href="javascript:alert(3)">klik</a>',
        ]);

        $stored = (string) Page::query()->where('key', $key)->value('body');

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Teks aman', $stored);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<script', $stored);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('onclick', $stored);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('onerror', $stored);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('javascript:', $stored);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('color:red', $stored);

        $this->get(route($route))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Teks aman')
            ->assertDontSee('<script>alert', false)
            ->assertDontSee('onclick', false)
            ->assertDontSee('onerror', false)
            ->assertDontSee('javascript:', false)
            ->assertDontSee('color:red', false);
    }

    #[DataProvider('pageCases')]
    public function test_a_visually_blank_body_is_stored_as_null_and_shows_the_empty_state(string $key, string $route): void
    {
        foreach (['<p><br></p>', '<p>&nbsp;</p>', "  \n  "] as $blank) {
            $this->createPage($key, ['body' => $blank]);

            $this->assertNull(Page::query()->where('key', $key)->value('body'), $blank);

            $this->get(route($route))
                ->assertOk()
                ->assertSee('Konten sedang disiapkan')
                ->assertDontSee('page-body');

            Page::query()->where('key', $key)->delete();
        }
    }

    public function test_the_pages_are_identical_for_guests_patients_and_staff(): void
    {
        $this->createPage('about', ['body' => '<p>Profil terbuka untuk semua.</p>']);

        $this->get(route('about'))->assertOk()->assertSee('Profil terbuka untuk semua.');
        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->patient()->create())->get(route('about'))->assertOk()->assertSee('Profil terbuka untuk semua.');

        foreach (['content-admin', 'registration-officer', 'super-admin'] as $role) {
            $this->actingAs($this->createStaff($role))->get(route('about'))->assertOk()->assertSee('Profil terbuka untuk semua.');
        }
    }

    // --- Kebijakan Privasi ------------------------------------------------------------------------

                'BPJS Kesehatan',
                'Informasi ini contoh dan harus diverifikasi',
                'Mitra Asuransi dan Perusahaan (Contoh)',
                'Urutan Contoh',
            ]);
    }

    // --- semua halaman: keamanan markup -------------------------------------------------------------

    #[DataProvider('pageCases')]
    public function test_pages_have_no_inline_handlers_and_no_javascript_urls(string $key, string $route): void
    {
        $this->createPage($key, ['body' => '<p>Isi.</p>']);

        $html = (string) $this->get(route($route))->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertSame(0, preg_match('/\son[a-z]+\s*=/i', $html));
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('javascript:', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('onerror', $html);
    }
}
```

`tests/Feature/Public/PublicPageBindingsTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Public;

use App\Models\Page;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Pemasangan `Page` di #4 `clinics.index`, #6 `doctors.index`, dan #8 `schedules.index` (F4A-R3, F4A-R4, F4A-R5).
 * Tanpa baris `pages`: teks bawaan (#6 dan #8 sama persis dengan teks statis fase 3; #4 memakai teks 13 §8.8). Dengan
 * baris `pages`: judul, subjudul, dan meta mengikutinya. Breadcrumb ketiganya tetap statis.
 */
class PublicPageBindingsTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    /** @return array<string, array{string, string, string, string, string, string}> */
    public static function bindings(): array
    {
        return [
            'clinics-index' => ['clinics-index', 'clinics.index', 'Layanan dan Poliklinik', 'Pilih layanan sesuai kebutuhan Anda', 'Daftar poliklinik dan layanan penunjang UNPAM HOSPITAL.', 'Layanan'],
            'doctors-index' => ['doctors-index', 'doctors.index', 'Cari Dokter', 'Cari berdasarkan nama, spesialisasi, poliklinik, atau tanggal praktik', 'Cari dokter UNPAM HOSPITAL berdasarkan nama, spesialisasi, poliklinik, dan tanggal.', 'Dokter'],
            'schedules-index' => ['schedules-index', 'schedules.index', 'Jadwal Dokter', 'Jadwal praktik per minggu', 'Jadwal praktik dokter UNPAM HOSPITAL per minggu dengan sisa kuota.', 'Jadwal Dokter'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('bindings')]
    public function test_without_a_page_row_the_defaults_are_used(string $key, string $route, string $title, string $subtitle, string $meta, string $crumb): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(0, Page::query()->count());

        $response = $this->get(route($route))->assertOk();

        $response->assertSee('<title>'.$title.' — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('<h1 class="mb-1">'.$title.'</h1>', false)
            ->assertSee($subtitle)
            ->assertSee('<meta name="description" content="'.$meta.'">', false)
            ->assertSee('<li class="breadcrumb-item active" aria-current="page">'.$crumb.'</li>', false);
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($response->getContent(), '<h1'));
        $this->assertSame(0, Page::query()->count());
    }

    #[DataProvider('bindings')]
    public function test_a_page_row_overrides_title_subtitle_and_meta(string $key, string $route, string $title, string $subtitle, string $meta, string $crumb): void
    {
        $this->createPage($key, [
            'title' => 'Judul Diubah Admin',
            'subtitle' => 'Subjudul diubah admin',
            'meta_title' => 'Meta Judul Admin',
            'meta_description' => 'Deskripsi meta dari admin.',
        ]);

        $this->get(route($route))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('<title>Meta Judul Admin — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('<h1 class="mb-1">Judul Diubah Admin</h1>', false)
            ->assertSee('Subjudul diubah admin')
            ->assertSee('<meta name="description" content="Deskripsi meta dari admin.">', false)
            ->assertSee('<li class="breadcrumb-item active" aria-current="page">'.$crumb.'</li>', false);
    }

    #[DataProvider('bindings')]
    public function test_title_and_description_fall_back_to_the_page_title_and_subtitle(string $key, string $route): void
    {
        $this->createPage($key, [
            'title' => 'Judul Tanpa Meta',
            'subtitle' => 'Subjudul sebagai deskripsi',
            'meta_title' => null,
            'meta_description' => null,
        ]);

        $this->get(route($route))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('<title>Judul Tanpa Meta — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('<meta name="description" content="Subjudul sebagai deskripsi">', false);
    }

    public function test_the_doctors_page_example_from_the_plan_follows_the_page_row(): void
    {
        $this->createPage('doctors-index', ['title' => 'Temukan Dokter']);

        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('<h1 class="mb-1">Temukan Dokter</h1>', false)
            ->assertSee('<link rel="canonical" href="'.route('doctors.index').'">', false);
    }
}
```

`app/Http/Controllers/Public/PageController.php` (tool Write):

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Public;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\InsurancePartner;
use App\Models\Page;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Halaman publik berbasis tabel `pages`: #2 Profil, #3 Visi dan Misi, #16 BPJS dan Asuransi, #17 Panduan Pendaftaran,
 * dan Kebijakan Privasi (11 §4.1). Judul, subjudul, SEO, dan isi dibaca lewat Page::forKey(), yang tidak pernah 404:
 * baris yang belum ada diganti teks bawaan (F4A-R4). Isi rich text sudah tersanitasi saat disimpan.
 */
class PageController extends Controller
{
    public function about(): View
    {
        return $this->render('about', 'public.about');
    }

    public function visionMission(): View
    {
        return $this->render('vision-mission', 'public.vision-mission');
    }

    public function insurance(): View
    {
        return $this->render('insurance-info', 'public.insurance', [
            'partners' => InsurancePartner::query()->active()->ordered()->with('media')->get(),
        ]);
    }

    public function registrationGuide(): View
    {
        return $this->render('registration-guide', 'public.registration-guide');
    }

    public function privacy(): View
    {
        return $this->render('privacy-policy', 'public.privacy');
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $extra
     */
    private function render(string $key, string $view, array $extra = []): View
    {
        return view($view, ['page' => Page::forKey($key)] + $extra);
    }
}
```

### Task 13: Halaman publik #18 Daftar Artikel dan #19 Detail Artikel

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Http/Requests/Public/ArticleIndexRequest.php`, `app/Http/Controllers/Public/ArticleController.php`
- Create: `resources/views/public/articles/index.blade.php`, `resources/views/public/articles/show.blade.php`, `resources/views/public/partials/_article-card.blade.php`
- Modify: `routes/web.php` (impor `ArticleController`; route `articles.index` dan `articles.show`)
- Modify: `tests/Feature/View/RawOutputScanTest.php` (daftar harapan `{!! !!}` bertambah satu baris)
- Test (baru): `tests/Feature/Public/PublicArticlesTest.php`
- Tidak diubah: `resources/views/public/partials/_page-body.blade.php`, `x-open-graph`, layout publik (semuanya dari Task 12), `public/home.blade.php` (Task 15 memakai ulang `_article-card`), `resources/js` dan `resources/scss`.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - Task 2: `App\Models\Article` (scope `published`, `newestFirst`, `search`, `inCategory`; `isPubliclyVisible()`; accessor `reading_time_minutes`, `seo_title`, `seo_description`; relasi `category`, `author`, `media`), `App\Models\ArticleCategory` (scope `ordered`, kolom `slug`, `name`), `App\Models\Page::forKey()`, `Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent` (`createArticle`, `createArticleCategory`, `createPage`).
  - Task 8: admin artikel (hanya pengisi data; tugas ini tidak memanggilnya).
  - Task 12: `x-open-graph`, prop layout publik, pola `Page` + `seo_title`/`seo_description`, `Route`/`routes/web.php` dengan blok `PageController` (anchor edit route di bawah).
  - Fase 1-3: `x-layouts.public`, `x-breadcrumb`, `x-page-header`, `x-empty-state`, `x-image` (tipe `article`, rasio `16x9`), `x-form.input`, `x-form.select`, `x-loading-button`, `MediaService`, `ImageFixtures`, `InteractsWithStaff`, pola `Public\DoctorIndexRequest`.
- Produces:
  - `App\Http\Requests\Public\ArticleIndexRequest` (`rules()`, `failedValidation()` tanpa melempar, `filters(): array{kategori: ?ArticleCategory, q: ?string}`), berdiri sendiri sesuai pola D-101 dan F4A-R12.
  - `App\Http\Controllers\Public\ArticleController` (`PER_PAGE = 9`, `RELATED = 3`, `index()`, `show()`).
  - Route `articles.index` (`/artikel`) dan `articles.show` (`/artikel/{article:slug}`).
  - View `public.articles.index`, `public.articles.show`.
  - Partial `public.partials._article-card` (variabel `$article`, `$headingLevel` bawaan 3) untuk #18, artikel terkait #19, dan beranda (Task 15).

**Test IDs:** CRD-08 (hanya artikel tayang, terbaru dahulu), CRD-09 bagian artikel (kategori), VAL-07 (parameter publik tidak valid), EMP-02 (pencarian tanpa hasil), SEK-15 (statis, `RawOutputScanTest`), BR-123 (fallback SEO artikel), Review Focus 1 (batas waktu tayang: sekarang, +1 menit, -1 menit, draf ber-`published_at`, terhapus), Review Focus 2 (isi artikel tersanitasi), Review Focus 3 (parameter publik tidak valid), F4A-R5, F4A-R10, F4A-R12, F4A-R13, F4A-R18, F4A-R19.

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Pola request.** `app/Http/Requests/Public/DoctorIndexRequest.php` memperluas `FormRequest`, `failedValidation()` kosong, dan `filters()` memakai `getValidatorInstance()->valid()` (nilai yang gagal otomatis dibuang). `ArticleIndexRequest` memakai pola yang sama tetapi tanpa pesan inline: nilai tidak valid diabaikan diam-diam (F4A-R12), dan `per_page` tidak dibuka. `kategori` dibatasi regex slug `[a-z0-9-]` sehingga `%00`, huruf besar, dan array ditolak sebelum menyentuh DB; slug yang lolos tetapi tidak ada menghasilkan `ArticleCategory` `null` (filter diabaikan).
- **Paginasi.** Parameter `page` dibaca paginator sendiri: `abc`, `0`, `-5`, dan `page[]=1` menjadi halaman 1 (`LengthAwarePaginator::resolveCurrentPage`). Tautan paginasi memakai `->appends([...])` hanya dengan filter yang valid, bukan `withQueryString()`, agar `q` 101 karakter atau `kategori` ngawur tidak terbawa ke tautan.
- **Zona waktu dan batas tayang.** `Article::scopePublished` membandingkan `published_at <= now()` waktu aplikasi (F4A-R10); tes memakai `travelTo('2026-10-05 10:00:00')` sehingga "sekarang" tepat sama dengan `published_at` (tayang), +1 menit tidak, -1 menit tayang.
- **404 untuk semua aktor.** `articles.show` tidak memakai Policy: `abort_unless($article->isPubliclyVisible(), 404)`. Artikel soft-deleted sudah 404 oleh binding `{article:slug}` (global scope `SoftDeletes`).
- **Mode ketat.** Daftar memuat `category` dan `media` (hanya koleksi `cover`); kartu memakai `firstMedia('cover')`. Detail memuat `category`, `author:id,name`, dan `media` cover; artikel terkait memuat `category` dan `media` yang sama. `author` tidak dibutuhkan kartu.
- **HTML mentah.** `{!! !!}` untuk `articles.body` hanya satu baris di `public/articles/show.blade.php` (F4A-R18); `RawOutputScanTest` mengurutkan temuan, sehingga baris artikel (`public/articles/...`) muncul sebelum `public/clinics/...` dan `public/partials/...`. Teks lama Edit di bawah adalah daftar persis hasil Task 12.
- **Heading.** `<h1>` dari `x-page-header` (judul `articles-index` pada #18, judul artikel pada #19). Kartu pada #18 memakai `<h2>`; kartu terkait pada #19 memakai `<h3>` di bawah `<h2>` "Artikel Terkait".
- **Breadcrumb.** #18 memakai label statis "Artikel" (sama dengan #4/#6/#8 yang tidak berubah dari fase 2-3); #19 "Artikel" (tautan) lalu judul artikel.
- Jumlah tes baru: ±52.

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Public;

use App\Enums\ArticleStatus;
use App\Models\Article;
use App\Models\Media;
use App\Services\Media\MediaService;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\ImageFixtures;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Halaman #18 `articles.index` dan #19 `articles.show` (05 hal. 18-19, F4A-R5/R10/R12/R13): hanya artikel yang tayang
 * (terbit dan `published_at` <= sekarang, belum dihapus), filter `kategori` dan `q` yang longgar, paginasi sembilan,
 * dan SEO artikel. Mencakup CRD-08, VAL-07, EMP-02, serta Review Focus 1, 2, dan 3.
 */
class PublicArticlesTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Storage::fake('public');
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 10:00:00');
    }

    private function cover(Article $article, ?string $alt = null): Media
    {
        return $this->app->make(MediaService::class)->store(
            ImageFixtures::jpeg(1200, 675, 'cover.jpg'),
            'cover',
            $article,
            ['alt_text' => $alt ?? 'Cover '.$article->title],
        );
    }

    private function withoutCategory(Article $article): Article
    {
        Article::query()->whereKey($article->id)->update(['article_category_id' => null]);

        return $article->refresh();
    }

    private function withoutAuthor(Article $article): Article
    {
        Article::query()->whereKey($article->id)->update(['author_user_id' => null]);

        return $article->refresh();
    }

    private function showUrl(Article $article): string
    {
        return route('articles.show', $article->slug);
    }

    private function noindexTag(): string
    {
        return '<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">';
    }

    // --- #18: header, SEO, formulir (F4A-R5) ----------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_index_renders_the_default_header_seo_breadcrumb_and_search_form(): void
    {
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Satu Artikel']);

        $response = $this->get(route('articles.index'))->assertOk();

        $response->assertSee('<title>Artikel Kesehatan — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('<h1 class="mb-1">Artikel Kesehatan</h1>', false)
            ->assertSee('Informasi kesehatan umum')
            ->assertSee('<meta name="description" content="Artikel kesehatan umum dari UNPAM HOSPITAL.">', false)
            ->assertSee('<meta property="og:title" content="Artikel Kesehatan">', false)
            ->assertSee('<link rel="canonical" href="'.route('articles.index').'">', false)
            ->assertSeeInOrder(['aria-label="Breadcrumb"', 'Beranda', 'Artikel'], false)
            ->assertSee('<li class="breadcrumb-item active" aria-current="page">Artikel</li>', false)
            ->assertSee('role="search"', false)
            ->assertSee('name="q"', false)
            ->assertSee('name="kategori"', false)
            ->assertSee('Semua kategori')
            ->assertSee('Reset')
            ->assertDontSee($this->noindexTag(), false);
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($response->getContent(), '<h1'));
    }

    public function test_index_header_and_seo_follow_the_articles_index_page_row(): void
    {
        $this->createPage('articles-index', [
            'title' => 'Warta Sehat',
            'subtitle' => 'Kabar kesehatan terbaru',
            'meta_title' => 'Warta Sehat Meta',
            'meta_description' => 'Deskripsi warta sehat.',
        ]);
        $this->createArticle();

        $this->get(route('articles.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('<title>Warta Sehat Meta — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('<h1 class="mb-1">Warta Sehat</h1>', false)
            ->assertSee('Kabar kesehatan terbaru')
            ->assertSee('<meta name="description" content="Deskripsi warta sehat.">', false)
            ->assertSee('<li class="breadcrumb-item active" aria-current="page">Artikel</li>', false);
    }

    // --- tayang: hanya terbit dan sudah waktunya (CRD-08, Review Focus 1) --------------------------------

    public function test_index_lists_only_live_articles_newest_first_with_inclusive_time_bounds(): void
    {
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Artikel Lama', 'published_at' => now()->subDays(3)]);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Artikel Baru', 'published_at' => now()->subDay()]);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Judul Sekarang', 'published_at' => now()]);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Judul Semenit Lalu', 'published_at' => now()->subMinute()]);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Judul Semenit Lagi', 'published_at' => now()->addMinute()]);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Draf Rahasia', 'status' => ArticleStatus::Draft, 'published_at' => now()->subDay()]);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Terhapus Rahasia'])->delete();

        $this->get(route('articles.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSeeInOrder(['Judul Sekarang', 'Judul Semenit Lalu', 'Artikel Baru', 'Artikel Lama'])
            ->assertSee('Menampilkan 4 dari 4 artikel')
            ->assertDontSee('Judul Semenit Lagi')
            ->assertDontSee('Draf Rahasia')
            ->assertDontSee('Terhapus Rahasia');
    }

    public function test_a_scheduled_article_goes_live_when_its_time_arrives(): void
    {
        $article = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Segera Tayang', 'published_at' => now()->addMinutes(30)]);

        $this->get(route('articles.index'))->assertOk()->assertDontSee('Segera Tayang');
        $this->get($this->showUrl($article))->assertNotFound();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 10:30:00');

        $this->get(route('articles.index'))->assertOk()->assertSee('Segera Tayang');
        $this->get($this->showUrl($article))->assertOk()->assertSee('Segera Tayang');
    }

    public function test_detail_boundaries_now_and_one_minute_ago_are_live_and_one_minute_ahead_is_not(): void
    {
        $now = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Tepat Sekarang', 'published_at' => now()]);
        $ago = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Semenit Lalu', 'published_at' => now()->subMinute()]);
        $ahead = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Semenit Lagi', 'published_at' => now()->addMinute()]);

        $this->get($this->showUrl($now))->assertOk();
        $this->get($this->showUrl($ago))->assertOk();
        $this->get($this->showUrl($ahead))->assertNotFound();
    }

    public function test_draft_scheduled_and_trashed_articles_are_404_for_everyone_including_staff(): void
    {
        $draft = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Draf', 'status' => ArticleStatus::Draft, 'published_at' => now()->subDay()]);
        $scheduled = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Terjadwal', 'published_at' => now()->addDay()]);
        $trashed = $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Terhapus']);
        $trashed->delete();

        foreach ([$draft, $scheduled, $trashed] as $article) {
            $this->get($this->showUrl($article))->assertNotFound();
        }

        foreach (['content-admin', 'super-admin'] as $role) {
            $this->actingAs($this->createStaff($role));

            foreach ([$draft, $scheduled, $trashed] as $article) {
                $this->get($this->showUrl($article))->assertNotFound();
            }
        }
    }

    public function test_an_unknown_slug_is_404(): void
    {
        $this->get(route('articles.show', 'tidak-ada'))->assertNotFound();
        $this->get('/artikel/Tidak%20Ada')->assertNotFound();
    }

    // --- filter kategori dan pencarian (CRD-09, F4A-R12) --------------------------------------------------

    public function test_filtering_by_category_lists_only_its_articles_and_adds_the_category_to_the_title(): void
    {
        $gizi = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Gizi']);
        $jantung = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Jantung']);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Pola Makan Seimbang'], $gizi);

            ->assertSee('<link rel="canonical" href="'.route('articles.index').'">', false)
            ->assertSee('<option value="gizi" selected>Gizi</option>', false);

    public function test_the_category_select_lists_every_category_in_order(): void
    {
        $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Jantung', 'sort_order' => 2]);
        $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Gizi', 'sort_order' => 1]);

        $this->get(route('articles.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSeeInOrder(['>Semua kategori</option>', '>Gizi</option>', '>Jantung</option>'], false);
    }

    public function test_searching_matches_title_and_excerpt_case_insensitively_and_trims_the_term(): void
    {
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Pola Makan Seimbang', 'excerpt' => 'Tips gizi harian.']);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Olahraga Ringan', 'excerpt' => 'Gerak tiap hari.']);

        $this->get(route('articles.index', ['q' => '  gerak  ']))->assertOk()->assertSee('Olahraga Ringan')->assertDontSee('Tidur Cukup');
        $this->get(route('articles.index', ['q' => 'gerak']))->assertOk()->assertSee('value="gerak"', false);
    }

    public function test_like_wildcards_in_the_search_term_are_matched_literally(): void
    {
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Kolesterol 100% Terkontrol']);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Tips_Sehat Harian']);
```

`app/Http/Requests/Public/ArticleIndexRequest.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Requests\Public;

use App\Models\ArticleCategory;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\Validator;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

/**
 * Filter halaman #18 Daftar Artikel (05 hal. 18, F4A-R12): `kategori` (slug kategori yang ada) dan `q` (maksimal 100
 * karakter). Berdiri sendiri seperti DoctorIndexRequest (D-101): nilai yang tidak lolos aturan diabaikan tanpa pesan,
 * tidak pernah menjadi galat 500 atau pengalihan. `per_page` tidak dibuka di publik.
 */
final class ArticleIndexRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, string>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'kategori' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:120', 'regex:/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/'],
            'q' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'page' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Tidak melempar: filter yang tidak valid diabaikan dan halaman tetap tampil (VAL-07).
     */
    protected function failedValidation(Validator $validator): void
    {
        //
    }

    /**
     * Hanya nilai yang lolos aturan. `kategori` yang lolos tetapi tidak ada di DB menjadi null (diabaikan).
     *
     * @return array{kategori: ?ArticleCategory, q: ?string}
     */
    public function filters(): array
    {
        $valid = $this->getValidatorInstance()->valid();

        $slug = is_string($valid['kategori'] ?? null) ? trim($valid['kategori']) : '';
        $term = is_string($valid['q'] ?? null) ? trim($valid['q']) : '';

        return [
            'kategori' => $slug === '' ? null : ArticleCategory::query()->where('slug', $slug)->first(),
            'q' => $term === '' ? null : $term,
        ];
    }
}
```

`app/Http/Controllers/Public/ArticleController.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Public;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Public\ArticleIndexRequest;
use App\Models\Article;
use App\Models\ArticleCategory;
use App\Models\Page;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Halaman publik artikel (#18 `articles.index`, #19 `articles.show`). Hanya artikel yang tayang (terbit, `published_at`
 * <= sekarang, belum dihapus; F4A-R10). Tanpa Policy: yang tidak tayang menjawab 404 untuk semua orang, termasuk staf.
 */
class ArticleController extends Controller
{
    /** Jumlah kartu per halaman (F4A-R13). */
    public const PER_PAGE = 9;

    /** Jumlah artikel terkait pada halaman detail. */
    public const RELATED = 3;

    public function index(ArticleIndexRequest $request): View
    {
        $filters = $request->filters();
        $category = $filters['kategori'];
        $term = $filters['q'];

        $articles = Article::query()
            ->published()
            ->with(['category', 'media' => fn ($query) => $query->where('collection', 'cover')])
            ->when($category !== null, fn (Builder $query) => $query->inCategory($category->slug))
            ->search($term)
            ->newestFirst()
            ->paginate(self::PER_PAGE)
            ->appends(array_filter(['kategori' => $category?->slug, 'q' => $term], fn (?string $value): bool => $value !== null));

        $page = Page::forKey('articles-index');

        // Judul: judul halaman, ditambah nama kategori dan nomor halaman (>= 2) (F4A-R5, 05 §7).
        $title = $page->seo_title;

        if ($category !== null) {
            $title .= ' — '.$category->name;
        }

        if ($articles->currentPage() > 1) {
            $title .= ' — Halaman '.$articles->currentPage();
        }

        $categories = ArticleCategory::query()->ordered()->get(['id', 'name', 'slug']);

        return view('public.articles.index', [
            'page' => $page,
            'title' => $title,
            'articles' => $articles,
            'category' => $category,
            'term' => $term,
            'categoryOptions' => ['' => 'Semua kategori'] + $categories->pluck('name', 'slug')->all(),
        ]);
    }

    public function show(Article $article): View
    {
        // Tanpa Policy: draf, terjadwal, atau terhapus (binding SoftDeletes) = 404 untuk semua orang, termasuk staf.
        abort_unless($article->isPubliclyVisible(), 404);

        $article->load([
            'category',
            'author:id,name',
            'media' => fn ($query) => $query->where('collection', 'cover'),
        ]);

        /** @var Collection<int, Article> $related */
        $related = $article->article_category_id === null
            ? collect()
            : Article::query()
                ->published()
                ->where('article_category_id', $article->article_category_id)
                ->whereKeyNot($article->getKey())
                ->with(['category', 'media' => fn ($query) => $query->where('collection', 'cover')])
                ->newestFirst()
                ->limit(self::RELATED)
                ->get();

        return view('public.articles.show', [
            'article' => $article,
            'related' => $related,
        ]);
    }
}
```

### Task 14: Halaman publik #20 Galeri, detail album, dan #21 FAQ

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Http/Controllers/Public/GalleryController.php`, `app/Http/Controllers/Public/FaqController.php`
- Create: `resources/views/public/galleries/index.blade.php`, `resources/views/public/galleries/show.blade.php`, `resources/views/public/faq.blade.php`
- Modify: `routes/web.php` (impor `FaqController` dan `GalleryController`; route `galleries.index`, `galleries.show`, `faq`)
- Modify: `resources/scss/_public.scss` (kelas `.faq-answer`)
- Test (baru): `tests/Feature/Public/PublicGalleriesTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Public/PublicFaqTest.php`
- Modify (tes lama): `tests/Feature/Public/PublicClinicDetailTest.php` (butir menu "Galeri" kini tampil di header/footer, jadi asersi `assertDontSee('Galeri')` diganti dengan id judul blok galeri poliklinik)
- Tidak diubah: `resources/js/app.js` (`initGalleryModals()` dipakai apa adanya), `public/clinics/show.blade.php` (hanya dijadikan contoh markup), `RawOutputScanTest` (tidak ada `{!! !!}` baru), `x-open-graph` dan layout publik (Task 12).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - Task 2: `App\Models\Gallery` (scope `published`, `ordered`; `coverMedia()`; `is_published`; relasi `media`; koleksi `photos`), `App\Models\Faq` (`CATEGORIES`, `CATEGORY_LABELS`, scope `published`, `ordered`; accessor `category_label`), `App\Models\Page::forKey()`, `Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent` (`createGallery`, `addGalleryPhoto`, `createFaq`, `createPage`).
  - Task 9 dan 10: admin galeri dan FAQ (hanya pengisi data; tugas ini tidak memanggilnya).
  - Task 12: `x-open-graph`, pola `Page` + `seo_title`/`seo_description`, blok route publik.
  - Task 13: blok route artikel (anchor edit route di bawah).
  - Fase 1-3: `x-layouts.public`, `x-breadcrumb`, `x-page-header`, `x-empty-state`, `x-image` (tipe `gallery`, rasio `4x3`), `initGalleryModals()` (`[data-gallery-modal]`, `data-gallery-index`), `MediaService`, `ImageFixtures`, `InteractsWithStaff`.
- Produces:
  - `App\Http\Controllers\Public\GalleryController` (`PER_PAGE = 12`, `index()`, `show()`), `App\Http\Controllers\Public\FaqController` (`index()`).
  - Route `galleries.index` (`/galeri`), `galleries.show` (`/galeri/{gallery:slug}`), `faq` (`/faq`).
  - View `public.galleries.index`, `public.galleries.show`, `public.faq`.
  - Kelas SCSS `.faq-answer` (`white-space: pre-line`, `overflow-wrap: anywhere`).

**Test IDs:** CRD-10 (judul FAQ dari baris `pages`), EMP-03 (album dan FAQ kosong), Review Focus 3 (parameter `page` tidak valid, album draf), Review Focus 1 (album tidak terbit 404 untuk semua aktor), F4A-R5 (SEO detail album), F4A-R13 (12 album per halaman), F4A-R22 (kelompok FAQ per kategori), F4A-R23 (sampul = foto pertama, detail memakai ulang pola modal klinik), SEK (jawaban FAQ di-escape).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Pola modal.** `resources/views/public/clinics/show.blade.php` memakai tombol `gallery-thumb` (`data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#galeri-modal" data-gallery-index`), satu modal `#galeri-modal` bertanda `data-gallery-modal`, dan satu carousel `#galeri-carousel` (`data-bs-ride="false"`, `tabindex="-1"`). `initGalleryModals()` (`resources/js/app.js:206-231`) mencari `[data-gallery-modal]`, membuat instance Carousel sejak awal, dan menyetel slide aktif dari `data-gallery-index` pemicu. Detail album memakai markup yang sama persis sehingga JS tidak berubah; `RawOutputScanTest` tetap menjaga kontraknya.
- **Mode ketat.** `Gallery::coverMedia()` dan `mediaIn('photos')` bertumpu pada relasi `media`; daftar dan detail memuat `media` dengan batasan koleksi `photos`. Daftar memuat seluruh foto album halaman itu (maksimal 12 x 100 baris) karena jumlah foto dan sampul dihitung dari koleksi yang sama.
- **Judul dan deskripsi detail (F4A-R5).** Judul `"{title} — Galeri"` lalu layout menambah `" — {site.name}"`; deskripsi `Str::limit(description, 160, '')`, atau `meta_description` baris `pages` `galleries-index` bila deskripsi album kosong. Daftar #20 memakai `Page::forKey('galleries-index')` dan menambah " — Halaman N" mulai halaman 2 (05 §7).
- **Paginasi.** #20 tanpa filter, jadi `page` yang tidak valid (`abc`, `0`, `-3`, `page[]=1`) otomatis menjadi halaman 1 oleh paginator; halaman di luar jangkauan menampilkan pemberitahuan seperti #6, dengan `noindex`.
- **Teks jawaban FAQ.** `faqs.answer` dirender dengan `{{ }}`; baris baru dipertahankan oleh `.faq-answer { white-space: pre-line }` (Bootstrap tidak punya utilitas `pre-line`; `.doctor-bio` sudah ada tetapi bermakna lain). Karena tugas ini mengubah `resources/scss`, `npm run build` dijalankan sebelum suite (kontrak `FrontendManifestTest`).
- **Accordion tanpa JS baru.** Bootstrap `collapse` bekerja lewat atribut `data-bs-*` yang sudah dimuat `app.js`; semua pertanyaan tertutup awalnya (`collapsed`, `aria-expanded="false"`). `data-bs-parent` per kategori membuat hanya satu jawaban terbuka per kelompok.
- **Heading.** `<h1>` dari `x-page-header`; #21: `<h2>` per kategori dan `<h3 class="accordion-header">` per pertanyaan; #20: `<h2>` per kartu album.
- Jumlah tes baru: ±48 (galeri ±30, FAQ ±18).

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Public;

use App\Services\Media\MediaService;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\ImageFixtures;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Halaman #20 `galleries.index` dan detail album `galleries.show` (05 hal. 20 dan §6.1, F4A-R5/R13/R23): hanya album
 * terbit; 404 untuk album draf bagi semua aktor termasuk staf; sampul = foto pertama; detail memakai ulang pola modal
 * dan carousel galeri poliklinik.
 */
class PublicGalleriesTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Storage::fake('public');
    }

    /** Foto sungguhan lewat MediaService (berkas dan thumbnail ada di disk palsu). */
    private function uploadPhoto(Gallery $gallery, string $alt, ?string $caption = null): void
    {
        $this->app->make(MediaService::class)->store(
            ImageFixtures::jpeg(1200, 800, 'foto.jpg'),
            'photos',
            $gallery,
            ['alt_text' => $alt, 'caption' => $caption],
        );
    }

    private function noindexTag(): string
    {
        return '<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">';
    }

    // --- #20: header, SEO, breadcrumb (F4A-R5) ---------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_index_renders_the_default_header_seo_and_breadcrumb(): void
    {
        $this->createGallery(['title' => 'Album Satu']);

        $response = $this->get(route('galleries.index'))->assertOk();

        $response->assertSee('<title>Galeri — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('<h1 class="mb-1">Galeri</h1>', false)
            ->assertSee('Foto-foto contoh')
            ->assertSee('<meta name="description" content="Galeri foto UNPAM HOSPITAL.">', false)
            ->assertSee('<meta property="og:title" content="Galeri">', false)
            ->assertSee('<link rel="canonical" href="'.route('galleries.index').'">', false)
            ->assertSeeInOrder(['aria-label="Breadcrumb"', 'Beranda', 'Galeri'], false)
            ->assertSee('<li class="breadcrumb-item active" aria-current="page">Galeri</li>', false)
            ->assertDontSee($this->noindexTag(), false);
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($response->getContent(), '<h1'));
    }

    public function test_index_header_and_seo_follow_the_galleries_index_page_row(): void
    {
        $this->createPage('galleries-index', [
            'title' => 'Album Kami',
            'subtitle' => 'Kegiatan dan fasilitas',
            'meta_title' => 'Album Kami Meta',
            'meta_description' => 'Deskripsi album kami.',
        ]);
        $this->createGallery();

        $this->get(route('galleries.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('<title>Album Kami Meta — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('<h1 class="mb-1">Album Kami</h1>', false)
            ->assertSee('Kegiatan dan fasilitas')
            ->assertSee('<meta name="description" content="Deskripsi album kami.">', false);

    // --- #20: daftar album --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_index_lists_published_albums_in_order_with_photo_counts_and_the_first_photo_as_cover(): void

        $b = $this->createGallery(['title' => 'Album B Contoh', 'sort_order' => 2]);
        $a = $this->createGallery(['title' => 'Album A Contoh', 'sort_order' => 1, 'description' => 'Deskripsi singkat album A.']);
        $this->createGallery(['title' => 'Album Draf Contoh', 'sort_order' => 0, 'is_published' => false]);

        $this->addGalleryPhoto($a, ['alt_text' => 'Foto kedua A', 'sort_order' => 3, 'file_name' => 'a-kedua.jpg', 'thumb_path' => 'photos/2026/10/thumbs/a-kedua.jpg', 'directory' => 'photos/2026/10']);
        $this->addGalleryPhoto($a, ['alt_text' => 'Foto pertama A', 'sort_order' => 1, 'file_name' => 'a-pertama.jpg', 'thumb_path' => 'photos/2026/10/thumbs/a-pertama.jpg', 'directory' => 'photos/2026/10']);
        $this->addGalleryPhoto($a, ['alt_text' => 'Foto ketiga A', 'sort_order' => 5, 'file_name' => 'a-ketiga.jpg', 'thumb_path' => 'photos/2026/10/thumbs/a-ketiga.jpg', 'directory' => 'photos/2026/10']);
        $this->addGalleryPhoto($b, ['alt_text' => 'Foto tunggal B', 'sort_order' => 1, 'file_name' => 'b-tunggal.jpg', 'thumb_path' => 'photos/2026/10/thumbs/b-tunggal.jpg', 'directory' => 'photos/2026/10']);

        $response = $this->get(route('galleries.index'))->assertOk();

    public function test_the_index_is_paginated_by_twelve_and_page_two_adds_the_page_to_the_title(): void
    {

        }

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Album Nomor 13', $second);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<title>Galeri — Halaman 2 — '.config('app.name').'</title>', $second);

    public function test_detail_description_is_cut_at_160_characters(): void
    {
        $long = str_repeat('Deskripsi album panjang. ', 20);
        $gallery = $this->createGallery(['title' => 'Album Panjang', 'description' => $long]);

        $html = (string) $this->get(route('galleries.show', $gallery->slug))->assertOk()->getContent();
```

`tests/Feature/Public/PublicFaqTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Public;

use App\Models\Faq;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Halaman #21 `faq` (05 hal. 21, F4A-R22): FAQ terbit dikelompokkan per kategori dalam urutan `Faq::CATEGORIES` dengan
 * accordion Bootstrap; jawaban dan pertanyaan di-escape; judul dan SEO dari baris `pages` `faq` (CRD-10).
 */
class PublicFaqTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function fakeRoute(string $name, string $uri): void
    {
        if (! Route::has($name)) {
            Route::middleware('web')->get($uri, fn () => 'x')->name($name);
            Route::getRoutes()->refreshNameLookups();
        }
    }

    // --- header, SEO, breadcrumb (CRD-10) --------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_it_renders_the_default_header_seo_and_breadcrumb(): void
    {
        $this->createFaq();

        $response = $this->get(route('faq'))->assertOk();

        $response->assertSee('<title>Pertanyaan yang Sering Diajukan — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('<h1 class="mb-1">Pertanyaan yang Sering Diajukan</h1>', false)
            ->assertSee('Jawaban atas pertanyaan umum')
            ->assertSee('<meta name="description" content="Pertanyaan umum tentang pendaftaran, BPJS, layanan, dan data pribadi.">', false)
            ->assertSee('<meta property="og:title" content="Pertanyaan yang Sering Diajukan">', false)
            ->assertSee('<link rel="canonical" href="'.route('faq').'">', false)
            ->assertSeeInOrder(['aria-label="Breadcrumb"', 'Beranda', 'FAQ'], false)
            ->assertSee('<li class="breadcrumb-item active" aria-current="page">FAQ</li>', false);
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($response->getContent(), '<h1'));
    }

    public function test_the_title_and_seo_follow_the_faq_page_row(): void
    {
        $this->createPage('faq', [
            'title' => 'Tanya Jawab',
            'subtitle' => 'Jawaban singkat untuk Anda',
            'meta_title' => 'Tanya Jawab Meta',
            'meta_description' => 'Deskripsi tanya jawab.',
        ]);
        $this->createFaq();

        $this->get(route('faq'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('<title>Tanya Jawab Meta — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('<h1 class="mb-1">Tanya Jawab</h1>', false)
            ->assertSee('Jawaban singkat untuk Anda')
            ->assertSee('<meta name="description" content="Deskripsi tanya jawab.">', false)
            ->assertSee('<li class="breadcrumb-item active" aria-current="page">FAQ</li>', false);
    }

    // --- pengelompokan per kategori (F4A-R22) ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_faqs_are_grouped_by_category_in_the_fixed_order_with_labels(): void
    {
        $this->createFaq(['category' => 'umum', 'question' => 'Pertanyaan umum satu?', 'sort_order' => 1]);
        $this->createFaq(['category' => 'bpjs', 'question' => 'Pertanyaan BPJS dua?', 'sort_order' => 2]);
        $this->createFaq(['category' => 'pendaftaran', 'question' => 'Pertanyaan daftar kedua?', 'sort_order' => 2]);
        $this->createFaq(['category' => 'pendaftaran', 'question' => 'Pertanyaan daftar pertama?', 'sort_order' => 1]);
        $this->createFaq(['category' => 'bpjs', 'question' => 'Pertanyaan BPJS satu?', 'sort_order' => 1]);

        $response = $this->get(route('faq'))->assertOk();

        $response->assertSeeInOrder([
            '<h2 class="h4 mb-3" id="faq-pendaftaran">Pendaftaran</h2>',
            'Pertanyaan daftar pertama?',
            'Pertanyaan daftar kedua?',
            '<h2 class="h4 mb-3" id="faq-bpjs">BPJS</h2>',
            'Pertanyaan BPJS satu?',
            'Pertanyaan BPJS dua?',
            '<h2 class="h4 mb-3" id="faq-umum">Umum</h2>',
            'Pertanyaan umum satu?',
        ], false);
        $this->assertSame(3, substr_count($response->getContent(), '<h2 class="h4 mb-3" id="faq-'));
    }

    public function test_a_category_without_published_faqs_is_skipped(): void
    {
        $this->createFaq(['category' => 'layanan', 'question' => 'Hanya draf layanan?', 'is_published' => false]);
        $this->createFaq(['category' => 'umum', 'question' => 'Pertanyaan terbit?']);

        $this->get(route('faq'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('id="faq-umum"', false)
            ->assertDontSee('id="faq-layanan"', false)
            ->assertDontSee('Layanan</h2>', false)
            ->assertDontSee('Hanya draf layanan?');
    }

    public function test_unpublished_faqs_are_not_shown(): void
    {
        $this->createFaq(['question' => 'Pertanyaan terbit?']);
        $this->createFaq(['question' => 'Pertanyaan draf?', 'answer' => 'Jawaban draf rahasia.', 'is_published' => false]);

        $this->get(route('faq'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Pertanyaan terbit?')
            ->assertDontSee('Pertanyaan draf?')
            ->assertDontSee('Jawaban draf rahasia.');
    }

    // --- accordion ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_every_question_is_a_collapsed_accordion_button_linked_to_its_answer(): void
    {
        $first = $this->createFaq(['category' => 'bpjs', 'question' => 'Apakah BPJS diterima?', 'answer' => 'Ya, sesuai ketentuan.']);
        $second = $this->createFaq(['category' => 'bpjs', 'question' => 'Apa syaratnya?', 'answer' => 'Bawa kartu peserta.']);

        $response = $this->get(route('faq'))->assertOk();
        $html = $response->getContent();

        $response->assertSee('<h3 class="accordion-header">', false)
            ->assertSee('data-bs-toggle="collapse"', false)
            ->assertSee('data-bs-target="#faq-jawaban-'.$first->id.'"', false)
            ->assertSee('aria-controls="faq-jawaban-'.$first->id.'"', false)
            ->assertSee('id="faq-jawaban-'.$second->id.'"', false)
            ->assertSee('data-bs-parent="#faq-accordion-bpjs"', false)
            ->assertSee('Ya, sesuai ketentuan.')
            ->assertSee('Bawa kartu peserta.');
        $this->assertSame(2, preg_match_all('/class="accordion-button collapsed"[^>]*aria-expanded="false"/', $html));
        $this->assertSame(0, preg_match_all('/class="accordion-button[^"]*"[^>]*aria-expanded="true"/', $html));
        $this->assertSame(2, substr_count($html, 'data-bs-toggle="collapse"'));
        $this->assertSame(2, substr_count($html, 'class="accordion-button collapsed"'));
        $this->assertSame(2, substr_count($html, 'class="accordion-collapse collapse"'));
        $this->assertSame(0, substr_count($html, 'collapse show'));
    }

    public function test_the_page_keeps_the_heading_hierarchy_h1_h2_h3(): void
    {
        $this->createFaq(['category' => 'bpjs']);
        $this->createFaq(['category' => 'umum']);
        $this->createFaq(['category' => 'umum']);

        $html = (string) $this->get(route('faq'))->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, '<h1'));
        $this->assertSame(2, substr_count($html, '<h2 class="h4 mb-3"'));
        $this->assertSame(3, substr_count($html, '<h3 class="accordion-header">'));
    }

    // --- escape: pertanyaan dan jawaban teks biasa -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_question_and_answer_are_escaped_and_keep_line_breaks_through_css(): void
    {
        $this->createFaq([
            'question' => 'Apakah <b>tebal</b> aman?',
            'answer' => "Baris satu <script>alert(1)</script>\n\nBaris dua <i>miring</i>",
        ]);

        $response = $this->get(route('faq'))->assertOk();

        $response->assertSee('Apakah &lt;b&gt;tebal&lt;/b&gt; aman?', false)
            ->assertSee('&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;', false)
            ->assertSee('&lt;i&gt;miring&lt;/i&gt;', false)
            ->assertSee('class="accordion-body faq-answer"', false)
            ->assertDontSee('<b>tebal</b>', false)
            ->assertDontSee('<script>alert(1)', false)
            ->assertDontSee('<i>miring</i>', false);
        $this->assertStringContainsString("Baris satu &lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;\n\nBaris dua", $response->getContent());
    }

    public function test_the_stylesheet_preserves_answer_line_breaks(): void
    {
        $scss = (string) file_get_contents(resource_path('scss/_public.scss'));

        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/\.faq-answer\s*\{[^}]*white-space:\s*pre-line;/s', $scss);
    }

    // --- kosong dan tautan kontak --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_with_no_published_faq_it_shows_the_empty_state(): void
    {
        $this->createFaq(['is_published' => false]);

        $response = $this->get(route('faq'))->assertOk();

        $response->assertSee('Belum ada pertanyaan yang diterbitkan')
            ->assertSee('Hubungi kami bila Anda memiliki pertanyaan.')
            ->assertDontSee('accordion', false)
            ->assertDontSee('<h2 class="h4 mb-3"', false);
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($response->getContent(), '<h1'));
    }

    public function test_the_contact_link_appears_only_when_the_route_exists(): void
    {
        $this->createFaq();

        if (! Route::has('contact')) {
            $this->get(route('faq'))->assertOk()->assertDontSee('Hubungi kami</a>', false);

            $this->fakeRoute('contact', '/_uji/kontak');
        }

        $this->get(route('faq'))->assertOk()->assertSee('<p class="mb-0">Belum menemukan jawaban? <a href="'.route('contact').'">Hubungi kami</a>.</p>', false);
    }

    public function test_the_empty_state_links_to_contact_when_the_route_exists(): void
    {
        $this->fakeRoute('contact', '/_uji/kontak');

        $this->get(route('faq'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Belum ada pertanyaan yang diterbitkan')
            ->assertSee('<a class="btn btn-outline-primary" href="'.route('contact').'">Hubungi kami</a>', false)
            ->assertDontSee('Belum menemukan jawaban?');
    }

    // --- mode ketat dan keamanan markup ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_many_faqs_render_in_strict_mode_without_inline_handlers(): void
    {
        $this->assertTrue(Model::preventsLazyLoading());

        foreach (Faq::CATEGORIES as $category) {
            foreach (range(1, 3) as $number) {
                $this->createFaq(['category' => $category, 'question' => "Pertanyaan {$category} {$number}?", 'sort_order' => $number]);
            }
        }

        $html = (string) $this->get(route('faq'))->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertSame(12, substr_count($html, '<h3 class="accordion-header">'));
        $this->assertSame(4, substr_count($html, '<h2 class="h4 mb-3"'));
        $this->assertSame(0, preg_match('/\son[a-z]+\s*=/i', $html));
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('javascript:', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('onerror', $html);
    }

    public function test_the_page_is_identical_for_guests_and_staff(): void
    {
        $this->createFaq(['question' => 'Terbuka untuk semua?']);

        $this->get(route('faq'))->assertOk()->assertSee('Terbuka untuk semua?');
        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->patient()->create())->get(route('faq'))->assertOk()->assertSee('Terbuka untuk semua?');

        foreach (['content-admin', 'registration-officer', 'super-admin'] as $role) {
            $this->actingAs($this->createStaff($role))->get(route('faq'))->assertOk()->assertSee('Terbuka untuk semua?');
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implementasi controller (tool Write)**

`app/Http/Controllers/Public/GalleryController.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Public;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Gallery;
use App\Models\Page;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Halaman publik galeri (#20 `galleries.index`, detail `galleries.show`). Hanya album terbit; album draf menjawab
 * 404 untuk semua orang, termasuk staf (tanpa Policy). Sampul album = foto pertama (`sort_order`, `id`) (F4A-R23).
 */
class GalleryController extends Controller
{
    /** Jumlah album per halaman (F4A-R13). */
    public const PER_PAGE = 12;

    public function index(): View
    {
        $galleries = Gallery::query()
            ->published()
            ->with(['media' => fn ($query) => $query->where('collection', 'photos')])
            ->ordered()
            ->paginate(self::PER_PAGE);

        $page = Page::forKey('galleries-index');
        $title = $page->seo_title;

        if ($galleries->currentPage() > 1) {
            $title .= ' — Halaman '.$galleries->currentPage();
        }

        return view('public.galleries.index', [
            'page' => $page,
            'title' => $title,
            'galleries' => $galleries,
        ]);
    }

    public function show(Gallery $gallery): View
    {
        // Tanpa Policy: album yang belum terbit = 404 untuk semua orang, termasuk staf.
        abort_unless($gallery->is_published, 404);

        $gallery->load(['media' => fn ($query) => $query->where('collection', 'photos')]);

        // Deskripsi SEO: deskripsi album (dipotong 160), lalu deskripsi halaman `galleries-index` (F4A-R5).
        $description = Str::limit(trim((string) $gallery->description), 160, '');

        return view('public.galleries.show', [
            'gallery' => $gallery,
            'photos' => $gallery->mediaIn('photos'),
            'title' => $gallery->title.' — Galeri',
            'metaDescription' => $description !== '' ? $description : Page::forKey('galleries-index')->seo_description,
        ]);
    }
}
```

`app/Http/Controllers/Public/FaqController.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Public;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Faq;
use App\Models\Page;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Halaman #21 `faq`: FAQ terbit dikelompokkan per kategori dalam urutan `Faq::CATEGORIES`; kategori tanpa FAQ terbit
 * dilewati (F4A-R22). Tanpa paginasi.
 */
class FaqController extends Controller
{
    public function index(): View
    {
        $byCategory = Faq::query()->published()->ordered()->get()->groupBy('category');

        $groups = collect(Faq::CATEGORIES)
            ->filter(fn (string $category): bool => $byCategory->has($category))
            ->mapWithKeys(fn (string $category): array => [$category => $byCategory->get($category)]);

        return view('public.faq', [
            'page' => Page::forKey('faq'),
            'groups' => $groups,
        ]);
    }
}
```

  - `Banner::currentlyActive()` (sudah berurut `sort_order`, `id`), `Banner::hasUsableButton()`, relasi `media` koleksi `image`;
  - `Article::published()`, `Article::newestFirst()`, relasi `category` dan `media` koleksi `cover`; partial `public.partials._article-card` (variabel `$article`, `$headingLevel`);
  - layout `x-layouts.public` dengan prop `fullTitle`, komponen `x-open-graph` (props `title`, `description`, `image`, `type`, `canonical`);
  - `DoctorAvailabilityQuery::doctors(AvailabilityFilter, int)`, `PracticeSessionGenerator::ensureDailyHorizon()`, `SettingsService::bookingRules()`, `string()`, `whatsappUrl()`;
  - `Clinic::active()`, `Clinic::ordered()`, partial `public.partials._clinic-card`, `x-doctor-card` (prop `nextSession`);
  - pembantu tes `InteractsWithContent` (`createPage`, `createBanner`, `createArticle`, `createArticleCategory`).
- Produces:
  - `Public\HomeController::index(PracticeSessionGenerator $generator, DoctorAvailabilityQuery $query, SettingsService $settings): View` dan konstanta `FEATURED_CLINICS = 6`, `FEATURED_DOCTORS = 4`, `LATEST_ARTICLES = 3`;
  - view `public/home` dan enam partial `public/partials/_banner-carousel|_quick-search|_featured-clinics|_featured-doctors|_latest-articles|_help-cta`;
  - route `home` sebagai `GET /` ke `HomeController@index` (nama route tidak berubah);
  - fungsi JS `initBannerCarousel()` dipanggil dari `init()`; atribut kait `data-banner-carousel`, `data-banner-live`, `data-banner-toggle`, `data-banner-toggle-label`, `data-banner-toggle-icon`;
  - kelas gaya `.home-hero`, `.home-hero-actions`, `.banner-carousel`, `.banner-slide-media`, `.banner-caption`, `.banner-carousel-controls`, `.home-section`, `.home-section-header`, `.quick-search`.

**Test IDs:** AKS-01 (#1 terbuka untuk semua aktor; baris matriks ditambahkan Task 17), CRD-09 (hanya banner aktif dalam periode tampil di beranda), EMP-01 (beranda 200 dengan DB kosong, blok tanpa data hilang), MED-08/OFF-03 (placeholder lokal `banner.svg`), RSP-01 (tiga tombol utama), JDW-12 (beranda memicu `ensureDailyHorizon`, D-66), tes `<title>` (judul beranda `meta_title` atau `{site.name} — {site.tagline}`), SEK-07/SEK-15 (tanpa `{!! !!}` dan tanpa atribut event inline di view beranda), Review Focus 1 (batas waktu banner dan artikel di beranda), Review Focus 3 (`/?page=` tidak mengubah isi beranda; F4A-R35).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- `routes/web.php:8-9` masih `Route::view('/', 'public.home')->name('home')` dengan komentar F1-R3. Nama route `home` dipakai `SafeRedirect`, `GuestRedirectTest`, `LayoutsTest`, dan `AdminPageMatrixTest::dashboardFor`; nama tidak berubah.
- `resources/views/public/home.blade.php` saat ini 21 baris: `@inject('site', ...)`, `<h1>` dari `site.name`, tiga tombol dengan `Route::has`, dan kalimat "Situs ini masih dalam tahap pembangunan." yang dikunci `SmokeTest.php:20` (diganti di tugas ini). `SmokeTest.php:25` mengunci tepat satu `<h1`.
- Layout publik mendapat `$site` lewat `View::composer` (`AppServiceProvider.php:54-56`); view isi tidak, sehingga `home.blade.php` tetap memakai `@inject('site', ...)` (partial yang di-`@include` mewarisi variabelnya). `SettingsService` terdaftar `scoped`, jadi satu instance per permintaan.
- Pola dokter diambil dari `Public\DoctorController`: `ensureDailyHorizon()` di awal (baris 43), spesialisasi nonaktif disaring dengan `setRelation('specialties', ...)` (baris 90) karena data publik hanya memuat spesialisasi aktif (D-56), dan `nextSession()` privat (baris 152-163) yang mengambil sesi terdekat bukan pembatalan. Beranda menyalin ketiganya; `DoctorController` tidak diubah.
- `DoctorAvailabilityQuery::doctors()` memakai `->paginate($perPage)`, sehingga `/?page=2` akan menggeser empat dokter. Controller membuang `page` dari query request agar beranda selalu menampilkan empat dokter pertama (urut `Doctor::ordered()`: `sort_order`, `name`; tidak ada kolom unggulan, F4A-R16, F4A-R35). Relasi `clinic`, `specialties`, `media` sudah di-eager-load oleh query itu.
- `Banner::scopeCurrentlyActive` (Task 2) sudah memanggil `ordered()`, jadi controller tidak mengurutkan lagi. `x-image` (`app/View/Components/Image.php:48-52`) melempar `InvalidArgumentException` bila `alt` kosong tanpa `decorative`; karena itu alt slide memakai `alt_text` media, lalu judul banner bila media belum ada.
- Mode ketat: `x-image`, `firstMedia()`, dan `x-doctor-card` memakai relasi `media`; controller memfilter koleksi lewat `with(['media' => fn ... where('collection', ...)])` (pola `ClinicController::index`). Artikel memuat `category` dan `media` cover karena `_article-card` memakainya.
- `app.js`: tepat satu `addEventListener('error'` (baris 122) dan `RawOutputScanTest` mengiris teks dari `function initGalleryModals()` sampai `function init()`. `initBannerCarousel()` ditulis **sebelum** `initGalleryModals()` agar irisan itu tidak berubah, dan tidak menambah listener `error`.
- Bootstrap 5.3.8 (`node_modules/bootstrap/js/src/carousel.js`): dengan `ride: false` dan `pause: false`, `cycle()` memakai `interval` konfigurasi (`defaultInterval`); `pause()` membersihkan timer; `_slide()` memulai ulang `cycle()` hanya bila sebelumnya berputar. Tombol `[data-bs-slide]`/`[data-bs-slide-to]` bekerja di mana pun asal `data-bs-target` menunjuk elemen `.carousel`; indikator wajib berada di dalam elemen `.carousel` dengan kelas `carousel-indicators`.
- Urutan hero mengikuti F4A-R34: tiga tombol utama ditempatkan tepat di bawah `<h1>` dan subjudul, **sebelum** carousel (menyimpang dari urutan W-02 mobile), karena 15 RSP-01 mewajibkan tombol utama terlihat tanpa gulir pada 360 px.
- Penyederhanaan mobile: kartu dokter bertumpuk satu kolom, bukan baris geser scroll-snap (disederhanakan). Pencarian cepat di mobile terlipat dengan `collapse` Bootstrap, jadi butuh JS untuk dibuka; formulirnya sendiri tetap GET biasa.
- Blok kamar dan tombol "Kirim Pesan" (bila route `contact` belum ada) ditunda ke fase 4b (F4A-R1); tombol "Daftar Kunjungan" hanya bila `Route::has('patient.appointments.create')` (F4A-R15). Banner seed #2 (`/pasien/pendaftaran/baru`) otomatis tanpa tombol karena `Banner::hasUsableButton()`.
- Jumlah tes baru: ±30 (`PublicHomeTest` ±26, `FrontendManifestTest` 2, `SmokeTest` diubah).

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Public;

use App\Enums\ArticleStatus;
use App\Http\Controllers\Public\HomeController;
use App\Models\Article;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Scheduling\PracticeSessionGenerator;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithContent;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMedia;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Halaman #1 `home` (05 hal. 1, 07 W-02, F4A-R15 s.d. F4A-R17): hero (h1 dari `pages.home`, tiga tombol utama,
 * carousel banner), pencarian dokter cepat, enam layanan, empat dokter beserta sesi terdekat, tiga artikel terbaru,
 * dan CTA bantuan. Mencakup CRD-09 (banner), EMP-01, Review Focus 1 dan 3, serta pemicu pembangkitan sesi harian.
 */
class PublicHomeTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithContent;
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithMedia;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Storage::fake('public');
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 10:00:00'); // Senin
        $this->markHorizonGenerated();
    }

    /** Menandai pembangkitan harian sudah berjalan agar sesi buatan tes tidak bertambah oleh templat pabrik. */
    private function markHorizonGenerated(): void
    {
        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        Cache::put(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey($today), true, $today->endOfDay());
    }

    /** Potongan `<section aria-labelledby="...">` sampai `</section>` pertama setelahnya. */
    private function section(string $html, string $labelledBy): string
    {
        $found = preg_match('#<section[^>]*aria-labelledby="'.preg_quote($labelledBy, '#').'".*?</section>#s', $html, $matches);

        $this->assertSame(1, $found, "Bagian {$labelledBy} tidak ditemukan.");

        return $matches[0];
    }

    /** @param  list<string>  $needles */
    private function assertInOrder(array $needles, string $haystack): void
    {
        $offset = -1;

        foreach ($needles as $needle) {
            $position = strpos($haystack, $needle);

            $this->assertNotFalse($position, "{$needle} tidak ditemukan.");
            $this->assertGreaterThan($offset, $position, "{$needle} berada di urutan yang salah.");
            $offset = $position;
        }
    }

    private function fakeRoute(string $name, string $uri): void
    {
        if (! Route::has($name)) {
            Route::middleware('web')->get($uri, fn () => 'x')->name($name);
            Route::getRoutes()->refreshNameLookups();
        }
    }

    // --- DB kosong (EMP-01) --------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_only_currently_active_banners_are_in_the_carousel_at_the_boundaries(): void
    {
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Banner Tanpa Periode', 'sort_order' => 1]);
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Banner Mulai Tepat Sekarang', 'sort_order' => 2, 'starts_at' => now()]);
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Banner Berakhir Tepat Sekarang', 'sort_order' => 3, 'ends_at' => now()]);
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Banner Berakhir Semenit Lalu', 'sort_order' => 4, 'ends_at' => now()->subMinute()]);
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Banner Mulai Semenit Lagi', 'sort_order' => 5, 'starts_at' => now()->addMinute()]);
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Banner Nonaktif Dalam Jendela', 'sort_order' => 6, 'is_active' => false, 'starts_at' => now()->subDay(), 'ends_at' => now()->addDay()]);

        $response = $this->get('/')->assertOk();
        $html = $response->getContent();

        $response->assertSeeInOrder(['Banner Tanpa Periode', 'Banner Mulai Tepat Sekarang', 'Banner Berakhir Tepat Sekarang'])
            ->assertDontSee('Banner Berakhir Semenit Lalu')
            ->assertDontSee('Banner Mulai Semenit Lagi')
            ->assertDontSee('Banner Nonaktif Dalam Jendela');
        $this->assertSame(3, substr_count($html, 'aria-roledescription="slide"'));
    }

    public function test_the_carousel_markup_follows_the_accessibility_contract(): void
    {
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Slide Pertama Uji', 'subtitle' => 'Keterangan slide pertama.', 'sort_order' => 1]);
        $this->createBanner(['title' => 'Slide Kedua Uji', 'sort_order' => 2]);

        $html = $this->get('/')->assertOk()->getContent();

        foreach ([
            'id="banner-carousel"',
            'role="region"',
            'aria-roledescription="carousel"',
            'aria-label="Banner"',
            ' data-banner-carousel',
            'data-banner-live aria-live="off"',
            'aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="1 dari 2"',
            'aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="2 dari 2"',
            'data-bs-slide-to="0"',
            'data-bs-slide-to="1"',
            'aria-label="Slide 1"',
            'aria-label="Slide 2"',
            'data-bs-slide="prev"',
            'data-bs-slide="next"',
            'data-banner-toggle',
            'aria-pressed="false"',
            'Jeda',
        ] as $needle) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString($needle, $html, "Markup carousel harus memuat {$needle}");
        }

        // Putaran dikendalikan app.js (bukan data-bs-ride); tombol Jeda tersembunyi sampai JavaScript aktif.
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('data-bs-ride', $html);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/<button[^>]*data-banner-toggle[^>]*\shidden[\s>]/', $html);

        // Judul slide bukan heading: satu-satunya h1 tetap judul halaman, dan tidak ada h2 berisi judul slide.
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<p class="h2 mb-1">Slide Pertama Uji</p>', $html);
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, '<h1'));
        $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression('/<h[1-6][^>]*>\s*Slide (Pertama|Kedua) Uji/', $html);
    }
```
