```php
    public function test_featured_clinics_are_the_first_six_active_ones_in_display_order_regardless_of_type(): void
    {
        Clinic::factory()->support()->create(['name' => 'Laboratorium Uji', 'sort_order' => 0]);
        Clinic::factory()->inactive()->create(['name' => 'Poli Nonaktif Uji', 'sort_order' => 0]);

        foreach (range(1, 8) as $number) {
            $this->createClinic(['name' => "Poli Uji {$number}", 'sort_order' => $number]);
        }

        $html = $this->get('/')->assertOk()->getContent();
        $section = $this->section($html, 'judul-layanan-unggulan');

        $this->assertInOrder(['Laboratorium Uji', 'Poli Uji 1', 'Poli Uji 2', 'Poli Uji 3', 'Poli Uji 4', 'Poli Uji 5'], $section);
        $this->assertSame(6, substr_count($section, 'class="card h-100 service-card"'));

        foreach (['Poli Uji 6', 'Poli Uji 7', 'Poli Uji 8', 'Poli Nonaktif Uji'] as $hidden) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString($hidden, $section);

    // --- dokter (F4A-R16) ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_four_doctors_with_their_next_session_are_shown_in_display_order(): void
    {
        $doctors = [];

        foreach (['Satu', 'Dua', 'Tiga', 'Empat', 'Lima'] as $index => $word) {
            $doctors[$word] = $this->createDoctor(['name' => "Uji {$word}", 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null, 'sort_order' => $index + 1]);
        }

        $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Uji Nonaktif', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null, 'sort_order' => 0, 'status' => 'inactive']);

        $this->createSession([
            'doctor_id' => $doctors['Satu']->id,
            'clinic_id' => $doctors['Satu']->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-06',
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ]);

        $html = $this->get('/')->assertOk()->getContent();
        $section = $this->section($html, 'judul-dokter-kami');

        $this->assertInOrder(['dr. Uji Satu', 'dr. Uji Dua', 'dr. Uji Tiga', 'dr. Uji Empat'], $section);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Uji Lima', $section);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Uji Nonaktif', $section);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="'.route('doctors.index').'">Lihat semua dokter</a>', $section);

        // Hanya dr. Uji Satu yang punya sesi: lencana, tanggal, dan tanpa tombol "Lihat Jadwal" terpisah.
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($section, 'Jadwal terdekat'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Selasa, 6 Oktober 2026', $section);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Tersedia', $section);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Lihat Jadwal', $section);
    }

    public function test_the_page_query_parameter_does_not_shift_the_featured_doctors(): void
    {
        foreach (['Satu', 'Dua', 'Tiga', 'Empat', 'Lima'] as $index => $word) {
            $this->createDoctor(['name' => "Uji {$word}", 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null, 'sort_order' => $index + 1]);
        }

        foreach (['/?page=2', '/?page=abc', '/?page[]=1', '/?page=-5'] as $uri) {
            $section = $this->section($this->get($uri)->assertOk()->getContent(), 'judul-dokter-kami');

            $this->assertStringContainsString('dr. Uji Satu', $section, $uri);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('dr. Uji Empat', $section, $uri);
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Uji Lima', $section, $uri);
        }
    }

    // --- artikel terbaru (Review Focus 1) ---------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_three_newest_published_articles_are_shown_and_unpublished_ones_never(): void
    {
        $gizi = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Gizi Uji']);

        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Artikel Tepat Sekarang', 'published_at' => now()], $gizi);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Artikel Semenit Lalu', 'published_at' => now()->subMinute()], $gizi);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Artikel Tanpa Kategori', 'published_at' => now()->subDay()]);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Artikel Terlalu Lama', 'published_at' => now()->subDays(5)], $gizi);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Artikel Semenit Lagi', 'published_at' => now()->addMinute()], $gizi);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Artikel Draf Berlabel Tanggal', 'status' => ArticleStatus::Draft, 'published_at' => now()->subHours(2)], $gizi);
        $this->createArticle(['title' => 'Artikel Terhapus', 'published_at' => now()->subHours(3)], $gizi)->delete();

        $html = $this->get('/')->assertOk()->getContent();
        $section = $this->section($html, 'judul-artikel-terbaru');

        $this->assertInOrder(['Artikel Tepat Sekarang', 'Artikel Semenit Lalu', 'Artikel Tanpa Kategori'], $section);

        foreach (['Artikel Terlalu Lama', 'Artikel Semenit Lagi', 'Artikel Draf Berlabel Tanggal', 'Artikel Terhapus'] as $hidden) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString($hidden, $section);
        }

        $this->assertStringContainsString('<h2 id="judul-artikel-terbaru"', $section);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="'.route('articles.index').'">Lihat semua artikel</a>', $section);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Gizi Uji', $section);
    }

    public function test_the_help_block_uses_the_contact_settings(): void
    {
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);

        $cta = $this->section($this->get('/')->assertOk()->getContent(), 'judul-bantuan');

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Butuh bantuan segera?', $cta);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('IGD: ', $cta);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<a class="text-white fw-bold" href="tel:02100000119">(021) 0000-0119</a>', $cta);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="https://wa.me/6280000000000" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"', $cta);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="tel:02100000000"', $cta);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Petunjuk Arah', $cta);
        $this->assertStringContainsString(e(app(SettingsService::class)->string('map.directions_url')), $cta);
        if (! Route::has('contact')) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Kirim Pesan', $cta);
        }
    }

    public function test_help_block_entries_disappear_when_their_setting_is_empty(): void
    {
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);
        $settings = app(SettingsService::class);

        $cta = $this->section($this->get('/')->assertOk()->getContent(), 'judul-bantuan');

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('wa.me', $cta);

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('IGD:', $cta);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="tel:02100000000"', $cta);
    }

    {

        }

        $cta = $this->section($this->get('/')->assertOk()->getContent(), 'judul-bantuan');

    // --- pembangkitan sesi harian (D-66, F3-R8/R9) -------------------------------------------------

    public function test_visiting_the_home_page_triggers_the_daily_generation_once(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);
        $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id, 'day_of_week' => 3, 'valid_from' => '2026-10-05']);
        Cache::forget(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey(CarbonImmutable::today()));

        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->count());

        $this->get('/')->assertOk();

        $this->assertSame(5, PracticeSession::query()->count()); // Rabu 7, 14, 21, 28 Okt dan 4 Nov
        $this->assertTrue(Cache::has(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey(CarbonImmutable::today())));

        PracticeSession::query()->delete();
        $this->get('/')->assertOk();

        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->count(), 'Penanda harian mencegah pembangkitan kedua.');
    }

    public function test_a_lock_held_by_another_process_does_not_block_the_home_page(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);
        $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id, 'day_of_week' => 3, 'valid_from' => '2026-10-05']);
        Cache::forget(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey(CarbonImmutable::today()));

        $lock = Cache::lock(PracticeSessionGenerator::LOCK_KEY, 30);
        $this->assertTrue($lock->get());

        try {
            $this->get('/')->assertOk()->assertSee('dr. Rani Oktaviani');
        } finally {
            $lock->release();
        }

        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_a_page_full_of_rows_renders_under_strict_mode_without_lazy_loading(): void
    {
        $category = $this->createArticleCategory(['name' => 'Kategori Banyak']);

        foreach (range(1, 4) as $number) {
            $banner = $this->createBanner(['title' => "Banner Banyak {$number}", 'sort_order' => $number, 'button_label' => 'Lihat Dokter', 'button_url' => '/dokter']);
            $this->createMediaRow(['model_type' => $banner->getMorphClass(), 'model_id' => $banner->id, 'collection' => 'image', 'directory' => 'image/2026/10', 'alt_text' => "Alt banner {$number}"]);
        }

        foreach (range(1, 8) as $number) {
            $clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => "Poli Banyak {$number}", 'sort_order' => $number]);
            $this->createMediaRow(['model_type' => $clinic->getMorphClass(), 'model_id' => $clinic->id, 'collection' => 'cover', 'directory' => 'cover/2026/10', 'alt_text' => "Alt poli {$number}"]);
        }

        foreach (range(1, 6) as $number) {
            $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => "Dokter Banyak {$number}", 'sort_order' => $number]);
            $this->createSession(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id, 'session_date' => '2026-10-06']);
        }

        foreach (range(1, 5) as $number) {
            $article = $this->createArticle(['title' => "Artikel Banyak {$number}", 'published_at' => now()->subDays($number)], $category);
            $this->createMediaRow(['model_type' => $article->getMorphClass(), 'model_id' => $article->id, 'collection' => 'cover', 'directory' => 'cover/2026/10', 'alt_text' => "Alt artikel {$number}"]);
        }

        $this->get('/')->assertOk()->assertSee('Banner Banyak 4')->assertSee('Artikel Banyak 3')->assertDontSee('Artikel Banyak 4');
    }

    public function test_the_home_views_use_escaped_output_and_no_inline_event_handlers(): void
    {
        foreach (['home', 'partials/_banner-carousel', 'partials/_quick-search', 'partials/_featured-clinics', 'partials/_featured-doctors', 'partials/_latest-articles', 'partials/_help-cta'] as $view) {

        }
    }
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implementasi controller (tool Write) `app/Http/Controllers/Public/HomeController.php`**

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Public;

use App\Enums\Availability;
use App\Enums\ClinicType;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Article;
use App\Models\Banner;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Page;
use App\Models\Specialty;
use App\Services\Scheduling\AvailabilityFilter;
use App\Services\Scheduling\DoctorAvailabilityQuery;
use App\Services\Scheduling\PracticeSessionGenerator;
use App\Services\Scheduling\SessionAvailability;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Beranda #1 `home` (05 hal. 1, 07 W-02). Teks hero dari `pages.home`; banner hanya yang sedang tayang
 * (F4A-R25); enam layanan aktif pertama, empat dokter pertama beserta sesi terdekat (F4A-R16), dan tiga artikel
 * terbit terbaru. Jadwal dibaca hanya lewat DoctorAvailabilityQuery dan pembangkitan sesi harian dipicu di sini
 * (D-66, F3-R9). Blok kamar menyusul di fase 4b.
 */
class HomeController extends Controller
{
    public const FEATURED_CLINICS = 6;

    public const FEATURED_DOCTORS = 4;

    public const LATEST_ARTICLES = 3;

    public function index(
        PracticeSessionGenerator $generator,
        DoctorAvailabilityQuery $query,
        SettingsService $settings,
    ): View {
        // Pemicu (b) pembangkitan sesi harian; kunci tidak menunggu, jadi halaman tetap tampil (F3-R8).
        $generator->ensureDailyHorizon();

        // DoctorAvailabilityQuery::doctors() memakai paginasi; beranda selalu menampilkan halaman pertama.
        request()->query->remove('page');

        $page = Page::forKey('home');
        $siteName = $settings->string('site.name', (string) config('app.name'));
        $tagline = $settings->string('site.tagline');

        $banners = Banner::query()
            ->currentlyActive()
            ->with(['media' => fn ($media) => $media->where('collection', 'image')])
            ->get();

        $clinics = Clinic::query()
            ->active()
            ->with(['media' => fn ($media) => $media->where('collection', 'cover')])
            ->ordered()
            ->limit(self::FEATURED_CLINICS)
            ->get();

        $doctors = $query->doctors(new AvailabilityFilter, self::FEATURED_DOCTORS)->getCollection();
        $nextSessions = [];

        foreach ($doctors as $doctor) {
            // Data publik hanya memuat spesialisasi aktif (D-56); pivot `is_primary` tetap terbawa.
            $doctor->setRelation('specialties', $doctor->specialties->filter(fn (Specialty $item): bool => $item->is_active)->values());
            $nextSessions[$doctor->id] = $this->nextSession($doctor->availabilities);
        }

        $articles = Article::query()
            ->published()
            ->newestFirst()
            ->with(['category', 'media' => fn ($media) => $media->where('collection', 'cover')])
            ->limit(self::LATEST_ARTICLES)
            ->get();

        $specialties = Specialty::query()->active()->ordered()->get(['id', 'name', 'slug']);
        $polyclinics = Clinic::query()->active()->where('type', ClinicType::Poliklinik->value)->ordered()->get(['id', 'name', 'slug']);

        // Judul utuh tanpa sufiks: `meta_title`, atau "{site.name} — {site.tagline}" (F4A-R5).
        $title = filled($page->meta_title)
            ? (string) $page->meta_title
            : ($tagline !== '' ? $siteName.' — '.$tagline : $siteName);

        return view('public.home', [
            'page' => $page,
            'title' => $title,
            'subtitle' => filled($page->subtitle) ? (string) $page->subtitle : $tagline,
            'metaDescription' => filled($page->meta_description) ? (string) $page->meta_description : null,
            'ogImage' => $banners->first()?->firstMedia('image')?->url,
            'banners' => $banners,
            'clinics' => $clinics,
            'doctors' => $doctors,
            'nextSessions' => $nextSessions,
            'articles' => $articles,
            'specialtyOptions' => ['' => 'Semua spesialisasi'] + $specialties->pluck('name', 'slug')->all(),
            'clinicOptions' => ['' => 'Semua poliklinik'] + $polyclinics->pluck('name', 'slug')->all(),
            'windowDays' => max(1, $settings->bookingRules()->windowDays),
            'today' => CarbonImmutable::today(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Sesi terdekat yang bukan pembatalan; kartu dokter menampilkannya sebagai "Jadwal terdekat" (F3-R25).
     *
     * @param  Collection<int, SessionAvailability>  $availabilities
     */
    private function nextSession(Collection $availabilities): ?SessionAvailability
    {
        $cancellations = [Availability::Leave, Availability::Holiday, Availability::Cancelled];

        return $availabilities->first(
            fn (SessionAvailability $item): bool => ! in_array($item->availability, $cancellations, true),
        );
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Implementasi JavaScript (tool Edit) `resources/js/app.js`**

Fungsi ditulis sebelum `initGalleryModals()` (irisan teks yang dikunci `RawOutputScanTest` tidak berubah). `old_string` cocok tepat satu kali:

old_string:

```js
// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Galeri layanan (modal + carousel Bootstrap)
```

new_string:

```js
// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Carousel banner beranda (#1, F4A-R17)
// Markup: .carousel[data-banner-carousel] berisi .carousel-inner[data-banner-live], indikator Bootstrap, dan tombol
// [data-banner-toggle] (Jeda/Putar; awalnya hidden karena tanpa JavaScript tombol ini tidak berguna). Berputar tiap
// 6000 ms kecuali prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; berhenti saat kursor mouse berada di atasnya, saat fokus berada di
// dalamnya, dan saat dijeda pengguna. aria-live bernilai off selama berputar dan polite selama berhenti.
function initBannerCarousel() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-banner-carousel]').forEach((root) => {
        if (root.querySelectorAll('.carousel-item').length < 2) {
            return;
        }

        const instance = window.bootstrap.Carousel.getOrCreateInstance(root, {
            interval: 6000,
            ride: false,
            pause: false,
            wrap: true,
            touch: true,
            keyboard: true,
        });
        const live = root.querySelector('[data-banner-live]');
        const toggle = root.querySelector('[data-banner-toggle]');
        const toggleLabel = toggle ? toggle.querySelector('[data-banner-toggle-label]') : null;
        const toggleIcon = toggle ? toggle.querySelector('[data-banner-toggle-icon]') : null;

        // Pengguna dengan prefers-reduced-motion mulai dalam keadaan dijeda; tombol Putar tetap dapat memulai putaran.
        let userPaused = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
        let hovered = false;
        let focused = false;

        const sync = () => {
            const running = !userPaused && !hovered && !focused;

            if (running) {
                instance.cycle();
            } else {
                instance.pause();
            }

            if (live) {
                live.setAttribute('aria-live', running ? 'off' : 'polite');
            }

            if (toggle) {
                toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', userPaused ? 'true' : 'false');

                if (toggleLabel) {
                    toggleLabel.textContent = userPaused ? 'Putar' : 'Jeda';
                }

                if (toggleIcon) {
                    toggleIcon.classList.toggle('bi-pause-fill', !userPaused);
                    toggleIcon.classList.toggle('bi-play-fill', userPaused);
                }
            }
        };

        if (toggle) {
            toggle.hidden = false;
            toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
                userPaused = !userPaused;
                sync();
            });
        }

        // Hanya kursor mouse yang menjeda; sentuhan tidak meninggalkan status "hover" yang menggantung.
        root.addEventListener('pointerenter', (event) => {
            if (event.pointerType === 'mouse') {
                hovered = true;
                sync();
            }
        });
        root.addEventListener('pointerleave', (event) => {
            if (event.pointerType === 'mouse') {
                hovered = false;
                sync();
            }
        });
        root.addEventListener('focusin', () => {
            focused = true;
            sync();
        });
        root.addEventListener('focusout', (event) => {
            if (!root.contains(event.relatedTarget)) {
                focused = false;
                sync();
            }
        });

        sync();
    });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Galeri layanan (modal + carousel Bootstrap)
```

```scss
// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Beranda (#1, F4A-R17)
.home-hero {
  margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
}

// Tiga tombol utama: bertumpuk penuh lebar di layar kecil, sebaris dan rata tengah mulai sm.
.home-hero-actions {
  display: grid;
  gap: .75rem;
  max-width: 28rem;
  margin-inline: auto;

  @include media-breakpoint-up(sm) {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    max-width: none;
  }
}

.banner-carousel {
  margin-top: 2rem;
}

// Gambar banner 1600x600: rasio 16:9 di layar kecil, 3:1 mulai md.
.banner-slide-media {
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: $light;
  border-radius: $border-radius $border-radius 0 0;

  img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
  }

  @include media-breakpoint-up(md) {
    aspect-ratio: 3 / 1;
    border-radius: $border-radius;
  }
}

// Judul slide memakai <p class="h2"> (bukan heading, h1 tetap pages.home.title). Di layar kecil panel solid di bawah
// gambar; mulai md panel menutup sudut kiri bawah dengan $primary 85% (kontras teks putih tetap >= 4,5:1).
.banner-caption {
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  background: $primary;
  color: #fff;
  border-radius: 0 0 $border-radius $border-radius;

  .h2 {
    margin-bottom: .25rem;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1.375rem;
  }

  :focus-visible {
    outline-color: #fff;
  }

  @include media-breakpoint-up(md) {
    position: absolute;
    inset-block-end: 1.5rem;
    inset-inline-start: 1.5rem;
    max-width: min(36rem, 70%);
    background: rgba(10, 77, 140, .85); // $primary
    border-radius: $border-radius;
  }
}

// Kontrol di bawah slide: panah, indikator (area sentuh 44 px), dan tombol Jeda/Putar.
.banner-carousel-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: .5rem;
  margin-top: .75rem;

  .carousel-indicators {
    position: static;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;

    [data-bs-target] {
      position: relative;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      width: 2.75rem;
      height: 2.75rem;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      border: 0;
      background: transparent;
      opacity: 1;

      // Titik: cincin untuk slide lain, terisi untuk slide aktif (kontras $primary vs putih >= 3:1).
      &::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: 50%;
        left: 50%;
        width: .875rem;
        height: .875rem;
        margin: -.4375rem 0 0 -.4375rem;
        border: 2px solid $primary;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: transparent;
      }

      &.active::after {
        background: $primary;
      }
    }
  }
}

.home-section {
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
}

.home-section-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: .5rem 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.quick-search {
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
  padding: 1.25rem;
  background: $light;
  border-radius: $border-radius;

  @include media-breakpoint-up(md) {
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }
}
```

### Task 16: `ContentSeeder` (data demo konten) dan pembaruan invarian seeder

**Files:**
- Create: `database/seeders/ContentSeeder.php`
- Modify: `database/seeders/DemoSeeder.php` (memanggil `ContentSeeder` sesudah `ScheduleExceptionSeeder`)
- Test: `tests/Feature/Seeding/ContentSeederTest.php`
- Modify (tes lama): `tests/Feature/Seeding/DemoSeederWiringTest.php`, `MasterDataSeederGuardTest.php`, `DemoSeederInvariantsTest.php`, `SeederProductionGuardTest.php` (komentar dan asersi tabel konten kosong di produksi)
- Tidak diubah: `DatabaseSeeder` (tidak boleh memanggil `ContentSeeder`; `PageSeeder` sudah dipasang Task 4), `PlaceholderImageGenerator`, `MediaService`.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: model `ArticleCategory`, `Article`, `Banner`, `Gallery`, `Faq`, `InsurancePartner` (fillable persis kerangka C.2), enum `ArticleStatus`, `MediaService::store()`, `PlaceholderImageGenerator::make()`, `DemoUserSeeder::ACCOUNTS` (akun Admin Konten Demo `konten@unpamhospital.test`), scope `Article::published()`, `Banner::currentlyActive()`, `Banner::hasUsableButton()`.
- Produces: `Database\Seeders\ContentSeeder` dengan konstanta publik `AUTHOR_EMAIL`, `CLOSING_SENTENCE`, `CATEGORIES`, `ARTICLES`, `BANNERS`, `GALLERIES`, `FAQS`, `PARTNERS` (kerangka C.4); data demo: 4 kategori, 8 artikel (7 terbit, 1 draf), 3 banner, 3 album (12 foto), 12 FAQ, 4 mitra, dan 25 media baru sehingga total media demo menjadi **57** (32 + 25).

**Test IDs:** SEED-01 (angka acuan konten), SEED-02 (guard produksi: `ContentSeeder` melempar `RuntimeException`), SEED-03 (`media:prune --dry-run` tetap 0 baris dan 0 berkas yatim), CRD-08/CRD-09/CRD-10 (data demo tampil di publik), EMP-01 (placeholder: artikel #5 tanpa cover).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- Pola `ClinicSeeder.php`: guard `app()->environment(['local', 'testing'])` dengan pesan `... DILARANG di APP_ENV=...`, idempoten per slug (`warn` lalu `continue`), gambar dari `PlaceholderImageGenerator::make()` lalu `MediaService::store()` dengan `@unlink` di `finally`. `DemoSeeder.php` memanggil seeder lewat satu `$this->call([...])` dan menjaga idempotensi dengan pemeriksaan akun `superadmin@unpamhospital.test`.
- `PlaceholderImageGenerator::TYPES` sudah mengenal `cover` (JPEG), `image` (JPEG, teks "Banner contoh"), `photos` (JPEG), dan `logo` (PNG, teks "Logo contoh"); ukuran minimum koleksi `MediaService::COLLECTIONS` terpenuhi (cover 800x450, image 1200x400, photos 600x400, logo 120x40). `MediaService::store()` mengecilkan hanya bila lebar > 1600, sehingga ukuran akhir sama dengan ukuran yang dibuat.
- `HasUniqueSlug` tidak menimpa slug yang sudah terisi (F4A-R7), jadi slug eksplisit 13 §8.5 s.d. §8.7 dipertahankan. Pemeriksaan idempotensi artikel memakai `Article::withTrashed()`.
- Observer audit (Task 3) aktif untuk ketujuh model, jadi seeder menulis baris `audit_logs` tanpa pelaku; tidak ada tes seeding yang menghitung audit.
- Tes lama yang terdampak (dibaca dari berkas saat ini): `DemoSeederInvariantsTest.php:51-53` (cover 16 dan media 32), `:105` (loop atas semua media dengan alt "Foto contoh " dan ukuran 1200x800/600x600), `:154` dan `:171` (larik `[13, 17, 18, 20, 32]`); `DemoSeederWiringTest.php:14-22` (urutan seeder) dan `:31`; `MasterDataSeederGuardTest.php:25-30` dan asersi akhir `:48`; `SeederProductionGuardTest.php:30` (komentar "32 gambar").
- Media konten bukan lagi "Foto contoh ..." berukuran 1200x800: alt cover "Ilustrasi contoh {judul}", banner "Banner contoh {judul}", foto "Foto contoh {judul album lengkap} {n}" (13 §9.2, F4A-R36; judul memuat "(Foto Contoh)"), logo "Logo contoh {nama}". Karena itu loop gambar di `DemoSeederInvariantsTest` dibatasi pada media milik `Doctor`/`Clinic`.
- Banner #2 menunjuk `/pasien/pendaftaran/baru` (13 §8.3) dan baru memiliki tombol setelah route fase 6 ada (`hasUsableButton()`, F4A-R15); tes menegaskan keadaan saat ini dan dikomentari agar diperbarui di fase 6.
- Jumlah tes baru: ±17 (`ContentSeederTest` 15, ditambah satu kasus data provider dan satu tes konten di tes lama).

```php
/**

    public function test_counts_match_the_reference_numbers(): void

        $this->assertSame(3, Banner::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(3, Gallery::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(12, Faq::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(4, InsurancePartner::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(25, Media::query()->count());

    public function test_categories_use_the_documented_names_slugs_and_order(): void
    {
        $this->seedContent();

        $this->assertSame(
            [
                ['Kesehatan Umum', 'kesehatan-umum', 1],
                ['Keluarga dan Anak', 'keluarga-dan-anak', 2],
                ['Gaya Hidup Sehat', 'gaya-hidup-sehat', 3],
                ['Info Layanan', 'info-layanan', 4],
            ],
            ArticleCategory::query()->ordered()->get()->map(fn (ArticleCategory $category): array => [$category->name, $category->slug, $category->sort_order])->all(),
        );
    }

    public function test_articles_keep_the_explicit_slugs_and_publication_dates(): void
    {
        $this->seedContent();

        $expected = [
            'kebiasaan-sederhana-menjaga-kesehatan-jantung' => 3,
            'pentingnya-pemeriksaan-kesehatan-berkala' => 6,
            'menyiapkan-diri-sebelum-berkunjung-ke-poliklinik' => 9,
            'mengenali-tanda-kekurangan-cairan-pada-anak' => 12,
            'pola-tidur-yang-baik-untuk-tubuh-bugar' => 15,
            'cara-mencuci-tangan-yang-benar' => 20,
            'panduan-pendaftaran-online-unpam-hospital' => 1,
        ];

        foreach ($expected as $slug => $days) {
            $article = Article::query()->with('category')->where('slug', $slug)->firstOrFail();

            $this->assertSame(ArticleStatus::Published, $article->status, $slug);
            $this->assertTrue($article->published_at->equalTo(now()->subDays($days)), $slug);
            $this->assertNotNull($article->category, $slug);
        }

        $draft = Article::query()->where('slug', 'draf-menjaga-kesehatan-di-musim-hujan')->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertSame(ArticleStatus::Draft, $draft->status);
        $this->assertNull($draft->published_at);
        $this->assertFalse($draft->isPubliclyVisible());
        $this->assertSame(7, Article::query()->published()->count());
    }

    public function test_articles_are_authored_by_the_demo_content_admin_with_the_standard_closing_sentence(): void
    {
        $this->seedContent();

        $author = User::query()->where('email', 'konten@unpamhospital.test')->firstOrFail();

        foreach (Article::query()->get() as $article) {
            $this->assertSame($author->id, $article->author_user_id, $article->slug);
            $this->assertStringEndsWith(ContentSeeder::CLOSING_SENTENCE.'</p>', trim((string) $article->body), $article->slug);
            $this->assertSame(3, substr_count((string) $article->body, '<p>'), $article->slug);
            $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression('/\d/', strip_tags((string) $article->body), 'Isi artikel tidak memuat angka medis: '.$article->slug);
            $this->assertNull($article->meta_title);
            $this->assertNull($article->meta_description);
        }
    }

    public function test_article_five_and_the_draft_have_no_cover_and_the_other_six_do(): void
    {
        $this->seedContent();

        $withoutCover = ['pola-tidur-yang-baik-untuk-tubuh-bugar', 'draf-menjaga-kesehatan-di-musim-hujan'];

        foreach (Article::query()->with('media')->get() as $article) {
            if (in_array($article->slug, $withoutCover, true)) {
                $this->assertNull($article->firstMedia('cover'), $article->slug);

                continue;
            }

            $cover = $article->firstMedia('cover');
            $this->assertNotNull($cover, $article->slug);
            $this->assertSame('Ilustrasi contoh '.$article->title, $cover->alt_text);
            $this->assertSame([1200, 675], [$cover->width, $cover->height]);
            $this->assertSame('jpg', $cover->extension);
        }

        $this->assertStringContainsString('images/placeholders/article.svg', Article::query()->with('media')->where('slug', 'pola-tidur-yang-baik-untuk-tubuh-bugar')->firstOrFail()->cover_url);
    }

    public function test_banners_are_active_from_the_start_of_the_day_with_the_documented_buttons(): void
    {
        $this->seedContent();

        $banners = Banner::query()->with('media')->ordered()->get();

        $this->assertSame(
            [
                ['Selamat Datang di UNPAM HOSPITAL', 'Cari Dokter', '/dokter'],
                ['Daftar Kunjungan Lebih Mudah', 'Daftar Kunjungan', '/pasien/pendaftaran/baru'],
                ['Lihat Jadwal Dokter Terbaru', 'Jadwal Dokter', '/jadwal-dokter'],
            ],
            $banners->map(fn (Banner $banner): array => [$banner->title, $banner->button_label, $banner->button_url])->all(),
        );
        $this->assertSame([1, 2, 3], $banners->pluck('sort_order')->all());

        foreach ($banners as $banner) {
            $this->assertTrue($banner->is_active);
            $this->assertTrue($banner->starts_at->equalTo(now()->startOfDay()));
            $this->assertNull($banner->ends_at);
            $this->assertSame('Banner contoh '.$banner->title, $banner->firstMedia('image')->alt_text);
            $this->assertSame([1600, 600], [$banner->firstMedia('image')->width, $banner->firstMedia('image')->height]);
        }

        $this->assertSame(3, Banner::query()->currentlyActive()->count());
        $this->assertTrue($banners[0]->hasUsableButton());
        $this->assertTrue($banners[2]->hasUsableButton());
        // Route pendaftaran pasien baru ada di fase 6 (F4A-R15); perbarui asersi ini di fase tersebut.
        $this->assertFalse($banners[1]->hasUsableButton());
    }

    public function test_galleries_have_four_labelled_photos_each_in_order(): void
    {
        $this->seedContent();

        $galleries = Gallery::query()->with('media')->ordered()->get();

        $this->assertSame(
            [
                ['Lobi dan Area Pendaftaran (Foto Contoh)', 'lobi-dan-area-pendaftaran'],
                ['Fasilitas Pelayanan (Foto Contoh)', 'fasilitas-pelayanan'],
                ['Edukasi Kesehatan (Foto Contoh)', 'edukasi-kesehatan'],
            ],
            $galleries->map(fn (Gallery $gallery): array => [$gallery->title, $gallery->slug])->all(),
        );

        foreach ($galleries as $gallery) {
            $this->assertTrue($gallery->is_published);
            $photos = $gallery->mediaIn('photos');
            $this->assertCount(4, $photos, $gallery->slug);
            $this->assertSame([1, 2, 3, 4], $photos->pluck('sort_order')->all());

            foreach ($photos as $photo) {
                $this->assertStringStartsWith('Foto contoh ', $photo->alt_text);
                $this->assertStringStartsWith('Foto contoh: '.$gallery->title.', foto ', (string) $photo->caption);
                $this->assertLessThanOrEqual(255, mb_strlen((string) $photo->alt_text));
                $this->assertSame([1200, 800], [$photo->width, $photo->height]);
            }

            $this->assertSame($photos->first()->id, $gallery->coverMedia()->id);
        }

        $this->assertSame('Foto contoh Lobi dan Area Pendaftaran (Foto Contoh) 1', $galleries[0]->mediaIn('photos')->first()->alt_text);
    }

    public function test_faqs_are_twelve_published_questions_grouped_as_documented(): void
    {
        $this->seedContent();

        $faqs = Faq::query()->ordered()->get();

        $this->assertSame(range(1, 12), $faqs->pluck('sort_order')->all());
        $this->assertSame(['pendaftaran' => 6, 'bpjs' => 2, 'layanan' => 2, 'umum' => 2], $faqs->countBy('category')->all());
        $this->assertTrue($faqs->every(fn (Faq $faq): bool => $faq->is_published));
        $this->assertSame('Bagaimana cara mendaftar kunjungan rawat jalan secara online?', $faqs->first()->question);
        $this->assertSame('Bagaimana menghubungi rumah sakit?', $faqs->last()->question);
        $this->assertSame('Tidak. Sistem ini tidak meminta NIK.', $faqs->firstWhere('question', 'Apakah saya perlu mengisi NIK?')->answer);
    }

    public function test_partners_and_labels_are_marked_as_examples_without_real_cooperation_claims(): void
    {
        $this->seedContent();

        $partners = InsurancePartner::query()->with('media')->ordered()->get();

        $this->assertSame(
            [
                ['Asuransi Contoh Sehat', 'asuransi-contoh-sehat', 'asuransi'],
                ['Asuransi Contoh Sentosa', 'asuransi-contoh-sentosa', 'asuransi'],
                ['Asuransi Contoh Prima', 'asuransi-contoh-prima', 'asuransi'],
                ['PT Contoh Karya Mandiri', 'pt-contoh-karya-mandiri', 'perusahaan'],
            ],
            $partners->map(fn (InsurancePartner $partner): array => [$partner->name, $partner->slug, $partner->type])->all(),
        );

        foreach ($partners as $partner) {
            $this->assertTrue($partner->is_active);
            $this->assertNull($partner->website_url);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Contoh', $partner->name);
            $this->assertStringEndsWith('Bukan kerja sama nyata.', (string) $partner->description);

            $logo = $partner->firstMedia('logo');
            $this->assertSame('Logo contoh '.$partner->name, $logo->alt_text);
            $this->assertSame([400, 200], [$logo->width, $logo->height]);
            $this->assertSame('png', $logo->extension);
        }
    }

    public function test_media_counts_per_collection_and_files_exist(): void
    {
        $this->seedContent();

        $this->assertSame(
            ['cover' => 6, 'image' => 3, 'logo' => 4, 'photos' => 12],
            Media::query()->selectRaw('collection, COUNT(*) as total')->groupBy('collection')->orderBy('collection')->pluck('total', 'collection')->map(fn ($total): int => (int) $total)->all(),
        );

        foreach (Media::query()->get() as $media) {
            Storage::disk('public')->assertExists($media->directory.'/'.$media->file_name);
            Storage::disk('public')->assertExists((string) $media->thumb_path);
        }
    }

    {

        $this->seed(ContentSeeder::class);

        $this->assertSame([4, 8, 3, 3, 12, 4, 25], [
            ArticleCategory::query()->count(),
            Article::query()->count(),
            Banner::query()->count(),
            Gallery::query()->count(),
            Faq::query()->count(),
            InsurancePartner::query()->count(),
            Media::query()->count(),

    public function test_a_soft_deleted_article_is_not_recreated(): void
    {
        $this->seedContent();
        Article::query()->where('slug', 'cara-mencuci-tangan-yang-benar')->firstOrFail()->delete();

        $this->seed(ContentSeeder::class);

        $this->assertSame(7, Article::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(8, Article::query()->withTrashed()->count());
    }

    public function test_the_seeder_throws_outside_local_and_testing_and_writes_nothing(): void
    {
        $this->seed(DemoUserSeeder::class);

        $original = $this->app['env'];
        $this->app['env'] = 'production';
        $thrown = null;

        try {
            $this->app->make(ContentSeeder::class)->run();
        } catch (RuntimeException $e) {
            $thrown = $e;
        } finally {
            $this->app['env'] = $original;
        }

        $this->assertInstanceOf(RuntimeException::class, $thrown);
        $this->assertSame('ContentSeeder DILARANG di APP_ENV=production. Seeder konten contoh hanya untuk data demo.', $thrown->getMessage());
        $this->assertSame(0, DB::table('articles')->count() + DB::table('article_categories')->count() + DB::table('media')->count());
    }

    public function test_the_seeder_requires_the_demo_content_admin_account(): void
    {
        $thrown = null;

        try {
            $this->app->make(ContentSeeder::class)->run();
        } catch (RuntimeException $e) {
            $thrown = $e;
        }

        $this->assertInstanceOf(RuntimeException::class, $thrown);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Jalankan DemoUserSeeder lebih dulu.', $thrown->getMessage());
        $this->assertSame(0, Article::query()->count() + ArticleCategory::query()->count() + Media::query()->count());
    }

            ->expectsOutputToContain('Baris media yatim: 0')

            ->assertExitCode(0);
    }

    public function test_the_content_seeder_is_not_called_by_the_database_seeder_and_users_stay_untouched(): void
    {

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('ContentSeeder', $source);
        $this->seedContent();
        $this->assertSame(3, DB::table('users')->count());
    }
```

```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use App\Enums\ArticleStatus;
use App\Models\Article;
use App\Models\ArticleCategory;
use App\Models\Banner;
use App\Models\Faq;
use App\Models\Gallery;
use App\Models\InsurancePartner;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Media\MediaService;
use App\Services\Media\PlaceholderImageGenerator;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Data demo konten (13 §8.3 s.d. §8.7, F4A-R27): kategori dan artikel kesehatan umum, banner beranda, album galeri,
 * FAQ, dan mitra asuransi fiktif berlabel "Contoh". Hanya `local`/`testing`; idempoten per slug atau judul.
 * `PageSeeder` (15 halaman) berjalan di semua lingkungan dan tidak ada di sini.
 */
class ContentSeeder extends Seeder
{
    /** Akun penulis artikel (DemoUserSeeder::ACCOUNTS, Admin Konten Demo). */
    public const AUTHOR_EMAIL = 'konten@unpamhospital.test';

    /** Kalimat penutup baku setiap artikel (13 §8.5). */
    public const CLOSING_SENTENCE = 'Informasi ini bersifat umum dan tidak menggantikan konsultasi dengan tenaga kesehatan.';

    /**
     * `sort_order` = nomor urut 1…n.
     *
     * @var list<array{name: string, slug: string}>
     */
    public const CATEGORIES = [
        ['name' => 'Kesehatan Umum', 'slug' => 'kesehatan-umum'],
        ['name' => 'Keluarga dan Anak', 'slug' => 'keluarga-dan-anak'],
        ['name' => 'Gaya Hidup Sehat', 'slug' => 'gaya-hidup-sehat'],
        ['name' => 'Info Layanan', 'slug' => 'info-layanan'],
    ];

    /**
     * 13 §8.5. `days` = umur terbit dalam hari (NULL = draf). `paragraphs` adalah dua paragraf orisinal yang netral;
     * kalimat penutup ditambahkan sebagai paragraf ketiga. `cover` false untuk artikel #5 (uji placeholder) dan draf #8.
     *
     * @var list<array{title: string, slug: string, category: string, days: ?int, excerpt: string, paragraphs: list<string>, cover: bool}>

     *
     * @var list<array{name: string, slug: string, type: string, code: string, description: string}>
     */
    public const PARTNERS = [
        ['name' => 'Asuransi Contoh Sehat', 'slug' => 'asuransi-contoh-sehat', 'type' => 'asuransi', 'code' => 'ACS', 'description' => 'Contoh mitra asuransi kesehatan untuk keperluan prototipe. Bukan kerja sama nyata.'],

        ['name' => 'PT Contoh Karya Mandiri', 'slug' => 'pt-contoh-karya-mandiri', 'type' => 'perusahaan', 'code' => 'PCKM', 'description' => 'Contoh perusahaan rekanan layanan kesehatan karyawan. Bukan kerja sama nyata.'],
    ];

    private MediaService $media;

    private PlaceholderImageGenerator $generator;

    public function run(): void
    {
        if (! app()->environment(['local', 'testing'])) {
            throw new RuntimeException('ContentSeeder DILARANG di APP_ENV='.app()->environment().'. Seeder konten contoh hanya untuk data demo.');
        }

        $author = User::query()->where('email', self::AUTHOR_EMAIL)->first();

        if ($author === null) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Akun Admin Konten Demo belum ada. Jalankan DemoUserSeeder lebih dulu.');
        }

        $this->media = app(MediaService::class);
        $this->generator = app(PlaceholderImageGenerator::class);

        $this->seedCategories();
        $this->seedArticles($author);
        $this->seedBanners();
        $this->seedGalleries();
        $this->seedFaqs();
        $this->seedPartners();
    }

    private function seedCategories(): void
    {
        foreach (self::CATEGORIES as $index => $row) {
            if (ArticleCategory::query()->where('slug', $row['slug'])->exists()) {
                $this->command?->warn("Kategori artikel {$row['name']} sudah ada, dilewati.");

                continue;
            }

            ArticleCategory::query()->create([
                'name' => $row['name'],
                'slug' => $row['slug'],
                'description' => null,
                'sort_order' => $index + 1,
            ]);
        }
    }

    private function seedArticles(User $author): void
    {
        $categories = ArticleCategory::query()->pluck('id', 'slug');

        foreach (self::ARTICLES as $index => $row) {
            if (Article::query()->withTrashed()->where('slug', $row['slug'])->exists()) {
                $this->command?->warn("Artikel {$row['title']} sudah ada, dilewati.");

                continue;
            }

            $categoryId = $categories->get($row['category']);

            if ($categoryId === null) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Kategori artikel {$row['category']} belum ada.");
            }

            $published = $row['days'] !== null;

            $article = Article::query()->create([
                'article_category_id' => $categoryId,
                'author_user_id' => $author->id,
                'title' => $row['title'],
                'slug' => $row['slug'],
                'excerpt' => $row['excerpt'],
                'body' => self::body($row['paragraphs']),
                'status' => $published ? ArticleStatus::Published : ArticleStatus::Draft,
                'published_at' => $published ? now()->subDays($row['days']) : null,
                'meta_title' => null,
                'meta_description' => null,
            ]);

            if ($row['cover']) {
                $this->attach('cover', 'ARTIKEL '.($index + 1), 1200, 675, 'cover', $article, 'Ilustrasi contoh '.$row['title']);
            }
        }
    }

    private function seedBanners(): void
    {
        foreach (self::BANNERS as $index => $row) {
            if (Banner::query()->where('title', $row['title'])->exists()) {
                $this->command?->warn("Banner {$row['title']} sudah ada, dilewati.");

                continue;
            }

            $banner = Banner::query()->create([
                'title' => $row['title'],
                'subtitle' => $row['subtitle'],
                'button_label' => $row['label'],
                'button_url' => $row['url'],
                'sort_order' => $index + 1,
                'is_active' => true,
                'starts_at' => now()->startOfDay(),
                'ends_at' => null,
            ]);

            $this->attach('image', 'BANNER '.($index + 1), 1600, 600, 'image', $banner, 'Banner contoh '.$row['title']);
        }
    }

    private function seedGalleries(): void
    {
        foreach (self::GALLERIES as $index => $row) {
            if (Gallery::query()->where('slug', $row['slug'])->exists()) {
                $this->command?->warn("Album {$row['title']} sudah ada, dilewati.");

                continue;
            }

            $gallery = Gallery::query()->create([
                'title' => $row['title'],
                'slug' => $row['slug'],
                'description' => $row['description'],
                'is_published' => true,
                'sort_order' => $index + 1,
            ]);

            foreach (range(1, 4) as $number) {
                $this->attach(
                    'photos',
                    'ALBUM '.($index + 1).'-'.$number,
                    1200,
                    800,
                    'photos',
                    $gallery,
                    "Foto contoh {$row['title']} {$number}",
                    "Foto contoh: {$row['title']}, foto {$number} dari 4.",
                );
            }
        }
    }

    private function seedFaqs(): void
    {
        foreach (self::FAQS as $index => $row) {
            if (Faq::query()->where('question', $row['question'])->exists()) {
                $this->command?->warn("FAQ \"{$row['question']}\" sudah ada, dilewati.");

                continue;
            }

            Faq::query()->create([
                'category' => $row['category'],
                'question' => $row['question'],
                'answer' => $row['answer'],
                'sort_order' => $index + 1,
                'is_published' => true,
            ]);
        }
    }

    private function seedPartners(): void
    {
        foreach (self::PARTNERS as $index => $row) {
            if (InsurancePartner::query()->where('slug', $row['slug'])->exists()) {
                $this->command?->warn("Mitra {$row['name']} sudah ada, dilewati.");

                continue;
            }

            $partner = InsurancePartner::query()->create([
                'name' => $row['name'],
                'slug' => $row['slug'],
                'type' => $row['type'],
                'description' => $row['description'],
                'website_url' => null,
                'is_active' => true,
                'sort_order' => $index + 1,
            ]);

            $this->attach('logo', $row['code'], 400, 200, 'logo', $partner, 'Logo contoh '.$row['name']);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Isi artikel: dua paragraf orisinal ditambah kalimat penutup baku (HTML disanitasi trait saat disimpan).
     *
     * @param  list<string>  $paragraphs
     */
    public static function body(array $paragraphs): string
    {
        $html = '';

        foreach ([...$paragraphs, self::CLOSING_SENTENCE] as $paragraph) {
            $html .= '<p>'.e($paragraph).'</p>';
        }

        return $html;
    }

    /**
     * Membuat satu gambar contoh lewat GD lalu menyimpannya lewat MediaService; berkas sementara selalu dihapus.
     */
    private function attach(string $type, string $label, int $width, int $height, string $collection, Model $owner, string $alt, ?string $caption = null): void
    {
        $file = $this->generator->make($type, $label, $width, $height);

        try {
            $this->media->store($file, $collection, $owner, ['alt_text' => $alt, 'caption' => $caption]);
        } finally {
            @unlink($file->getPathname());
        }
    }
}
```

```php
    /** AKS-04 dan F4A-R30: layar konten tidak mengueri data pasien, pendaftaran, atau pesan kontak. */

    {
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $screens = [
            ['admin.pages.index', []],
            ['admin.pages.edit', ['page' => $this->createPage('about')->id]],
            ['admin.banners.index', []],
            ['admin.banners.create', []],
            ['admin.banners.edit', ['banner' => $this->createBanner()->id]],

            ['admin.articles.create', []],

            ['admin.galleries.index', []],

            ['admin.faqs.index', []],

            ['admin.insurance-partners.index', []],
            ['admin.insurance-partners.create', []],
            ['admin.insurance-partners.edit', ['insurancePartner' => $this->createInsurancePartner()->id]],
        ];

        foreach ($screens as [$name, $parameters]) {
            DB::flushQueryLog();
            DB::enableQueryLog();

            $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route($name, $parameters))->assertOk();

            foreach (DB::getQueryLog() as $entry) {
                $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression(
                    '/\b(patient_profiles|appointments|appointment_status_histories|contact_messages)\b/',
                    $entry['query'],
                    "{$name} mengueri data pasien: {$entry['query']}",
                );
            }
        }

        DB::disableQueryLog();
    }
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Access;

use App\Support\NavigationMenu;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * KNS-01 (bagian fase 4a), KNS-02 (route admin berizin), KNS-03 (`content.manage`), dan bagian route dari CRD-13:
 * 40 nama route konten, izin, nama parameter, URI Indonesia, 11 route publik terbuka, serta route yang sengaja tidak ada.
 */
class Phase4aRoutePermissionTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const MANAGE = 'permission:content.manage';

    /** @return array<string, array{string, string}> */
    public static function permissions(): array
    {
        $names = ['admin.pages.index', 'admin.pages.edit', 'admin.pages.update', 'admin.galleries.photos.store'];

        foreach (['banners', 'articles', 'article-categories', 'galleries', 'faqs', 'insurance-partners'] as $resource) {
            foreach (['index', 'create', 'store', 'edit', 'update', 'destroy'] as $action) {
                $names[] = "admin.{$resource}.{$action}";
            }
        }

        $cases = [];

        foreach ($names as $name) {
            $cases[$name] = [$name, self::MANAGE];
        }

        return $cases;
    }

    #[DataProvider('permissions')]
    public function test_route_exists_with_the_content_manage_permission_middleware(string $name, string $permission): void
    {
        $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName($name);

        $this->assertNotNull($route, "Route {$name} belum terdaftar.");

        $middleware = array_filter($route->gatherMiddleware(), 'is_string');
        $this->assertContains($permission, $middleware, "Route {$name} harus memakai {$permission}.");
        $this->assertContains('auth', $middleware, "Route {$name} harus berada di grup admin yang memakai auth.");
        $this->assertCount(1, array_filter($middleware, fn (string $item): bool => str_starts_with($item, 'permission:')), "Route {$name} hanya boleh memakai satu middleware izin.");
    }

    public function test_the_phase_4a_admin_route_names_are_exactly_the_forty_documented_ones(): void
    {
        $names = [];

        foreach (Route::getRoutes()->getRoutes() as $route) {
            $name = (string) $route->getName();

            if (preg_match('/^admin\.(pages|banners|articles|article-categories|galleries|faqs|insurance-partners)\./', $name) === 1) {
                $names[] = $name;
            }
        }

        sort($names);

        $this->assertSame(40, count($names));
        $this->assertSame(array_values(array_unique($names)), $names, 'Nama route tidak boleh ganda.');
        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing(array_keys(self::permissions()), $names);
    }

    public function test_the_admin_area_has_ninety_routes_after_phase_4a(): void
    {
        $count = 0;

        foreach (Route::getRoutes()->getRoutes() as $route) {
            if ($route->uri() === 'admin' || str_starts_with($route->uri(), 'admin/')) {
                $count++;
            }
        }

        // 31 fase 1-2 + 19 fase 3 + 40 fase 4a (F4A-R28); fase 4b dan seterusnya wajib memperbarui angka ini.
        $this->assertSame(90, $count);
    }

    public function test_route_parameters_are_named_as_documented(): void
    {
        $expected = [
            'admin.pages.edit' => ['page'],
            'admin.banners.edit' => ['banner'],
            'admin.articles.edit' => ['article'],
            'admin.article-categories.edit' => ['articleCategory'],
            'admin.galleries.edit' => ['gallery'],
            'admin.galleries.photos.store' => ['gallery'],
            'admin.faqs.edit' => ['faq'],
            'admin.insurance-partners.edit' => ['insurancePartner'],
        ];

        foreach ($expected as $name => $parameters) {
            $this->assertSame($parameters, Route::getRoutes()->getByName($name)->parameterNames(), $name);
        }
    }

    public function test_pages_have_no_create_store_destroy_or_show_routes(): void
    {
        foreach (['admin.pages.create', 'admin.pages.store', 'admin.pages.destroy', 'admin.pages.show'] as $name) {
            $this->assertNull(Route::getRoutes()->getByName($name), "{$name} tidak boleh ada (halaman sistem, 00 C).");
        }

        foreach (['banners', 'articles', 'article-categories', 'galleries', 'faqs', 'insurance-partners'] as $resource) {
            $this->assertNull(Route::getRoutes()->getByName("admin.{$resource}.show"), "admin.{$resource}.show tidak boleh ada (00 I.6).");
        }

        $this->delete('/admin/konten/halaman/1')->assertStatus(405);
        $this->post('/admin/konten/halaman')->assertStatus(405);
        $this->put('/admin/konten/halaman')->assertStatus(405);
        $this->get('/admin/konten/banner/1')->assertStatus(405);
    }

    public function test_uris_use_indonesian_segments(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('/admin/konten/halaman', route('admin.pages.index', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/konten/halaman/3/ubah', route('admin.pages.edit', 3, false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/konten/halaman/3', route('admin.pages.update', 3, false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/konten/banner', route('admin.banners.index', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/konten/banner/buat', route('admin.banners.create', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/konten/banner/4/ubah', route('admin.banners.edit', 4, false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/konten/artikel', route('admin.articles.index', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/konten/artikel/3/ubah', route('admin.articles.edit', 3, false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/konten/kategori-artikel', route('admin.article-categories.index', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/konten/kategori-artikel/5/ubah', route('admin.article-categories.edit', 5, false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/konten/galeri', route('admin.galleries.index', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/konten/galeri/2/ubah', route('admin.galleries.edit', 2, false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/konten/galeri/2/foto', route('admin.galleries.photos.store', 2, false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/konten/faq/buat', route('admin.faqs.create', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/konten/asuransi', route('admin.insurance-partners.index', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/konten/asuransi/9/ubah', route('admin.insurance-partners.edit', 9, false));
    }

    public function test_static_segments_are_matched_before_parameterised_routes(): void
    {
        $routes = Route::getRoutes();

        foreach ([
            'banner' => 'admin.banners.create',
            'artikel' => 'admin.articles.create',
            'kategori-artikel' => 'admin.article-categories.create',
            'galeri' => 'admin.galleries.create',
            'faq' => 'admin.faqs.create',
            'asuransi' => 'admin.insurance-partners.create',
        ] as $segment => $name) {
            $this->assertSame($name, $routes->match(Request::create("/admin/konten/{$segment}/buat", 'GET'))->getName());
        }

        $this->assertSame('admin.galleries.photos.store', $routes->match(Request::create('/admin/konten/galeri/7/foto', 'POST'))->getName());
        $this->assertSame('admin.banners.destroy', $routes->match(Request::create('/admin/konten/banner/7', 'DELETE'))->getName());
        $this->assertSame('admin.articles.update', $routes->match(Request::create('/admin/konten/artikel/7', 'PUT'))->getName());
    }

    public function test_admin_ids_must_be_numeric(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->createStaff('super-admin');

        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin/konten/artikel/abc/ubah')->assertNotFound();
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin/konten/kategori-artikel/abc/ubah')->assertNotFound();
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin/konten/asuransi/abc/ubah')->assertNotFound();
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{string, string}> */
    public static function publicRoutes(): array
    {
        return [
            'home' => ['home', '/'],
            'about' => ['about', 'profil'],
            'vision-mission' => ['vision-mission', 'visi-misi'],
            'insurance' => ['insurance', 'bpjs-asuransi'],
            'registration-guide' => ['registration-guide', 'panduan-pendaftaran'],
            'articles.index' => ['articles.index', 'artikel'],
            'articles.show' => ['articles.show', 'artikel/{article}'],
            'galleries.index' => ['galleries.index', 'galeri'],
            'galleries.show' => ['galleries.show', 'galeri/{gallery}'],
            'faq' => ['faq', 'faq'],
            'privacy' => ['privacy', 'kebijakan-privasi'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('publicRoutes')]
    public function test_public_content_routes_are_open_get_routes_without_auth_or_permission_middleware(string $name, string $uri): void
    {
        $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName($name);

        $this->assertNotNull($route, "Route {$name} belum terdaftar.");
        $this->assertSame(['GET', 'HEAD'], $route->methods());
        $this->assertSame($uri, $route->uri());

        foreach (array_filter($route->gatherMiddleware(), 'is_string') as $middleware) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('permission:', $middleware, "{$name}: {$middleware}");
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('auth', $middleware, "{$name}: {$middleware}");
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('account:', $middleware, "{$name}: {$middleware}");
        }
    }

    public function test_article_and_gallery_detail_routes_bind_by_slug(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('slug', Route::getRoutes()->getByName('articles.show')->bindingFieldFor('article'));
        $this->assertSame('slug', Route::getRoutes()->getByName('galleries.show')->bindingFieldFor('gallery'));
    }

    public function test_public_uris_use_indonesian_segments(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('/', route('home', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/profil', route('about', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/visi-misi', route('vision-mission', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/bpjs-asuransi', route('insurance', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/panduan-pendaftaran', route('registration-guide', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/artikel', route('articles.index', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/artikel/menjaga-jantung', route('articles.show', 'menjaga-jantung', false));
        $this->assertSame('/galeri/lobi', route('galleries.show', 'lobi', false));
        $this->assertSame('/faq', route('faq', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/kebijakan-privasi', route('privacy', [], false));
    }

    public function test_the_content_module_tabs_follow_the_documented_configuration(): void
    {
        $tabs = config('navigation.modules.content');

        $this->assertSame(
            ['admin.pages.index', 'admin.banners.index', 'admin.articles.index', 'admin.article-categories.index', 'admin.galleries.index', 'admin.faqs.index', 'admin.insurance-partners.index'],
            array_column($tabs, 'route'),
        );
        $this->assertSame(['Halaman', 'Banner', 'Artikel', 'Kategori Artikel', 'Galeri', 'FAQ', 'Mitra Asuransi'], array_column($tabs, 'label'));
        $this->assertSame(array_fill(0, 7, 'content.manage'), array_column($tabs, 'permission'));
    }

    public function test_only_users_with_content_manage_see_the_content_tabs(): void
    {
        $this->assertCount(7, NavigationMenu::items('modules.content', $this->createStaff('content-admin')));
        $this->assertCount(7, NavigationMenu::items('modules.content', $this->createStaff('super-admin')));
        $this->assertSame([], NavigationMenu::items('modules.content', $this->createStaff('registration-officer')));
        $this->assertSame([], NavigationMenu::items('modules.content', null));
    }
}
```

````markdown
## Fase 4a — Konten publik dan CMS (halaman, banner, artikel, galeri, FAQ, mitra asuransi)

Yang tersedia:
- **Konten Website** di <http://unpam-hospital.test/admin/konten/halaman> dengan tujuh tab: **Halaman** (15 halaman tetap), **Banner**, **Artikel**, **Kategori Artikel**, **Galeri**, **FAQ**, dan **Mitra Asuransi** (`/admin/konten/banner`, `/artikel`, `/kategori-artikel`, `/galeri`, `/faq`, `/asuransi`).
- Halaman publik **Beranda** (`/`, banner carousel, layanan, dokter, artikel terbaru, dan CTA bantuan), **Profil** (`/profil`), **Visi dan Misi** (`/visi-misi`), **BPJS dan Asuransi** (`/bpjs-asuransi`), **Panduan Pendaftaran** (`/panduan-pendaftaran`), **Artikel** (`/artikel`, `/artikel/{slug}`), **Galeri** (`/galeri`, `/galeri/{slug}`), **FAQ** (`/faq`), dan **Kebijakan Privasi** (`/kebijakan-privasi`). Judul halaman #4, #6, dan #8 kini dibaca dari tabel `pages`.
- Fasilitas, kamar rawat inap, kontak, dan kotak pesan menyusul di fase 4b. Tombol menuju fitur fase berikutnya (Daftar Kunjungan, Masuk, Kirim Pesan) baru tampil setelah route-nya ada.

### Hak akses

| Peran | Kelola konten (halaman, banner, artikel, galeri, FAQ, mitra) |
|---|:-:|
| Super Admin | ya |
| Admin Konten | ya |
| Petugas Pendaftaran | tidak (403) |

Layar konten tidak pernah memuat data pasien. Halaman publik terbuka untuk semua orang; artikel draf, terjadwal, atau terhapus dan album yang belum terbit menjawab 404 di URL-nya, juga untuk staf yang login.

### Aturan yang berlaku untuk semua peran, termasuk Super Admin

15 halaman bersifat tetap: tidak dapat ditambah atau dihapus, hanya diubah. Isi artikel tidak boleh kosong setelah disanitasi. Satu album paling banyak 100 foto. Mitra asuransi yang masih dirujuk data pendaftaran tidak dapat dihapus (nonaktifkan saja). Menghapus artikel hanya menyembunyikannya (soft delete); menghapus kategori membuat artikelnya tanpa kategori; menghapus album ikut menghapus berkas fotonya.

### Data awal dan data demo

`PageSeeder` membuat 15 halaman di semua lingkungan (termasuk produksi) lewat `db:seed`. Data contoh konten hanya untuk lokal:

```powershell
& $PHP artisan migrate:fresh --seed   # LOKAL SAJA: menghapus semua tabel dan isi database unpam_hospital
```

Selain data fase 1–3: 15 halaman, 4 kategori artikel, 8 artikel (7 terbit dan 1 draf; satu artikel sengaja tanpa cover untuk menguji placeholder), 3 banner (banner kedua baru memiliki tombol setelah fase 6), 3 album dengan 12 foto, 12 FAQ, dan 4 mitra asuransi fiktif berlabel "Contoh". Total gambar contoh menjadi 57 (32 fase 2 + 25 konten), semuanya dibuat lokal oleh GD. Teks contoh harus ditinjau dan disesuaikan oleh admin sebelum dipakai di produksi.
````

   - Beranda: tiga banner berputar tiap 6 detik; tombol "Jeda"/"Putar" mengubah `aria-pressed`; hover dan fokus menjeda; panah keyboard bekerja; emulasi `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` menghentikan putaran otomatis; banner kedua tanpa tombol; enam layanan, empat dokter dengan "Jadwal terdekat", tiga artikel terbaru, CTA (IGD, WhatsApp, Telepon, Petunjuk Arah; tanpa "Kirim Pesan").
   - `/artikel`: filter kategori dan pencarian (`?kategori=gaya-hidup-sehat`, `?q=jantung`), parameter tidak valid (`?kategori=%00`, `?q[]=x`) tetap 200; draf `/artikel/draf-menjaga-kesehatan-di-musim-hujan` menjawab 404, juga setelah login sebagai staf.
   - `/galeri/{slug}`: klik thumbnail membuka modal, panah keyboard dan Esc bekerja, fokus kembali ke thumbnail.
   - `/faq`: accordion tertutup awalnya dan `aria-expanded` berubah.
2. **Publik, mobile 360 px.** Semua halaman di atas tanpa gulir horizontal; tiga tombol utama beranda terlihat tanpa gulir (15 RSP-01); pencarian cepat berupa tombol terlipat; target sentuh ≥ 44 px; gambar hilang memakai placeholder (hapus satu berkas cover lalu muat ulang).
3. **Admin Konten** (`konten@unpamhospital.test`): sidebar "Konten Website" memuat tujuh item; `/admin/konten/halaman` menampilkan 15 baris tanpa tombol tambah/hapus; ubah `about` dengan payload `<script>` dan `<p><br></p>` (tersanitasi/ditolak sesuai aturan); CRUD banner dengan unggahan gambar (SVG dan `shell.php.jpg` ditolak, < 1200x400 ditolak); artikel draf → terbit → terjadwal, isi kosong ditolak, soft delete lalu buat artikel berjudul sama (slug `-2`); kategori (hapus membuat artikel tanpa kategori); album baru → unggah foto + alt, urutkan, hapus foto, hapus album; FAQ; mitra asuransi (tambah, nonaktifkan, hapus logo); setiap perubahan langsung tampil di halaman publik.
4. **Petugas Pendaftaran** (`pendaftaran@unpamhospital.test`): semua `/admin/konten/*` menjawab 403 dan item "Konten Website" tidak tampil di sidebar. **Super Admin**: semua layar konten terbuka. Mitra asuransi yang dirujuk appointment tidak dapat dicoba karena appointment demo baru ada di fase 6 (diuji otomatis di Task 11).
5. **Konsol dan jaringan.** Tidak ada pelanggaran CSP, galat JavaScript, atau permintaan ke domain eksternal (kecuali tautan yang diklik) pada semua halaman di atas; hanya satu pendengar `error` tertaut.
6. **Aksesibilitas.** Audit Lighthouse aksesibilitas ≥ 90 untuk beranda `/`, `/artikel`, `/artikel/{slug}`, `/galeri`, dan `/faq` (15 A11-05); urutan fokus keyboard beranda: skip link → header → tiga tombol → carousel (panah, indikator, Jeda) → pencarian → layanan → dokter → artikel → CTA → footer.

## Catatan Eksekusi (2026-10-06)

Dieksekusi dengan `superpowers:subagent-driven-development`. Semua peran memakai subagent **Sonnet 5.5** (preferensi pemilik): implementer, reviewer per tugas, re-reviewer, final reviewer, implementer gelombang perbaikan final, dan penguji manual Playwright. Eksekusi berlangsung 2026-10-06 dalam satu sesi. Satu kali agen terputus karena galat jaringan (ENOTFOUND) di akhir Task 2; agen yang sama dilanjutkan dan commit-nya utuh.

Cabang `fase-4a-konten-publik` dibuat dari `master` (`a6c9534`). Isinya dua commit penyusunan (`4a9b27a` CHECKPOINT, `8e46a10` rencana), 22 commit kerja (`31d32af`..`a57eccf`), ditambah commit catatan ini.

|---|---|
| `artisan test` | **4348 tes lulus (21166 asersi)**, ±665 s, diverifikasi koordinator di `a57eccf`; basis fase 3: 2933 |
| `pint --test` | PASS |
| `npm run build` | Sukses (T14, T15, T17); tanpa entri Vite baru |
| `route:list --path=admin` | 90 route (50 fase 1–3 + 40 baru di `admin/konten`) |

**Fase 4b:**
- Hapus `ContentSchemaTest::test_the_phase_4b_migrations_are_not_created_yet` saat migration 4b dibuat.

**Fase 6 (Booking):**
- Pindahkan `nextSession` dan saringan spesialisasi aktif ke satu tempat (`DoctorAvailabilityQuery` atau `SessionAvailability`) sebelum salinan ketiga muncul (E12).

**Minor yang ditunda (tidak memblokir):**
- Target sentuh tautan teks footer, breadcrumb, dan kartu (20–25 px; uji manual M1).
- Form mitra tanpa kontrol "hapus logo" (uji manual M2; logo cukup diganti).
- Pratinjau draf/artikel terjadwal untuk staf (kini 404 untuk semua, F4A-R10).

- Admin Halaman bergantung pada `PageSeeder` (README sudah memuat checklist deploy).
- `HomeController` memutasi `request()->query` untuk `page`; aturan `page` mati di `Public\ArticleIndexRequest`; kategori tanpa artikel ikut di dropdown #18; canonical #18 halaman 2/berfilter menunjuk `/artikel`.
- `tel:+` bila nomor hanya berisi `+`; balapan cek-lalu-hapus mitra (500 FK); `forceDelete` artikel terhapus-lunak mungkin mencatat audit dua kali.
- Suite kini ±11–14 menit (4348 tes); implementer perlu menjalankannya di latar belakang.
